## 1. **파이프라인 저촉 ① — 고정값 「단위셀 2×2×2」가 이 후보군 대부분에서 물리적으로 틀립니다**

CLAUDE.md §1 은 컷오프 12 Å 과 단위셀 2×2×2 를 **둘 다** 불변으로 고정했습니다. 이 둘은 독립이 아닙니다. 최소상(minimum image) 규약은 슈퍼셀의 각 변이 **2 × 컷오프 = 24 Å 이상**일 것을 요구합니다. ZIF-69 의 gme 셀은 a ≈ 26 Å 급이라 2×2×2 로 충분했고 — **그래서 이 문제가 지금까지 드러나지 않았습니다.**

신규 후보는 대부분 소형 셀입니다:
- SIFSIX-3 계열: 피라진 기둥 격자라 셀 변이 ~7 Å 급 [미확인 — CIF 확인 필요] → 2×2×2 ≈ 14 Å < 24 Å. **4×4×4 이상 필요**
- CALF-20: 단사정, 변 ~10 Å 급 [미확인] → 2×2×2 ≈ 20 Å < 24 Å
- MIL-120: Al–OH 사슬 간 5.30 Å, 리간드 간격 4.78 Å [전문] → 최소 변이 매우 짧음

**이것은 성능 최적화가 아니라 정확성 문제입니다.** §1 은 "성능을 위해 바꾸고 싶으면 바꾸지 말고 물어보라"고 했으므로, 이 건은 반드시 사용자 결정으로 올려야 합니다. 권고: **"2×2×2" 를 "각 변 ≥ 24 Å 를 만족하는 최소 정수배"로 다시 쓰되, ZIF-69 계열에서는 그것이 곧 2×2×2 라 기존 결과와 100 % 호환**임을 명시. 이렇게 하면 고정값을 바꾸지 않으면서 규약을 지킬 수 있습니다.

## 2. **파이프라인 저촉 ② — PLD ≥ 3.3 Å 관문이 습윤 근거가 가장 좋은 계열을 통째로 떨어뜨립니다**

`V5_RULERS_20260824.md §2` 는 PLD ≥ 3.3 Å 을 **"다음 세대 구조부터 정식 적용"** 으로 등록했고, **신규 골격이 바로 그 다음 세대**입니다. 그런데:
- SIFSIX-3-Cu 세공 3.50 Å, SIFSIX-3-Zn 3.84 Å [전문]
- Cu-F-pymo 세공 ≈ 3.4 Å [요지]

이 값들은 문헌의 "세공 지름"이지 Zeo++ PLD 가 아니며, **PLD 는 대개 그보다 작게 나옵니다.** 즉 이 계열은 관문에서 자동 탈락할 개연성이 높습니다. 그런데 이 계열이야말로 우리 질문(습윤 CO2)에서 세계 최고 자료를 가진 쪽입니다. 게다가 `LITERATURE_COREMOF_20260904.md §1` 이 이미 정반대 방향을 지목했습니다 — CoRE MOF 2025 1등 물질은 창 지름 **3.2 Å**(CO2 3.05 와 N2 3.31 사이)로 N2 를 배제해서 이겼고, 35개 중 17개가 PLD < N2 지름이었습니다.

**즉 우리 관문 문턱(3.3 Å = CO2 운동직경)은 "CO2 가 들어가는가"만 묻고 "N2 가 배제되는가"는 못 묻습니다.** 문턱을 결과 보고 고치는 것은 금지지만, **아직 자료 0건인 신규 계열에 대해 관문을 새로 등록하는 것은 §2 의 "계산 전 등록" 규칙 안**입니다. 권고: T-NF-* 등록 시 PLD 관문을 **하한 3.05 Å(CO2 vdW) · 상한 없음**으로 하고, 3.05~3.31 Å 구간은 탈락이 아니라 **"N2 배제 후보"로 별도 표시**.

## 3. 습윤 근거를 읽을 때 반드시 갈라야 할 세 가지 (MAGI-003 §3 "같은 이름의 다른 양")

이 조사에서 실제로 부딪힌 혼동입니다:

**(가) 평형 대 breakthrough.** MIL-120 의 92 %, Ni-4-PyC 의 93 %, TIFSIX-3-Ni 의 90 %, IITKGP-12 의 "영향 없음" — **전부 breakthrough(동적·유한 접촉시간)** 입니다. TIFSIX-3-Ni 논문은 이 점을 스스로 드러냅니다: 같은 물질이 **평형계 인용에서는 83 %, 비평형 짧은 사이클에서는 90 %** 입니다. 그리고 90 % 를 만드는 것은 열역학이 아니라 **물 수착 동역학이 느리다는 사실**입니다. **우리 RH90 평형 GCMC 는 원리적으로 83 % 쪽(또는 더 낮은 쪽)만 잽니다.** 문헌의 유지율을 우리 유지율 옆에 나란히 놓으면 그 자체가 오독입니다.

**(나) RH 값.** 확인된 습윤 자료의 RH 는 5 % (MIL-53 MTV) · 40 % (CALF-20) · 49 % (DAC 표) · 50 % (KAUST-7) · 65 % (KAUST-7) · 74 % (SIFSIX-18-Ni-β) · 75 % (MIL-120, SIFSIX-3-Ni, TIFSIX-3-Ni) · 80 % (TIFSIX 안정성) · 85 % 초과 (Ni-4-PyC 증기 처리) · 95 % (SIFSIX-18-Ni-β 물 등온) 입니다. **우리 RH90(2852.1 Pa)보다 낮은 조건이 대부분**이고, RH90 에서 CO2 를 잰 문헌은 이 조사에서 **0건**이었습니다. 우리 조건이 문헌보다 가혹하다는 것은 신규성이자, 문헌 유지율이 우리 값의 상한이라는 뜻입니다.

**(다) 압력.** HUM/DAC 문헌의 절대다수가 400 ppm ~ 10,000 ppm (= 0.0004 ~ 0.01 bar) 입니다. 우리 0.15 bar 와 **15~375배** 차입니다. 0.15 bar 부근의 직접 자료가 있는 후보는 넷뿐입니다: **MIL-120(150 mbar 등온 4점), MIL-160(150 mbar 1.24 mmol/g), MIL-120-AP(0.1 bar 1.9 mmol/g), 그리고 SIFSIX-3-Ni / TIFSIX-3-Ni(0.15 bar·75 % RH 의 상대값 62 % / 83 %)**.

## 4. 우리 「월등」 정의를 이 후보군에 대 보면

`DESIGN_STUDY_20260903.md §2-3` 의 세 조건 중 셋째 — **RH90 물 로딩 ≤ 0.75 mmol/g** — 를 통과할 가능성이 있는 후보는 사실상 **SIFSIX-18-Ni-β 하나**입니다(RH 95 % 에서 0.96 mmol/g, 우리 기준을 여전히 28 % 초과하지만 saIm0583 의 1.2185 mmol/g 보다 낮음). 나머지는:
- CALF-20: RH 90 % 에서 ≈10 mmol/g [계산] — 한 자릿수 초과
- MIL-120: P/P0 0.15 에서 이미 대량 흡수 — 초과
- MIL-160 · CAU-10 · MOF-303: 물 흡착이 **설계 목표였던** 물질들

**읽기: 산업에서 통하는 습윤 CO2 물질의 다수는 "물을 안 먹어서"가 아니라 "물보다 CO2 가 빨라서" 또는 "CO2 가 물을 밀어내서" 통합니다**(CALF-20 의 CO2에 의한 물 억제, MIL-120-AP 의 동역학적 우위, TIFSIX-3-Ni 의 느린 물 동역학). 우리 세 번째 조건은 **소수성 경로만 통과시키는 자**이고, 이 문헌군이 가리키는 두 번째 경로(경쟁 우위)를 통째로 배제합니다. T-NF-* 등록 전에 이 점을 사용자 결정으로 올릴 것을 권고합니다.

## 5. 계산 배정 우선순위 (우리 파이프라인이 **지금 그대로** 돌 수 있는 순서)

**A조 — 강체·OMS 없음·상전이 보고 없음 (바로 돌릴 수 있음)**
1. **MIL-120(Al)** — 0.15 bar 등온 4점 + 습윤 breakthrough + **OMS 부재 실험 확인** + Qst 44. 우리 값과 직접 대조할 외부 앵커로 최상. 약점은 MTV 여지 부족.
2. **Ni-4-PyC** — 습윤 유지율 93 %, >85 % RH 증기 7일 후 등온 불변(우리 RH90 에 가장 가까운 조건). 이소니코틴산 치환체가 전부 상용 → **우리 saIm 스캔의 직행 이식처**. 약점은 구조 지표·0.15 bar 절대량 미확인.
3. **MUF-16** — 5-X-이소프탈레이트 계열(SO3H 포함)이 통째로 상용 → **MTV 여지 최상**. 약점은 습윤 자료 0.
4. **MIL-160(Al)** — 헤테로원자 하나만 바꾸는 단일변수 MTV 축(fdc/CAU-23/MOF-303/CAU-10)이 실재. 약점은 친수성.
5. **IITKGP-12** — 저장소가 이미 «화학 최근접» 으로 등록. 저자 GCMC 의 CO2–술폰 배향을 우리 `density_v3` 로 재현하면 그 자체가 파이프라인 검증.

**B조 — 값어치는 크나 강체 가정이 흔들림 (계산 전 별도 판단 필요)**
6. **SIFSIX-18-Ni-β** — 아졸레이트(비피라졸) 링커라 우리 화학 경험 직결 + 물 친화도 최저. β↔α 상전이가 걸림.
7. **TIFSIX-3-Ni** — 0.15 bar·75 % RH 에서 83 % 라는 우리 조건 최근접 수치 + **CO2/H2O 가 같은 세공에서 저 로딩에서는 서로 돕는다**는 기제. 우리 이성분 GCMC 로 83 % 를 재현하는지가 곧 힘장 검증.

**C조 — 후보로는 내되 계산 배정 불가 (스스로 «모델 불가» 를 적어야 함)**
CALF-20(breathing) · MIL-53 MTV(breathing) · Cu-F-pymo(활성화 상태 의존) · Zn2(Atz)2(ox)(화학흡착 성분) · CD-MOF(알킬카보네이트 화학흡착) · 2-ampd-Mg2(dobpdc)(OMS + 카바메이트).

## 6. 등록 저촉 확인 (MAGI-003 §3 요구사항)

이미 등록된 GME 밖 갈림길(ZIF-2 crb / ZIF-77 frl / npo ZIF-1001)과 GME 안 대안(azbIm · 무극성 등-LCD · b2-아릴 슬릿) 중 **어느 것과도 직접 저촉하지 않습니다** — 위 후보는 전부 비-이미다졸레이트 골격입니다. 다만 두 곳에서 **논리가 겹칩니다**:
- `LITERATURE_COREMOF_20260904.md §1` 의 "소공동 이식 2단(T-C4 crb · T-C9 npo)" 우선순위 근거는 **창 지름으로 N2 를 배제한다**는 것인데, HUM 계열이 그 논리의 극단 사례입니다. 신규 골격 후보와 기존 T-C4/T-C9 는 **같은 가설의 두 실현**이므로, 둘을 각각 등록하면 검정력을 나눠 쓰게 됩니다.
- `DESIGN_STUDY_20260903.md §1-3` "GME 등방 좁히기로는 도달 불가" 는 이 신규 후보군 전체의 존재 이유이기도 합니다.

## 7. 포스터에 즉시 쓸 수 있는 외부 선행 연구 (신규성 방어용)

**10.1021/acs.inorgchem.5c02921** — «Capturing CO2 under Dry and Humid Conditions: **When Does the Parent MOF Outperform the MTV MOF?**» (Inorg. Chem. 2025). MIL-53(Al) 혼합 링커 6단 비율 스캔에서 −CH3 판이 RH 5 % 유지율 ~91 % 를 사는 대신 건조 절대량은 1.58 로 가장 낮고, −NH2 판은 절대량 1.98 을 얻는 대신 RH 5 % 에서 82 % 를 잃습니다. **완전히 다른 화학(Al 카복실레이트)에서 우리 09-08 결론(«유지율과 절대량이 상충하며 saIm050 을 두 축에서 넘는 조성이 없다»)이 독립적으로 재현된 것**입니다. 심사에서 "왜 아무도 안 했나"가 아니라 "다른 데서도 같은 벽에 부딪혔나"를 답할 수 있는 자료이므로, `LITERATURE_NOVELTY_20260909.md` 에 추가할 것을 권고합니다.

Isotherm is essentially saturated by 0.01 bar: 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 mmol/g at 500 / 1000 / 3000 / 5000 / 10000 ppm CO2, 298 K; Qst(CO2) 52 kJ/mol; N2 0.04 mmol/g at 1 bar (Table 1, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171). Extrapolating to 0.15 bar would give ≈2.2-2.4 mmol/g [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH (not equilibrium): fixed-bed 1000/3000 ppm CO2 in N2, 298 K, dry vs 74 % RH; dry 1000 ppm saturation uptake 0.7 mmol/g, retention time 715 min/g. Capture performance retained at high RH also for 0.005 and 0.01 bar CO2 mixtures (figs. S39-S40). Water uptake at 95 % RH = 1.64 mmol/g (vacuum DVS) / 0.96 mmol/g (ambient-pressure DVS) — comparable to ZIF-8 (1.44/2.6 mmol/g) and far below NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (10.09), SIFSIX-3-Ni (8.80), TIFSIX-3-Ni (7.46), zeolite 13X (18.8). S(CO2/H2O) = 16.2 at 500 ppm / 74 % RH.
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes — DVS H2O isotherm at 298 K (Fig. 2E). Very low uptake, consistent with surface sorption only; but a β→α phase transition occurs at 95 % RH (in-situ PXRD, fig. S5), reversible by temperature swing
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized. Hydrothermal reaction of the tetramethylbipyrazole with NiSiF6·6H2O gives SIFSIX-18-Ni-α; 85 °C vacuum converts to the β phase. Mean particle size ca. 14 µm
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for rigid GCMC/UFF_MOF/DDEC6/TIP5P-Ew — no OMS, no amine, no chemisorption; Ni, Si, F all have UFF parameters. CAVEAT: the α↔β transition is a real phase change (13.4 % cell-volume change) that a rigid framework cannot reproduce; a rigid run is a run on ONE of the two phases and must be labelled as such. Zeo++/PACMAN fine.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Very high and directly analogous to our saIm work: (i) 4 methyl positions on the bipyrazole → mix CH3 / H / CF3 / Et / Cl at fractional occupancy, exactly the same 'fraction of substituted sites × arrangement realization' ensemble structure we already run; (ii) anion pillar swap SiF6 → TiF6 (TIFSIX), SnF6, GeF6, NbOF5 (NbOFFIVE), CrO4/SO4; (iii) metal swap Ni → Cu, Co, Zn, Fe, Cd
candidates.risks: (1) Humid evidence is trace-CO2 breakthrough at 74 % RH, NOT equilibrium 0.15 bar / RH90 — MAGI-003 §3 forbids treating it as the same quantity. (2) Phase transition under water = flexibility our pipeline cannot model. (3) Ultramicroporous → low absolute capacity; PLD may fall below our 3.3 Å shadow gate [미확인]. (4) Qst 52 kJ/mol is above the 29.8-41 benchmark band → higher regeneration energy.

candidates.name: MCIF-1
candidates.family: Metal-azolate framework (Cu(I)-imidazolate) — a direct non-Zn, non-ZIF cousin of our ZIF line
candidates.topology: Not stated in the accessible text [미확인]; identified in the ACS Cent. Sci. 2025 screen as one of the 'narrow, straight 1D channel' motif structures (CSD refcode JAWXEN)
candidates.pore_metrics: Not reported in the accessible text; the ACS Cent. Sci. screen classifies it in the 1D-channel group whose average pore diameter is 4.8 Å [요지]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — no CO2 isotherm in the Faraday Discussions paper; the ACS Cent. Sci. numbers are in the blocked SI xlsx
candidates.humid_evidence: INDIRECT. (a) Stability: retains crystallinity after ~1 week soaking in water and across pH 0-13.5 (10.1039/c7fd00017k). (b) It is one of the three structures Kwon et al. show as exemplars of the 1D-channel motif that survives their 40 % RH multicomponent GCMC filter (wet/dry CO2 uptake ratio ≥ 0.9 AND CO2/H2O uptake ratio ≥ 1) (10.1021/acscentsci.5c00777, Fig. 7b)
candidates.water_isotherm: No experimental water isotherm found [미확인]. Of the 117 unique top MOFs in the ACS Cent. Sci. screen only three had published water isotherms, and all three were type VII
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized at ROOM TEMPERATURE; the authors report a slightly modified procedure that produces the material on large scale in very short time — the single most scalable candidate in this list after CALF-20
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid, no OMS on Cu(I) (tetrahedral/trigonal N-coordination like Zn in ZIFs), no chemisorption. UFF has Cu; DDEC6/PACMAN handles Cu(I). This is the closest structural jump from ZIF-69 that is still 'imidazolate chemistry we already know how to build'.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Excellent: the imidazolate 4,5-positions carry two nitriles. Mixed-linker series 4,5-(CN)2-Im / 4-CN-Im / 4-NO2-Im / 4,5-Cl2-Im / plain Im is a textbook MTV ladder, and CN is exactly the 'aza/nitrile acceptor site' descriptor the humid literature keeps pointing at. Metal swap Cu(I) → Ag(I).
candidates.risks: (1) Almost no adsorption data published — we would be generating the first CO2/H2O numbers, i.e. no external anchor (the repo already flags 'humid axis external benchmark = 0'). (2) Cu(I) oxidation to Cu(II) in wet oxidizing flue gas is a real chemical risk our pipeline cannot see. (3) CSD refcode → CIF must be obtained; verify it is the desolvated phase (MeCN guest present in the as-made structure).
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] for the material paper; [전문] for the screening paper that nominates it

candidates.name: CALF-20
candidates.family: Zn-triazolate/oxalate; the only MOF currently commercialised for flue-gas CO2 capture (BASF/Svante)
candidates.topology: Layered Zn-triazolate sheets pillared by oxalate; narrow 1D channels
candidates.pore_metrics: LCD ≈ 4.3 Å, PLD ≈ 3.0 Å (Zeo++-type geometric analysis, 10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0)
candidates.co2_015bar: 2.6 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, 298 K (10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0, citing the Science 2021 report)
candidates.humid_evidence: CO2 selectivity over water is retained only up to ~40 % RH; above 40 % RH competitive water adsorption destroys CO2 uptake, and at 70-80 % RH CO2 uptake is negligible (10.1021/jacs.3c11671; 10.1039/d6sc03678c §2.1). PXRD shows no change at 4-10 % RH but a clear (100)/(011)/(020) change at 20 % RH — humidity-responsive polymorphism
candidates.water_isotherm: YES — type V, inflection below 20 % RH, saturation loading ≈ 11 mmol/g (simulation and experiment agree; 10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0). Water arranges as quasi-1D wires; hydrophobicity at low RH comes from the framework not opening, not from a hydrophobic surface
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercial, scaled by BASF with Svante; cheapest and most process-validated MOF in this list
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PARTIALLY. Rigid GCMC on the activated phase is standard and published, but CALF-20 is adsorption-flexible and humidity-polymorphic: a rigid run cannot reproduce the >20 % RH structural switch, which is precisely where its humid performance dies. Also PLD 3.0 Å < our 3.3 Å CO2-kinetic-diameter gate — under the rule that PLD becomes a formal gate 'from the next generation of structures' (V5_RULERS_20260824.md §2), CALF-20 would be REJECTED by our own gate while being the world's only commercial sorbent. That contradiction must be registered before any T-NF-* threshold is written.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Enormous and already partly explored by others (see CALF-20M, SquCALF-20, CALF20-SiF6-met-w rows): triazolate 3/5-methylation fraction, oxalate → squarate/SiF6/SO4 pillar swap, Zn → Co/Ni/Mg
candidates.risks: Flexibility; PLD below our gate; well-trodden ground (three independent groups have already published the substitution series, so the novelty margin for us is thin).

candidates.name: CALF-20M-w / CALF-20M-e / NU-220 (methyl-triazolate CALF-20 analogues)
candidates.family: Zn-methyltriazolate/oxalate — MTV substitution on CALF-20
candidates.topology: CALF-20-related layered-pillared nets; three distinct new phases reported
candidates.linkers: 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazolate (SMILES: Cc1ncn[nH]1) + oxalate; 'w' and 'e' denote two different methyl orientations relative to the pore
candidates.pore_metrics: Not extracted [미확인] — paper is paywalled (only the abstract was accessible)
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: Both CALF-20M-w and CALF-20M-e retain OVER 20 % of their initial CO2 capture efficiency at 70 % RH, a threshold at which CALF-20 shows negligible CO2 uptake (abstract, 10.1021/jacs.3c11671). The Chem. Sci. 2026 perspective restates this as ~20 % retention at 80 % RH (10.1039/d6sc03678c §2.1). Mechanism claimed: methyls sterically frustrate the water H-bond network and push water away from the Zn-N bonds
candidates.water_isotherm: Implied (RH-resolved CO2 capacity measured); explicit isotherm shape not confirmed [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized (Farha/Snurr, Northwestern, 2024)
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for rigid GCMC — same chemistry class as CALF-20, no OMS/chemisorption. Same flexibility caveat.
candidates.mtv_headroom: This IS the MTV axis: methyl coverage fraction 0/25/50/75/100 % on the triazolate, and the 'w' vs 'e' orientation is a site-arrangement degree of freedom — the exact realization-ensemble problem our repo already quantifies (batch scatter 8.7×statistical σ). A same-composition/different-arrangement pair (w vs e) that the ORIGINAL AUTHORS report as physically distinct is an external check on our '배치 단위' ruler.
candidates.risks: 20 % retention at 70-80 % RH is still a large loss — it clears 'better than CALF-20' but is far from our 80 % retention gate (HANDOVER.md §6-1). Priority claim is already taken by Northwestern.

candidates.name: CALF20-SiF6-met-w
candidates.family: Hypothetical anion-pillar-substituted CALF-20 (computational design only)
candidates.topology: CALF-20 topology with the oxalate pillar replaced by SiF6^2-
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인] — in the paywalled body
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: SIMULATION ONLY: theoretically maintains CO2 uptake efficiency above 92.4 % across the ENTIRE relative-humidity range, outperforming the template MOF and benchmark materials; TVSA process simulation gives a better productivity/energy trade-off than CALF-20 owing to higher working capacity and lower H2O uptake (abstract, 10.1021/acs.chemmater.5c01848). 18 hypothetical MOFs were designed by combining SiF6^2-/SO4^2- pillars with CALF20, CALF20-met-w, CALF20-met-e templates
candidates.water_isotherm: Simulated only [요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: NOT SYNTHESIZED — hypothetical. Its two ingredients (methyltriazolate CALF-20 and SiF6-pillared Zn azolates) are each independently known, so it is a plausible synthesis target
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — this is exactly our kind of object (built in silico, rigid, DDEC6-chargeable). Reproducing/extending it with OUR water force field (TIP5P-Ew, post-2026-09-06 fix) rather than theirs is a defensible independent test, because the repo already showed old/new water K_H ratios of 1.7-14.4× from a two-line force-field change.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Two orthogonal axes already defined by the authors: pillar identity (oxalate/SiF6/SO4) × methyl position (none/w/e). Adding fractional pillar mixing (MTV on the ANION, not the linker) is unexplored and is a genuinely new idea for us.
candidates.risks: (1) Purely computational — no experimental anchor at all. (2) '>92.4 % across the entire RH range' is a simulated number with someone else's water model; our own repo's WATER_FIX experience says such numbers move by up to 14× when the water force field changes. Do not quote it as measured. (3) Registered-conflict check needed against the existing GME-alternative forks.

candidates.name: SquCALF-20 (squarate-linked CALF-20)
candidates.family: Hypothetical isoreticular CALF-20 series (computational)
candidates.topology: CALF-20 topology, oxalate replaced by squarate
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 3.6 mmol/g at 0.15 bar (dry), vs pristine CALF-20's 2.6 (10.1021/acsaenm.3c00622)
candidates.humid_evidence: Maintains a high level of CO2 capture performance in the presence of humidity, BUT starts to adsorb H2O at LOWER relative humidity than CALF-20 (abstract, 10.1021/acsaenm.3c00622). RH values not extracted [미확인]
candidates.water_isotherm: Simulated; onset shifted to lower RH than CALF-20
candidates.synthesis_status: NOT SYNTHESIZED; authors argue squaric acid is a semiconductor-industry feedstock and squarate MOFs are chemically robust, so it is cheap and plausible
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — in-silico linker substitution on a rigid framework, identical workflow to ours
candidates.mtv_headroom: Squarate/oxalate fractional mixing on the pillar site; combined with triazolate methylation gives a 2D composition grid
candidates.risks: Same as CALF20-SiF6-met-w: purely computational, someone else's water model, and CALF-20's PLD problem probably carries over.

candidates.name: MUF-16 (Massey University Framework 16)
candidates.family: Hydrogen-bonded microporous coordination polymer, aminoisophthalate
candidates.metal: Co(II) (original); Mn(II) and Ni(II) isostructural analogues exist and are made from the same recipe
candidates.pore_metrics: Ultramicroporous; explicit PLD/LCD not extracted [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: ≈2 mmol/g at 30 °C and 100 kPa pure CO2 (10.1021/acsami.5c16139). Value at 0.15 bar not stated [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH + ISOTHERM. Georgia Tech/ORNL 2025: feed 14 % CO2 / 2 % He / 84 % N2 at 70 % RH and 30 °C over a dry bed — water breaks through after >20 min while CO2/N2/He break through in <1 min, i.e. NO competitive displacement of CO2 by water at flue-gas RH. Qst(CO2) ≈ 36 kJ/mol, Qst(H2O) ≈ 54-56 kJ/mol — both at the LOW end for this material class. Qazvini et al. previously showed >100 humid breakthrough cycles. Caveat stated by the authors themselves: the binding-affinity ORDER is still H2O > CO2 > N2 at flue-gas humidity
candidates.water_isotherm: YES — gravimetric H2O isotherms at 30/45/60 °C over 5-70 % RH, with desorption branch (10.1021/acsami.5c16139, Fig. 1b)
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized, from cheap commodity reagents (cobalt(II) acetate + 5-aminoisophthalic acid in methanol/water), scalable, regenerable at room temperature
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for rigid GCMC/UFF_MOF/DDEC6/TIP5P-Ew. No OMS, no amine chemisorption (the -NH2 is an aromatic amine on the ring, NOT an aliphatic amine — it does NOT form carbamate, so this is genuine physisorption). Co and Mn are in UFF. The H-bonded (rather than fully coordinated) connectivity means audit_orphans.py's 'connected components = 1' check may flag it spuriously — check before rejecting.
candidates.mtv_headroom: BEST-IN-LIST for us, and it is the direct non-ZIF analogue of our saIm line: the isophthalate 5-position carries -NH2, and the same synthesis accepts 5-nitro-, 5-methyl-, 5-hydroxy-, 5-sulfo-, 5-H isophthalic acid. That is exactly our 'fraction of substituted sites + arrangement ensemble' problem transplanted onto a framework where the water-competition literature is already positive. Metal axis Co/Mn/Ni gives a second orthogonal knob.
candidates.risks: (1) Modest absolute capacity (~2 mmol/g at 1 bar). (2) Water is still the more strongly bound species — the SMB process paper's whole point is engineering AROUND that, not eliminating it; do not report MUF-16 as 'hydrophobic'. (3) Repo digest lists MUF-16 Qst as '32·37' — the 2025 measurement gives 36 kJ/mol; reconcile before citing.

candidates.name: ZnF(daTz) / amino-triazolate metal-azolate frameworks (MAF family, Zhang Y.-B. group)
candidates.family: Metal-triazolate framework (MAF) with appended amino groups
candidates.topology: Channel-type framework; the paper reports a series [미확인 for individual net symbols]
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — paywalled body; abstract gives selectivities only
candidates.humid_evidence: CO2/N2 thermodynamic adsorption selectivity up to 120 AND CO2/H2O KINETIC adsorption selectivity up to 70. Key structural claim: CO2 and H2O occupy SPATIALLY SEPARATED sites — CO2 at the channel centre, H2O at the channel corner. Pre-adsorbed water raises Qst(CO2) by 25-30 % versus the dry framework by electrostatically polarizing the triazolate rings, i.e. water HELPS rather than competes. Exceptional chemical stability to aqueous, acidic and basic conditions; 'high CO2 capture utility under humid conditions and decent cycling performance for mimic flue gas'
candidates.water_isotherm: Not confirmed [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized (JACS 2020)
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for equilibrium rigid GCMC. BUT the headline claim is a KINETIC selectivity (70) and a water-polarization effect on Qst — neither is accessible to equilibrium GCMC. We could reproduce the site segregation (CO2 centre / H2O corner) from our density grids, which is a genuinely checkable prediction with the VTK density-profile machinery already in 21_ZIF69_MTV/density_v3/.
candidates.mtv_headroom: High: amino count per triazolate (0/1/2), and the closely related Zn2(daTz)2SO4 sulfate-pillared MAF series (10.1002/anie.202512425) is EXPLICITLY an MTV study — mixing an asymmetric non-amino linker into the daTz framework suppresses flexibility and raises CO2 selectivity over light hydrocarbons. That paper is the closest published precedent to what our project does, on a completely different framework.
candidates.risks: (1) The winning mechanism (kinetic selectivity, water-induced polarization) sits outside equilibrium rigid GCMC — we would be measuring a different quantity than the one that made this material famous. (2) The MTV sulfate-pillared analogue is explicitly FLEXIBLE (triazolate rotation + reversible Zn-O rearrangement). (3) Numbers behind '25-30 % Qst increase' not read at full text.

candidates.name: Al-PMOF (Al2(OH)2TCPP)
candidates.family: Al(III) 1D-rod / tetratopic carboxylate, 'adsorbaphore' design target from Boyd et al. Nature 2019
candidates.metal: Al(III) (1D chains of Al-OH octahedra, NO open metal sites)
candidates.pore_metrics: Design target is the A1 adsorbaphore: two PARALLEL AROMATIC RINGS at 6.5-7.0 Å interatomic spacing (31 % of the 106,680 optimal CO2 binding sites found in 8,325 top hypothetical MOFs). Explicit PLD/LCD not given in the accessible manuscript [미확인]. BET 1400 m2/g (hydrothermal), 1024-1226 m2/g (microwave)
candidates.co2_015bar: Not extracted — the CO2/N2 isotherms in Fig. 4a are at 313 K and the numeric values sit in Extended Data behind the Nature paywall [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH: CO2/N2 mixture, dry vs humid — Al-PMOF's capture capacity is MINIMALLY influenced by humidity, and in wet flue gas it OUTPERFORMS zeolite 13X and activated carbon, both of which lose significant capacity when wet. UiO-66-NH2 also degrades when wet. Repeated cycling causes no degradation. 13C CP-MAS NMR as a function of RH shows the adsorbaphore carbons see no change in chemical environment until the very highest water loadings, and the 13C shift of adsorbed 13CO2 is INDEPENDENT of water content — i.e. CO2 in the adsorbaphore is insulated from water. Simulation-side: ~75 % of the 35 isoreticular frz materials keep their CO2/N2 selectivity unchanged by water at flue-gas conditions; the hypothetical analogue m8o67 (= Al-PyrMOF) resists H2O flooding to ~85 % RH while m8o71 loses ALL CO2 capacity by 60 % RH — same adsorbaphore, different pore shape
candidates.water_isotherm: Not reported in the accessible manuscript [미확인]; DFT binding energies give CO2 -10.2 kcal/mol, preferred over N2 by 2.7 and over H2O by 1.5 kcal/mol
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized and water-stable (no crystallinity loss after 7 days immersion in water). Microwave route optimized by genetic algorithm: 50 min at 190 °C / 250 W, ~80 % yield (10.1038/s42004-022-00785-2). Originally Fateeva et al. 2012
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES, cleanly. Al(III) carboxylate rods = no OMS, no chemisorption, rigid, non-breathing (explicitly stated for the In analogue). UFF has Al. Large unit cell → 2×2×2 supercell will be expensive; check Zeo++ 9.5 GB/job budget before queueing (CLAUDE.md §5).
candidates.mtv_headroom: Two-level: (i) porphyrin metalation — Al-PMOF(M) with M = Ni, Cu, Zn, Co, Fe is routine (10.1021/acsami.6c07492, 10.1002/smll.202402779), giving a metal-site MTV axis inside the linker rather than at the node; (ii) linker mixing TCPP/TBAPy in the SAME frz net (Al-PMOF and Al-PyrMOF are isoreticular) — a true MTV pair whose end members have OPPOSITE humidity responses (flat vs enhanced), which is the most interesting MTV experiment in this whole list; (iii) the 35-member isoreticular library already generated by Boyd et al. is a ready-made candidate set
candidates.risks: (1) The adsorbaphore is a LOW-PRESSURE selectivity design; the authors state plainly 'our materials are not the ones with the highest working capacity'. (2) The 7 Å parallel-ring motif is the opposite of the 3-5 Å ultramicropore motif that the other three screens converge on — the two design rules genuinely disagree, and picking one is a registerable decision, not a fact. (3) All numeric humid values are in paywalled Extended Data.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the accepted manuscript; Extended Data [미확인]

candidates.name: Al-PyrMOF (Al-TBAPy, hypothetical MOF m8o67)
candidates.family: Same frz Al(III)-rod family as Al-PMOF; the 'water-frustrating' member

Simulated as m8o67: only a small effect of H2O on CO2 capacity even at ~85 % RH. Contrast material m8o71, same adsorbaphore, completely loses CO2 capacity by 60 % RH

candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid, no OMS, no chemisorption
candidates.mtv_headroom: Pyrene 1,3,6,8 aryl substitution (F, CF3, CH3, NO2 on the benzoate rings) tunes the H-bond-frustrating spacer directly; TCPP/TBAPy mixed-linker MTV within frz

candidates.name: Fe2(BDP)3 (CSD VICDOC)
candidates.family: Metal-pyrazolate, triangular 1D channels
candidates.pore_metrics: LCD 4.6 Å, helium void fraction 0.45, calculated surface area 1044 m2/g, experimental 1230 m2/g (Table 1, 10.1021/acs.langmuir.6b02803)
candidates.co2_015bar: Ternary-mixture GCMC at 298 K under CO2:N2 = 1:9 with RH fixed at 80 % (pH2O = 3280 Pa): CO2/H2O selectivity 3, CO2/N2 selectivity 188 (highest CO2/N2 of the 15 screened). Henry constants from REPEAT charges: KH(CO2) = 2×10^-3, KH(H2O) = 4.2×10^-5 mol/kg/Pa

Water WINS at low total pressure (pores fill with H2O at 0.1 bar because pH2O 3280 Pa >> pCO2 672 Pa) but CO2 takes over as partial pressures equalize above ~0.4-0.5 bar. This is a clean, honest negative for our 0.15 bar operating point and should be recorded as such
candidates.water_isotherm: Simulated ternary uptake curve only [요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized, well known (Long group), thermally and chemically robust; pyrazolate-Fe bonds are among the most hydrolytically stable in MOF chemistry
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid, no OMS (Fe is fully pyrazolate-coordinated), no chemisorption. Fe in UFF. Note Li et al. used REPEAT charges and TIP4P water; our DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew will not reproduce their numbers exactly and that difference is itself worth registering.

(2) Triangular channels give strong confinement but the material's fame is hexane-isomer separation, so all humid CO2 evidence is computational.

Absolute 0.15 bar loading not tabulated [미확인]; the authors note ZERQOE adsorbs LESS CO2 than PARMIG and HAWZEM

candidates.water_isotherm: Simulated only [요지]; SBMOF-1 is widely reported as hydrophobic in the Xe/Kr literature
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized, Ca-based (cheapest possible metal), reported by Banerjee/Parise 2012 with permanent porosity and high CO2/N2 selectivity
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid, no OMS, no chemisorption. Ca is in UFF but UFF4MOF coverage for Ca should be checked before the LAMMPS relaxation gate.
candidates.mtv_headroom: The sulfone bridge (-SO2-) can be swapped for -O-, -S-, -CH2-, -C(CF3)2- keeping the same dicarboxylate geometry (oxydibenzoate, thiodibenzoate) — a direct 'acceptor-strength' MTV series testing exactly the hypothesis our saIm line tests, on a framework where the ranking is already #1 for CO2/H2O
candidates.risks: (1) Low capacity (315 m2/g, VF 0.25) — the classic retention/uptake trade-off our repo already found inside ZIF-69 reappears here. (2) All humid evidence is GCMC with REPEAT charges and TIP4P-family water, not measurement; the repo's own WATER_FIX experience says water numbers move a lot with the model. (3) Ca-carboxylate hydrolytic stability in a wet acidic flue gas is unproven for long exposure.

candidates.name: HAWZEM (Cu(II)-isonicotinate, 8-connected bcu net)
candidates.family: Metal-pyridylcarboxylate, small-pore
candidates.pore_metrics: LCD 4.8 Å, helium void fraction 0.47, calculated surface area 951 m2/g (Table 1, 10.1021/acs.langmuir.6b02803)
candidates.co2_015bar: Ternary GCMC 298 K, CO2:N2 = 1:9, RH 80 %: CO2/H2O selectivity 43, CO2/N2 selectivity 53; ranked #3 overall by GCMC and it adsorbs MORE CO2 than the #1 material
candidates.humid_evidence: SIMULATION: of the top three, HAWZEM is the only one that adsorbs NO water at any point in the 0.1-1 bar ternary isotherm — 'HAWZEM is more hydrophobic than ZERQOE and PARMIG'. The authors name PARMIG and HAWZEM (not the #1 ZERQOE) as the better practical choices because they combine selectivity with capacity
candidates.water_isotherm: Simulated only [요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized (Lian & Chen, Inorg. Chem. Commun. 2012, 18, 8-10)
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PROBABLY — but Cu(II) in an 8-connected node may carry an open axial coordination site. If it does, OMS-water coordination is outside our pipeline (CLAUDE.md/MAGI-003 §3) and this candidate cannot receive a compute allocation until the CIF is inspected for a vacant axial site.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Isonicotinate ring substitution (2-, 3-, methyl/amino/nitro-isonicotinate); metal swap Cu → Ni gives IISERP-MOF2 (same ligand, different net) — a rare case where the SAME MTV ligand family spans two independently validated humid candidates
candidates.risks: OMS check required first; humid evidence is simulation only; original structure paper is a short communication with little characterization.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the screening data; [미확인] for the OMS question

candidates.name: IISERP-MOF2 (Ni(4-pyridylcarboxylate)2)
candidates.family: Single-small-ligand ultramicroporous MOF; cubic
candidates.pore_metrics: Two pore sizes, 3.5 and 4.8 Å (10.1126/sciadv.1500421). Kwon et al. place its channel diameter in the 2.6-3.7 Å band with CALF-20, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni and SIFSIX-18-Ni-β
candidates.co2_015bar: Reported for precombustion (10 bar) conditions: CO2/H2 selectivity 285 (20:80) and 230 (40:60) at 10 bar/40 °C, working capacity 3.95 mmol/g. Post-combustion 0.15 bar value [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: (a) Original paper: 'ultra-micropores generated by a small ligand ensure hydrolytic, hydrostatic stabilities, shelf life, and stability toward humid gas streams' — a stability claim, not a co-adsorption measurement. (b) Kwon et al. 2025 list IISERP-MOF2 as one of only four MOFs with experimentally reported CO2 capture ability under humid conditions, and it is the reference material against which the whole P/VSA practical-energy-limit analysis is benchmarked (Pai et al.: within ~20 % to 3 % of the practical energy limit depending on CO2 concentration)
candidates.water_isotherm: Not found [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized; single cheap ligand, simple and 'easily scalable' synthesis, rigid
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid by the authors' own description, single ligand, Ni fully coordinated. Small unit cell = cheap in our 2×2×2 protocol. This is the lowest-cost candidate to run first.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Isonicotinate substitution (2-/3-methyl, amino, nitro, fluoro variants) at fractional occupancy; and the Cu(II) analogue with a different net (HAWZEM) gives a metal/topology cross-check
candidates.risks: (1) All its published performance is PRECOMBUSTION (10 bar, CO2/H2) — using it at 0.15 bar/RH90 is a different test entirely and must be labelled so under MAGI-003 §3. (2) Ni-pyridylcarboxylate: check for open axial Ni sites in the CIF. (3) CO2 self-diffusivity ~3×10^-9 m2/s is a kinetic virtue our equilibrium pipeline cannot score.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] for the material; [전문] for the screening paper

candidates.name: VOFFIVE-3_Fe / VOFFIVE-1-Ni (V-oxyfluoride pillared square grids)
candidates.family: Anion-pillared HUM, vanadium oxyfluoride pillar (VOF5) — the FMOF-screen winner and its experimental cousin
candidates.topology: Square-pillared 3D net (sql layers pillared by VOF5), 1D square channels
candidates.metal: Fe(II/III) in the screened hypothetical; Ni(II) in the synthesized VOFFIVE-1-Ni; V in the pillar
candidates.pore_metrics: VOFFIVE-3_Fe: PLD 3.31 Å, LCD 4.63 Å, porosity 0.20 (Table 1, 10.1021/cbe.4c00111) — note PLD 3.31 Å just clears our 3.3 Å gate
candidates.co2_015bar: VOFFIVE-3_Fe, wet-flue-gas GCMC at 298 K, 1 bar, CO2/N2/H2O = 0.124/0.850/0.026 (pH2O = 2600 Pa ≈ 82 % RH, so pCO2 = 0.124 bar ≈ our 0.15 bar): N(CO2) = 2.52 mmol/g, N(H2O) = 0.13 mmol/g, S(CO2/N2) = 1827, S(CO2/H2O) = 4.07. Experimental VOFFIVE-1-Ni: 2.75 mmol/g CO2 (12.08 wt %) at 293 K and 0.5 bar
candidates.humid_evidence: SIMULATION (mixture GCMC in a genuinely wet ternary at ~82 % RH — the closest published condition to our RH90 registered point) plus first-principles MD: the pyrazine rotates 11° toward the pore centre within 5 ps, shrinking the pore so it accommodates CO2 rather than H2O; PLD is only slightly reduced during FPMD, i.e. the framework stays intact under co-adsorbed CO2/H2O
candidates.water_isotherm: Not measured [미확인]; N(H2O) = 0.13 mmol/g from mixture GCMC
candidates.synthesis_status: VOFFIVE-1-Ni is SYNTHESIZED (Nano Lett. 2024); VOFFIVE-3_Fe is hypothetical. The NbOFFIVE/SIFSIX/TIFSIX synthetic route is well established, so the Fe/V variant is a plausible target
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for the rigid equilibrium part. CAVEAT: the mechanism the authors credit is a 11° pyrazine rotation — a soft-mode flexibility our rigid pipeline erases. A rigid run on the ROTATED (post-FPMD) geometry vs the as-built geometry is a legitimate two-point sensitivity test, and it must be reported as two different tests, not a retry (CLAUDE.md §2).
candidates.mtv_headroom: Three axes: pillar anion (VOF5 / NbOF5 / SiF6 / TiF6 / SnF6), linker (pyrazine / 4,4'-bipyridine / phenanthroline / methylpyrazine — the screen found pyrazine, bipyridine and phenanthroline each at 22 % of the top 19), metal (Cu 53 %, Zn 32 %, V 10 %, Fe/V 5 % among the top 19)
candidates.risks: (1) S(CO2/H2O) is only 4.07 — six of the top 19 exceed 15 and one reaches ~100, so this particular member is not the water champion. (2) V and Nb LJ/UFF4MOF parameters need checking before the relaxation gate. (3) The FMOF screen used 1 bar total pressure, so the CO2 partial pressure 0.124 bar is close to but not identical with our 0.15 bar.

candidates.name: Top-19 hypothetical fluorinated MOFs (hMOF-28016, hMOF-16702, hMOF-28562, hMOF-5033915, hMOF-36835)
candidates.family: Fluorinated hypothetical MOFs (FMOFs) from hMOF + anion-pillared + CoRE databases
candidates.topology: Pillared square grids; PLD 2.75-4.25 Å across the set
candidates.linkers: F- and N-containing cyclic pillars — pyrazine 22 %, bipyridine 22 %, phenanthroline 22 %, azo-linkage 17 % — plus fluorinated organic linkers
candidates.humid_evidence: SIMULATION ONLY, but in the right mixture at the right humidity. Explicit negatives are reported too: hMOF-35835 takes up 10.09 mmol/g of water and has S(CO2/H2O) = 0.05; hMOF-27207 takes 7.54 mmol/g. FPMD (5 ps) shows the frameworks stay intact with co-adsorbed CO2/N2/H2O
candidates.water_isotherm: No; single-point mixture water loadings only
candidates.synthesis_status: NOT SYNTHESIZED — hypothetical database structures
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES in principle (rigid, hypothetical, chargeable). The practical obstacle is obtaining the hMOF CIFs and confirming they pass audit_orphans.py — hypothetical-database structures are exactly the kind that trip orphan-atom and clash checks.
candidates.mtv_headroom: The paper's own design rule IS an MTV rule: 'the POSITION of the F atom, not the amount, controls CO2 capture' — 58 % of the top 19 have F in BOTH the pillar and the linker, and F percentage shows no correlation with performance (their Fig. 7a). That is a directly testable, pre-registerable hypothesis for a fluorinated-MTV series: hold F count fixed, vary F position.
candidates.risks: (1) Hypothetical structures with no synthesis route — MAGI-003 requires a synthesis-status statement, and 'none' is a real cost. (2) Four of the five have PLD 2.75 Å, below our 3.3 Å CO2-kinetic-diameter gate — they would be rejected by our own screen while scoring 3 mmol/g in someone else's GCMC. This PLD-gate-vs-performance conflict must be resolved before T-NF-* is written. (3) Their Qst(H2O) exceeds 42 kJ/mol in many top FMOFs at mixture loadings because of cooperative water-water interaction — the same effect our repo's regen_energy scripts currently omit.

candidates.name: Ni-TM-DMOF (Ni(tetramethyl-BDC)(dabco)0.5 family)
candidates.family: DMOF / pillared-layer M(BDC)(dabco) with methylated linker
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 5.0 mmol/g at 273 K and 1 bar (best member). 0.15 bar / 298 K value [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH: negligible performance loss under 80 % RH — the highest RH at which any SYNTHESIZED candidate in this list is reported to hold up, and the closest to our registered RH90 point (10.1016/j.micromeso.2025.113559, as summarized in 10.1039/d6sc03678c §2.1)
candidates.water_isotherm: [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized; DMOF-1 chemistry is standard, cheap and scalable
candidates.pipeline_modelable: MOSTLY YES — rigid GCMC standard for DMOFs, no chemisorption. BUT DMOF-1 analogues are notoriously breathing/gate-opening under guest loading, and the Zn version is water-UNSTABLE (that is why the paper tunes the metal to Ni). Flexibility is a genuine risk here.
candidates.mtv_headroom: BEST-STRUCTURED MTV AXIS IN THE LIST, and it is a two-dimensional grid the authors themselves used: metal (Zn↔Ni, continuous solid solution) × ligand methylation degree (BDC / 2-Me / 2,5-Me2 / TM-BDC). This maps one-to-one onto our composition×arrangement ensemble design and would let us re-run our whole 'is composition or arrangement bigger?' analysis on a non-ZIF framework.
candidates.risks: (1) Only abstract-level and secondary-source evidence obtained; the primary numbers were not read at full text. (2) DMOF flexibility/breathing. (3) DABCO pillar is amine-like but tertiary and coordinated — it does NOT chemisorb CO2, but a reviewer will ask.

candidates.name: CoMOF_new (Co-trz2An)
candidates.family: Metal-triazolate-anilate (anilate/quinone + triazolyl), ultramicroporous
candidates.pore_metrics: Narrow pore size distribution centred at 3.6 Å; the optimized synthesis raises accessible surface area by 50 % by removing Co(OH)2 impurity
candidates.co2_015bar: Static: 5.0 mmol/g at 0 °C and 4.2 mmol/g at 30 °C, 1 bar pure CO2 (≈1.39-1.66 CO2 per formula unit). Dynamic at flue-gas-like composition, 30 °C: 10 % CO2/N2 gives 0.71 mmol/g DRY; 5 % CO2/N2 gives 0.32 mmol/g DRY. IAST CO2/N2 selectivity ≈ 75 at 1 bar
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH at 33 % RH, 30 °C (33 % was the maximum RH their rig could reach — NOT our RH90). CO2 uptake INCREASES with humidity: 10 % CO2 goes 0.71 → 1.17 mmol/g (+65 %); 5 % CO2 goes 0.32 → 0.66 mmol/g (+106 %). Stable over 15 cycles with mild N2 regeneration. Mechanism claimed: transient pore opening from guest-induced linker flexibility. The authors' own comparison table: MgCUK-1 3.0 → 3.3 mmol/g (+10 %) and a CuMOF 1.63 → 1.78 mmol/g are the only other water-enhanced cases they cite
candidates.water_isotherm: YES — total water uptake 15 mmol/g at 90 % RH, with a steep rise above that from external condensation; 7 mmol/g at 33 % RH (≈2 H2O per Co node)
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized 2026; the paper's contribution is a purification protocol that removes Co(OH)2 and unlocks the ultramicroporosity
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO, not for the effect that matters. The +65 % humid enhancement is explicitly attributed to guest-induced linker flexibility opening transient pores — a rigid framework will never show it, and a rigid run would report the dry number and call it the wet number. Model only as a dry-baseline reference.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Anilate core substitution (Cl2An, Br2An, H2An, NO2 variants are a large established family) × triazolyl vs pyrazolyl vs tetrazolyl arms × metal (Co/Mn/Fe/Zn/Cd all known for anilates)
candidates.risks: (1) 15 mmol/g of water at 90 % RH is 20× our 0.75 mmol/g registered water gate — at RH90 this material is a water sponge, and the +65 % result is at 33 % RH only. (2) Flexibility puts the winning mechanism outside our pipeline. Include as a documented 'model-impossible' candidate under MAGI-003 §3.

candidates.name: NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (KAUST-7) and TIFSIX-3-Ni / SIFSIX-3-Ni
candidates.family: Anion-pillared HUMs — included as REGISTERED NEGATIVE CONTROLS for the humid axis
candidates.pore_metrics: Contracted square channels bringing F centres into close proximity; NbOFFIVE-1-Ni is the tightest of the series [미확인 for exact PLD]
candidates.co2_015bar: NbOFFIVE-1-Ni: 1.3 mmol/g at 400 ppm and 51.4 cm3(STP)/cm3 volumetric — the highest of any physisorbent at 400 ppm; 2.3 mmol/g at 10000 ppm; Qst 54 kJ/mol. TIFSIX-3-Ni: 1.7 mmol/g at 1000 ppm, Qst 50. SIFSIX-3-Ni: 0.7 at 1000 ppm, Qst 45 (Table 1, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171)
candidates.humid_evidence: NEGATIVE AND WELL MEASURED: at 95 % RH the water uptake is NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 10.09 mmol/g, SIFSIX-3-Ni 8.80, TIFSIX-3-Ni 7.46 — versus SIFSIX-18-Ni-β 1.64 and ZIF-8 1.44. NbOFFIVE-1-Ni's S(CO2/H2O) at 500 ppm / 74 % RH is 0.03 (i.e. it prefers water 30:1). For SIFSIX-3-Ni and TIFSIX-3-Ni IAST could not even be computed because of NEGATIVE adsorption caused by a water-induced phase change. This is the cleanest published statement of the retention/affinity trade-off that our repo found inside ZIF-69
candidates.water_isotherm: YES — DVS at 298 K up to 95 % RH for all of them
candidates.synthesis_status: All synthesized and widely reproduced
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for the dry side. The water-induced phase change in SIFSIX-3-Ni/TIFSIX-3-Ni is outside a rigid pipeline. Their value to us is as EXTERNAL CALIBRATION: they are three materials with published 95 % RH water uptakes spanning 7.5-10.1 mmol/g and a fourth (SIFSIX-18-Ni-β) at 1.6 — a four-point ladder we can try to reproduce with our corrected TIP5P-Ew force field. The repo currently records ZERO external benchmarks on the humid axis; this ladder would be the first.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Pillar identity is itself the variable (SiF6/TiF6/NbOF5/GeF6/SnF6) and the pyrazine can be methylated — but as controls we would keep them unsubstituted
candidates.risks: As candidates they FAIL: high Qst (50-54 kJ/mol, above the 29.8-41 benchmark band) plus 7-10 mmol/g water at 95 % RH. Their value is as a force-field validation set, and that use must be registered as a validation test, not a candidate screen.

candidates.family: Simplest possible carboxylate MOF; molecular-sieving CO2/N2 separator
candidates.pore_metrics: Size-selective aperture that discriminates on the small kinetic-diameter difference between CO2 (3.3 Å) and N2 (3.64 Å); exact PLD not extracted [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — the abstract reports 'excellent CO2 adsorption capacities and outstanding CO2/N2 selectivity' without numbers in the accessible text

Stable to SO2 and NO, readily pelletized, simple to regenerate — but the paper does not claim wet-gas operation. Record it as a candidate whose humid behaviour is UNMEASURED, not as a humid winner
candidates.water_isotherm: Not found [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized inexpensively from commodity chemicals; scalable and pelletized — by far the cheapest framework in this list
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — rigid, Al carboxylate, no OMS, tiny unit cell, cheapest possible GCMC. An ideal pipeline shake-down structure.
candidates.mtv_headroom: LOW — formate has one substitutable H. Mixed formate/acetate or formate/fluoroformate would change the topology, not decorate it. This is the one candidate with essentially NO MTV headroom, which makes it a useful control for the question 'does MTV headroom actually buy anything?'

result.notes:
FOUR INDEPENDENT SCREENS, ONE DESCRIPTOR — AND ONE THAT DISAGREES.
(1) Kwon/Woo, ACS Cent. Sci. 2025 (10.1021/acscentsci.5c00777, [전문]): 55,818 experimental MOFs → ~19k GCMC → 2,758/2,311/8,118 within 4 % of the P/VSA practical energy limit at 6/15/35 % CO2 dry → multicomponent GCMC at 40 % RH keeps 206/128/543. Of the 117 unique top-50 structures, 48 (41 %) are 'narrow, straight 1D channels' averaging 4.8 Å. Their humid filter is a ready-made pre-registerable threshold pair: EXCLUDE if wet/dry CO2 uptake ratio < 0.9 at 40 % RH, or if CO2/H2O uptake ratio < 1. Note this is 40 % RH, not our 90 %.
(2) Palakkal/Jiang, Chem. Bio. Eng. 2024 (10.1021/cbe.4c00111, [전문]): 5,061 fluorinated MOFs → top 19 by a capacity×selectivity trade-off; PLD 2.75-4.25 Å, porosity 0.2-0.3. Design rule: F POSITION not F amount; N-containing CYCLIC pillars (pyrazine/bipyridine/phenanthroline, 22 % each) beat azo (17 %).
(3) Li/Chung/Snurr, Langmuir 2016 (10.1021/acs.langmuir.6b02803, [전문]): 2,927 CoRE MOFs by KH(CO2)/KH(H2O) → top 15 → ternary GCMC at RH 80 %. Rule: LCD < 10 Å is selective (S > 100), LCD > 10 Å is not; winners have LCD 4.5-5.7 Å and LOW void fraction. Spearman ρ(KH ranking, GCMC ranking) = 0.61; ρ(EQeq, REPEAT) = 0.76. One of the 15 (IWELOM) is a false positive that prefers water (S_GCMC = 0.04) — a 1-in-15 false-positive rate for a Henry-ratio prescreen, which is directly relevant to our own Widom-based prescreens.
(4) Boyd/Smit, Nature 2019 ([전문]): 325,000 hypothetical MOFs → 8,325 with WC > 2 mmol/g and CO2/N2 > 50 → 106,680 binding sites → three adsorbaphore classes: A1 two parallel aromatic rings at ~7 Å (31 %), A2 metal-oxygen-metal bridges (32 %), A3 open metal sites (21 %). A1 has LOW water Henry coefficient; A2 and A3 have HIGH.
CONVERGENCE: (1),(2),(3) all land on ultramicropores 2.6-4.8 Å, hydrophobic decoration (methyl or fluorine), no open metal sites, and type V/VII water isotherms. (4) DISAGREES: it prescribes a 7 Å slit between aromatic rings, which is roughly twice the other rule. The two rules are not reconcilable by averaging — they are two different mechanisms (confinement vs. H-bond-network frustration), and choosing which to pursue is a registerable decision (MAGI-003 §6 / T-NF-*), not a fact to be summarized away. Boyd's A3 result also independently confirms the repo's own conclusion that open metal sites are a water liability.

THREE COLLISIONS WITH OUR OWN GATES THAT MUST BE SETTLED BEFORE T-NF-* IS WRITTEN.
(a) PLD 3.3 Å. Our shadow gate (V5_RULERS_20260824.md §2, /home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/risk_screen.py:113-117) becomes formal 'from the next generation of structures' — and new frameworks ARE that generation. But CALF-20, the only MOF commercialised for this exact duty, has PLD ≈ 3.0 Å (10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0), and four of the five best hypothetical FMOFs have PLD 2.75 Å with 2.0-3.0 mmol/g CO2 in a wet mixture. The gate as written would reject the world's best answer. Either the gate is wrong for ultramicroporous sorbents (because CO2 enters kinetically through a soft aperture, which our rigid as-built PLD cannot see) or those materials are wrong. Do not quietly apply the gate; register the conflict.
(b) Water gate 0.75 mmol/g at RH90. Almost nothing published clears it: SIFSIX-18-Ni-β 1.64 (vacuum DVS) / 0.96 (ambient) at 95 % RH is the best measured value in this entire survey and it still misses. ZIF-8 is 1.44-2.6. Everything else is 7-19 mmol/g. If our gate stands unchanged, the honest prediction is that NO candidate passes — which is itself a poster-grade result, but it should be stated in advance rather than discovered.
(c) 'Humid' is four different quantities. Equilibrium ternary GCMC at RH 80 % (Li 2016), mixture GCMC at ~82 % RH (Palakkal 2024), multicomponent GCMC at 40 % RH (Kwon 2025), and fixed-bed BREAKTHROUGH at 33-74 % RH (SIFSIX-18, MUF-16, Co-trz2An, Al-PMOF, Ni-TM-DMOF). MAGI-003 §3 already forbids mixing these. Every humid number above is labelled with its kind; none of the breakthrough numbers may be compared to our RH90 equilibrium TSA working capacity.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY NEW FOR US, RANKED BY (evidence × modelability × MTV headroom).
TIER A — run first, cheap, rigid, real MTV ladder, humid literature already positive:
 · MUF-16 [Co(5-aminoisophthalate)2]. The 5-position substituent IS our saIm variable transplanted onto a framework where 70 % RH breakthrough shows no CO2 displacement and Qst(CO2) 36 / Qst(H2O) 54-56 kJ/mol are measured. Metal axis Co/Mn/Ni is a free second dimension. No OMS, no aliphatic amine, so genuine physisorption.
 · MCIF-1 [Cu2(4,5-dicyanoimidazolate)2]. Stays inside imidazolate chemistry we already build, changes metal (Cu(I)) and topology, adds nitrile acceptor sites, survives water 1 week and pH 0-13.5, room-temperature scalable synthesis, and was independently nominated by the 2025 wet-flue-gas screen. Almost no adsorption data exists — we would produce the first numbers, which is the strongest novelty position in this list.
 · IISERP-MOF2 Ni(4-pyridylcarboxylate)2. Smallest unit cell, single cheap ligand, explicitly rigid, benchmark for the practical-energy-limit analysis. Cheapest possible first run. Its Cu(II)/bcu cousin HAWZEM is the #3 hydrophobic hit of the 2016 CoRE screen — same ligand family, two nets, one MTV ladder.
TIER B — highest MTV information content, but flexibility risk:
 · SIFSIX-18-Ni-β (tetramethylbipyrazolate + SiF6): four methyl sites × pillar swap × metal swap, and the only measured material that combines strong CO2 affinity with ZIF-8-level water uptake. Phase transition under water is the catch.
 · Al-PMOF / Al-PyrMOF isoreticular pair in frz: the two end members have OPPOSITE humidity responses (flat vs enhanced) with the SAME adsorbaphore. A mixed TCPP/TBAPy MTV series across that pair is the single most interesting unrun experiment I found, and it is fully rigid-modelable.
 · Ni-TM-DMOF: a published 2D grid of metal (Zn→Ni) × methylation degree with negligible loss at 80 % RH — the closest external analogue of our composition×arrangement study, on a non-ZIF framework.
TIER C — model-impossible or already-taken, list but do not allocate compute:
 · Co-trz2An (+65 % CO2 under humidity, but the mechanism is guest-induced linker flexibility and it holds 15 mmol/g water at 90 % RH); FJI-H46 (3.92 mmol/g at 100 % RH, 97.8 % retention — flexible, 10.1021/jacs.5c20653); ZnF(daTz) (its selling point is a KINETIC selectivity of 70, which equilibrium GCMC cannot measure); CALF-20M (Northwestern has priority); all amine/amino-acid/ionic-liquid composites.

CORRECTIONS AND CAUTIONS FOR THE REPO DIGEST.
· MUF-16 is [Co(Haip)2] with 5-aminoisophthalic acid, not Mn; the digest's 'MUF-16 32·37' Qst should be checked against the 2025 measurement of 36 kJ/mol (CO2) and 54-56 (H2O) (10.1021/acsami.5c16139).
· The Moghadam water KH threshold problem generalizes: EVERY external water number in this survey was produced with TIP4P-family water (Li 2016 explicitly; the CALF-20 Nat. Commun. work explicitly; Kwon 2025 and Palakkal 2024 by inheritance). Our TIP5P-Ew with the 2026-09-06 Hw/Lw none fix will not reproduce them, and the repo already measured old/new KH ratios of 1.7-14.4×. Before ANY new-framework water number is quoted against literature, reproduce one published water uptake (the four-point ladder SIFSIX-18-Ni-β 1.64 / TIFSIX-3-Ni 7.46 / SIFSIX-3-Ni 8.80 / NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 10.09 mmol/g at 95 % RH, all from one paper and one apparatus, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171) and report the ratio. That would give the repo its FIRST external benchmark on the humid axis, which it currently records as zero.
· Li/Chung/Snurr found EQeq systematically UNDERESTIMATES the water-MOF interaction, hence overestimates CO2/H2O selectivity, while CO2 and N2 KH are barely affected. Our chain went EQeq → PACMAN DDEC6 for the same reason; this is external confirmation that the switch mattered specifically for water, not for CO2.
· Boyd's A3 finding (open metal sites → high water Henry coefficient) independently corroborates the repo's decision to abandon the OMS route, for a different reason than density.
· Our own 8.7×-statistical-σ arrangement-scatter result has an external echo: CALF-20M-w vs CALF-20M-e are the SAME composition with different methyl orientation and the authors report them as physically distinct materials. That pair is an external, experimental test of whether arrangement beats composition.
· Adjacent but out of scope (no metal, so not listed as candidates): Nature Chem. 2025, Liu et al., 'Bottom-up computational design of shape-selective organic macrocycles for humid CO2 capture' (10.1038/s41557-025-01873-1, News&Views 10.1038/s41557-025-01914-9), and JACS 2025 'Selective CO2 Adsorption in Ultrahydrophobic Molecular Pyrene Frameworks by Computational Design' (10.1021/jacs.5c06861, open access, PMC12232307) — both are DFT+CSP-designed hydrophobic hosts validated by humid breakthrough, i.e. the same design loop we run, on non-MOF hosts. Worth reading for method, not as candidates.
· One more MTV precedent worth reading in full before we write T-NF-*: Angew. 2025 'Multivariate Sulfate-Pillared Metal Azolate Frameworks with Tunable Flexibility for CO2 Capture' (10.1002/anie.202512425) — Zn2(daTz)2SO4 with a mixed asymmetric non-amino linker that LOCKS the framework by removing intraframework H-bonding. It is the closest published thing to our project's method, applied to a completely different framework, and it reports flexibility as a tunable MTV output rather than a nuisance.

REGISTRATION-CONFLICT CHECK (MAGI-003 §3). None of the Tier A/B candidates collides with the already-registered GME-external forks (ZIF-2 crb, ZIF-77 frl, npo ZIF-1001) or the GME-internal alternatives (azbIm, non-polar iso-LCD, b2-aryl slit). MCIF-1 is the closest — it is an imidazolate, but Cu(I), a different net, and a different substituent class, so it is a new fork rather than a duplicate. All numeric claims above carry a DOI or a URL that was actually opened; anything I could not open is marked [미확인] and listed in not_found.

candidates.name: CALF-20 (Calgary Framework 20)
candidates.family: Zn triazolate–oxalate pillared layer ("CALF/dtz-CALF" family)
candidates.topology: dmc (SingleNode simplification; triazolate = 3-c node, oxalate = straight-through pillar)
candidates.linkers: 1,2,4-triazolate (C1=NC=NN1, H-form CAS 288-88-0) + oxalate (C(=O)(C(=O)O)O, CAS 144-62-7); ratio Zn:trz:ox = 2:2:1
candidates.pore_metrics: LCD ca. 4.3 Å, PLD ca. 3.0 Å (Zeo++-type calc on published CIF); BET 550 m2/g [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0, 전문]
candidates.co2_015bar: Simulated/experimental at 0.10–0.15 atm: 1.9 mmol/g @323 K, 1.3 @343 K, 3.3 @273 K (298 K NOT stated) [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0, 전문]. Shaped extrudate: 2.15 mmol/g @313 K, 0.15 bar; VPSA working capacity 1.51 mmol/g stable over 50 cycles [10.1016/j.cej.2025.171623, 요지]. Dry ZLC anchor 2.0 mmol/g @0.1 bar/311 K [repo 21_ZIF69_MTV/CALF20_ANCHOR_20260829.md, 전문·로컬]. WARNING: the widely quoted "dry 2.6 mmol/g @0.15 bar" is NOT in Science 2021 — unsourced [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-1.1]
candidates.humid_evidence: EQUILIBRIUM (binderless granules, 30 °C, 0.95 bar PURE CO2, microscale dynamic column breakthrough, desorption basis): RH0 3.51 / RH10 3.10 / RH20 2.92 / RH25 2.71 / RH50 2.10 / RH75 0.42 / RH90 0.22 mmol/g → retention RH50 59.8 %, RH75 12.0 %, RH90 6.3 % [10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772 Table 2, via repo 21_ZIF69_MTV/CALF20_ANCHOR_20260829.md §V-2, 전문·로컬]. Science 2021 competitive CO2 (20 % polysulfone monolith, gravimetric-breakthrough difference): unaffected ≤30 % RH, "negligible at RH > 80 %" [10.1126/science.abi7281, 전문·L2 via repo]. PROCESS (VSA demo): purity/recovery 95 %/71 % and 92 %/81 % at RH 13–45 %; test points 13/25/45/70 — NO RH90 point [10.1007/s10450-025-00600-z, 전문 via repo]. The often-cited "retains performance to ~40 % RH" is a COMPARISON sentence against CAU-10/Al-fumarate in the Science abstract, not a retention limit [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-1.1 ㉢]
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes. Type V / S-shaped, hydrophobic branch then step; inflection below 20 % RH, saturation ca. 11 mmol/g at 293 K [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0, 전문]. Under CO2 the water inflection shifts 17 → ca. 60 % RH [10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772, 요지 + repo]. Humidity drives a reversible α→β polymorph transition (PXRD change already at 20 % RH) [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0; 10.1021/acsmaterialslett.3c00930, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercial. Water/methanol solvents, low-cost commodity reagents, single-step; Svante reported single-step COMMERCIAL synthesis feeding a TSA unit removing up to 1 tonne CO2/day from cement flue gas [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0 (citing its ref 21), 전문]. Microwave-assisted route: 12× shorter reaction, 97 % yield, ~20 % higher CO2 capacity [10.1021/acs.inorgchem.4c04727, 요지]. Kilogram-level extrudates: material cost cut by 2/3, preparation time cut >95 % [10.1016/j.cej.2025.171623, 요지]. Durability >450,000 STEAM TREATMENTS (not adsorption cycles; CO2 capacity measured at a single end-point) [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-1.1; restated as ">450 000 cycles under steam and wet acid gases" in 10.1021/acs.inorgchem.4c04727, 요지]
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PARTIAL. Rigid-framework GCMC is what the Nat Commun team themselves used and it reproduces dry CO2 well [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0]. BUT the humid collapse mechanism is a guest-induced α→β structural phase transition (water coordinating Zn, open-pore→closed-pore) which a frozen framework CANNOT see. Our UFF_MOF + García-Sánchez CO2 + TIP5P-Ew + DDEC6 stack will therefore OVER-predict RH90 retention for CALF-20 and for anything like it. This is already registered as a risk against our own numbers [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-3b]. Also: PLD ca. 3.0 Å is BELOW our registered PLD ≥ 3.3 Å gate — CALF-20 would be rejected by our own gate before it was ever measured.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Substantial and already exercised. (a) triazolate → 3,5-diamino-1,2,4-triazolate: (dtz)CALF-20, mechanochemical room-temperature ball milling, STY 4600 kg m-3 d-1, 98 % yield, 1.40 mmol/g at 5000 ppm CO2, CO2/N2 936 in breakthrough, pelletized with sodium alginate retaining 95 % capacity [10.1021/acs.iecr.6c01754, 요지]. (b) same composition, different connectivity: IISERP-MOF36 Zn-diaminotriazolate-oxalate is NONlayered-pillared, higher low-pressure CO2 than CALF-20 but LESS hydrophobic [10.1021/acs.chemmater.4c03231, 요지]. (c) oxalate → squarate (SquCALF-20) was computationally predicted to give 3.6 mmol/g at 0.15 bar and CO2/N2 500 [10.1021/acsaenm.3c00622, 요지] — but the synthesis FAILED; a synthetic screen produced only two NONPOROUS coordination polymers (UdP-40, UdP-41) at the same 2:2:1 stoichiometry [10.1021/acs.cgd.6c00193, 요지]. Substitution positions available: triazolate C3/C5 (NH2, CH3, CF3, SH, NO2), pillar dicarboxylate identity.
candidates.risks: (1) PLD ~3.0 Å fails our own registered PLD gate. (2) Flexible — humidity-driven polymorphism means rigid GCMC is structurally blind to its actual failure mode. (3) RH90 EQUILIBRIUM capacity is essentially zero (6.3 % retention) — CALF-20 is not a RH90-equilibrium material, its strength is RH≲60 equilibrium plus process kinetics. (4) Heavily worked field with an incumbent industrial player — thin novelty margin. (5) The SquCALF-20 episode is a direct precedent that a computationally 'better' isoreticular CALF-20 analogue can be unsynthesizable.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] (Nat Commun OA full text read; Science + IECR via repo full-text cross-check) / [요지] for CEJ, IECR-mechanochem, CGD, ACS Mater Lett

candidates.synthesis_status: Excellent. Synthesized DIRECTLY IN WATER from zinc oxalate + 3-amino-1,2,4-triazole, high atom economy, "green/scalable"; already demonstrated at kilogram scale with simulated flue gas [10.1021/acs.inorgchem.5c02499, 요지]. (2) 0.15 bar value is at 318 K, not our registered 298 K. (3) Structure/PLD unknown → cannot pre-screen. (4) Very recent (2025) single report; no independent replication located.

The 2-mIm : benzimidazolate ratio is continuously tunable (0.67–0.94 mIm across the three published members), and the benzimidazolate 5(6)-substituent is a halogen/alkyl handle (Br, Cl, CH3 published; F, CF3, NO2, NH2, SO3H open). A CHA-topology MTV series is a genuinely different lattice from gme ZIF-69 while reusing every tool we have.

candidates.family: Metal azolate framework (MAF), zeolitic
candidates.linkers: 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazolate (CC1=NC=NN1, H-form CAS 7170-01-6) and/or 2-methylimidazolate (CC1=NC=CN1, CAS 693-98-1); continuous solid solutions between them

candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]. Qualitatively the uncoordinated triazolate N donor gives "dramatically enhanced and fine-tuned sorption" over the pure imidazolate [10.1002/adma.201004028, 요지]; ZIF-8 itself is a poor low-pressure CO2 sorbent (no 0.15 bar primary value located).

What exists is pure-water sorption on MAF-7 (uptake, kinetics, recyclability, regeneration temperature, 15–45 °C, with molecular simulation of water sites) [10.1039/d4cc05990e, 요지] — i.e. MAF-7 DOES take up water, unlike ZIF-8. No humid CO2 competition data located.
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes for MAF-7 (measured over 15–45 °C) [10.1039/d4cc05990e, 요지]; shape/step [미확인]. ZIF-8 is hydrophobic on the internal pore surface but hydrophilic on the external crystal surface [10.1021/jacs.5b03727, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Excellent and green. Zeolitic MAFs including MAF-7 are made solvent- and additive-free by heating ZnO/Zn(OH)2 with the azole, water being the only by-product [10.1039/c1cc12763b, 요지; 10.1016/j.micromeso.2011.11.033, 요지]. For the ZIF-8 end member: an aqueous ZnO + CO2 route with full filtrate recycling has been run in a PILOT PLANT producing hundreds of kilograms [10.1016/j.gee.2021.09.003, 요지]; concentrated aqueous synthesis also published [10.1016/j.micromeso.2013.10.003]. 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazole: 85 PubChem vendor records (https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/305560).
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES, fully. Rigid Zn azolate SOD, no OMS, no chemisorption; identical machinery to our ZIF-69 line. NOTE the registered relaxation trap: the empty-framework UFF minimum is the CLOSED gate phase, so PLD must be read as-built (3.95) and LCD-drop/min-distance after relaxation [repo risk_screen.py docstring].
candidates.mtv_headroom: The cleanest MTV axis available anywhere in this list, and the closest analogue to our own study: replacing 2-methylimidazolate by 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazolate in SOD gives isomorphous PURE triazolate OR imidazolate/triazolate SOLID SOLUTIONS carrying uncoordinated N donors [10.1002/adma.201004028, 요지]. That is a composition axis (x = 0…2) on a single cheap aqueous-synthesizable lattice, with the polar site density as the tuning variable — directly comparable to our saIm 0…100 series but at 1/10 the reagent cost.
candidates.risks: (1) MAF-7 adsorbs water (the triazolate N is a water site as much as a CO2 site) — this is the exact retention-vs-uptake trade our ZIF-69 work already found, so it may reproduce our null result on a new lattice. (2) SOD apertures ~3.4 Å sit right on our PLD gate. (3) No humid CO2 measurement exists — we would be first, which is upside for novelty and downside for validation (no external humid anchor, which the repo already lists as a standing weakness). (4) Supramolecular isomerism: the same Zn/azole system also gives RHO, dia and other phases — phase control is a real synthesis risk [10.1021/jacs.5b03727].
