candidates.name: SIFSIX-3-Ni (and the SIFSIX-3-M series, M = Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Zn)
candidates.family: Hybrid ultramicroporous material (HUM), anion-pillared square grid
candidates.metal: Ni(II) (series: Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)
candidates.pore_metrics: Series values: SIFSIX-3-Zn 3.84 Å, SIFSIX-3-Cu 3.5 Å average pore size [10.1038/ncomms5228, 전문]; SIFSIX-3-Ni lies between [미확인 exact]. Q_st across the series 42–54 kJ/mol, decreasing with increasing pore size [10.1021/acs.cgd.9b00086, 요지]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — the literature focus is trace CO2 (400–1000 ppm), not 0.15 bar
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH only, and on the Cu analogue: CO2/N2 1000 ppm/99.9 % at 298 K, apparent CO2 selectivity "not affected" at 74 % RH, PXRD unchanged after ≥4 dry+humid cycles [10.1038/ncomms5228, 전문]. CONTRADICTED for Ni under DAC conditions: "competition and reaction with atmospheric moisture significantly reduced their DAC performance" for all four physisorbents tested including SIFSIX-3-Ni [10.1002/anie.201506952, 요지]. Aging causes IRREVERSIBLE partial decomposition to nonporous single-layer edge-sharing NiO sheets, permanently reducing CO2 uptake [10.1021/jacs.3c11503, 요지]. The Ti analogue TIFSIX-3-Ni shows "limited stability under humid and oxidative conditions as well as upon multiple adsorption-desorption cycles" [10.1021/acs.energyfuels.4c01368, 요지]
candidates.water_isotherm: Measured for TIFSIX-3-Ni at multiple temperatures [10.1021/acs.energyfuels.4c01368, 요지]; SIFSIX-3-Ni isotherm shape [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Laboratory, trivially simple, room temperature. For the Cu analogue: layer 5.0 mL methanolic pyrazine (0.30 g, 3.0 mmol) onto 5.0 mL methanolic CuSiF6·xH2O (0.325 g, 0.6 mmol); powder forms immediately, left 24 h, filtered [10.1038/ncomms5228 Methods, 전문]. Pyrazine is a commodity flavour chemical (92 PubChem vendor records). MSiF6 salts are the cost/handling limitation (fluorosilicate chemistry). Binderless pelletization demonstrated for TIFSIX-3-Ni [10.1021/acs.energyfuels.4c01368]. No kilogram-scale report located.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PARTIAL. GCMC reproduces experimental CO2 isotherms and Q_st for all five SIFSIX-3-M [10.1021/acs.cgd.9b00086, 요지] — but with force fields tuned for these materials, not with generic UFF. Our UFF_MOF + DDEC6 stack has never been checked on a SiF6 anion-pillared lattice; the whole binding mechanism is electrostatic F···C(CO2), so a bad charge or a bad F LJ term breaks it. And the actual humid failure mode is CHEMICAL DECOMPOSITION (hydrolysis to NiO sheets), which no rigid GCMC can express. Pore ~3.2–3.5 Å is at or below our PLD ≥ 3.3 Å gate.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Enormous but mostly NOT ligand-substitution headroom. Three published axes: (a) divalent metal M = Fe/Co/Ni/Cu/Zn (tunes Q_st 42→54 kJ/mol); (b) pillar anion M'F6 with M' = Si/Ti/Ge/Sn/Nb/Zr/V/Ga (found to make little difference for CO2); (c) ligand length pyrazine → bipyridine → azopyridine → bipyridylacetylene → dipyridyltetrazine, plus interpenetration — the interpenetrated series is the one that helps, and the study concludes the optimum ultramicropore is 4.0–4.5 Å [10.1021/acs.jpcc.0c03633, 요지]. Mixed-anion or mixed-metal MTV within one crystal is documented for the sulfate-pillared azolate cousins [10.1002/anie.202512425].
candidates.risks: (1) The humid claim in the literature is breakthrough on the Cu analogue at 74 % RH, while independent work says moisture significantly degrades the Ni analogue under DAC — the field contradicts itself and the optimistic paper is the older one. (2) Irreversible hydrolytic decomposition on aging. (3) 3.2–3.5 Å pore fails our PLD gate. (4) Our force field is unvalidated for fluoroanion pillars. (5) Fluorosilicate handling.

candidates.name: NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (KAUST-7)
candidates.family: Hybrid ultramicroporous material (HUM), fluorinated anion-pillared
candidates.pore_metrics: "Contracted square-like channels" placing fluorine centres in close proximity; numeric PLD/LCD [미확인] — smaller than SIFSIX-3-Cu's 3.5 Å by design [10.1021/jacs.6b05345, 요지]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]. Published anchor is trace: 1.3 mmol/g gravimetric and 51.4 cm3(STP) cm-3 volumetric at 400 ppm CO2 / 298 K — the highest reported for a physisorbent at that concentration [10.1021/jacs.6b05345, 요지]. Full desorption at 328 K under vacuum, 54 kJ/mol regeneration energy.
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH: "cyclic CO2/N2 mixed-gas column breakthrough experiments under dry and humid conditions corroborate the excellent CO2 selectivity"; "notable hydrolytic stability" [10.1021/jacs.6b05345, 요지]. RH value, cycle count and any equilibrium humid isotherm are not in the abstract [미확인].
candidates.water_isotherm: Studied computationally: DFT + GCMC show that water adsorption in NbOFFIVE-1-Ni CANNOT be reproduced without accounting for framework flexibility (linker rotation, DFT re-optimization in the presence of adsorbed water) [10.1021/acs.jpcc.4c04486, 요지]. Experimental isotherm shape [미확인].
candidates.synthesis_status: Laboratory only. Analogous solution route to SIFSIX-3 but requires an oxyfluoroniobate salt ((NH4)2NbOF5 or equivalent), i.e. HF-derived fluoride chemistry [미확인 — the specific procedure was not accessible; JACS full text is 403]. No scale-up, shaping or cost report located. Same material commercialized in the literature as KAUST-7 for propylene/propane [10.1126/science.aaf6323].
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO / LIMITED — and this is documented, not inferred. A dedicated modelling study concludes that framework FLEXIBILITY must be included to describe water adsorption in this exact material [10.1021/acs.jpcc.4c04486]. Our rigid-framework TIP5P-Ew GCMC would therefore give a water isotherm known in advance to be wrong. Plus the same unvalidated-force-field problem as SIFSIX (fluoroanion pillar, DDEC6 on NbOF5), plus a pore below our PLD gate.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Poor as a ligand-substitution platform. The pillar anion and the pyrazine are both essentially fixed by the design logic (pore contraction + aligned F centres); substituting pyrazine changes the pore size that IS the mechanism. Metal and anion swaps are the only axes and the anion swap was shown to matter little for CO2 [10.1021/acs.jpcc.0c03633].
candidates.risks: (1) Explicitly flexibility-dependent for water — a registered model-impossibility for our pipeline. (2) Fluoride/HF synthesis chemistry. (3) No 0.15 bar number, no scale-up, no cost. (4) Pore below our PLD gate. (5) Optimized for 400 ppm DAC, not 15 % flue gas — the material's selling point is not our state point.

candidates.name: CAU-10-H
candidates.family: Al(OH)(dicarboxylate) helical-chain MOF (CAU-10 family)
candidates.topology: Helical chains of cis-corner-sharing AlO6 polyhedra linked by 1,3-benzenedicarboxylate; non-intersecting parallel sinusoidal channels
candidates.pore_metrics: Square sinusoidal channel whose diameter varies periodically between 1.1 and 6.6 Å (measured on the Br analogue CAU-10-Br, isostructural) [10.1039/c3dt32355b, 요지]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]. The CAU-10 structure does adsorb CO2 at 298 K while being non-porous to N2/H2 at 77 K [10.1039/c3dt32355b, 요지]
candidates.humid_evidence: EQUILIBRIUM binary CO2/H2O at 30 °C by microscale dynamic column breakthrough: CO2 capacity is retained to the LEFT of the water-isotherm inflection and drops to the RIGHT of it; unlike CALF-20, the CAU-10-H water isotherm is UNAFFECTED by the presence of CO2 (no protective shift) [10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772, 요지]
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes — S-shaped/Type V with a sharp step (the reason it is a heat-pump and adsorption-chiller material); reversible breathing-like structural change on water ad/desorption [10.1039/c4dt02264e, 요지; 10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: BEST-DOCUMENTED SCALE AND COST OF ANY CANDIDATE HERE. Green, low-cost multikilogram pilot-scale batch reactor run yielding 27.5 kg of dry MOF, STY 99 kg m-3 d-1; techno-economic analysis at 1 kt scale gives 13.8 ± 2.8 $/kg (2022 prices), best case 12.1 ± 2.4 $/kg at STY 481 kg m-3 d-1 with solvent recycling; LINKER COST is the dominant cost driver; coatings measured for full-scale adsorption chillers [10.1021/acs.iecr.5c05308, 요지; preprint 10.26434/chemrxiv-2025-38cvz]. 700 water ad/desorption cycles stable [10.1039/c4dt02264e]; but after ~70,000 temperature-swing hydrothermal stress cycles the effective heat/mass transfer resistance rises 30–40 % [10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2023.120336, 요지]. Isophthalic acid is a bulk commodity (100 PubChem vendor records).
candidates.pipeline_modelable: LIMITED. Documented breathing-like reversible structural change on water sorption [10.1039/c4dt02264e] — the rigid-framework assumption fails exactly where we need it (RH90). Al3+ carboxylate is also outside the Zn-azolate regime where our UFF_MOF/DDEC6 combination has any internal validation. The 1.1 Å narrow point of the channel means a rigid Zeo++ PLD would report it impassable, contradicting the experimental CO2 uptake — a known trap.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Documented and quantified, INCLUDING the batch-reproducibility failure mode we already found ourselves. Mixed-linker CAU-10 MOFs were made by high-throughput screening: [Al(OH)(BDC)0.8(BDC-Br)0.2], [Al(OH)(BDC-NO2)0.55(BDC-NH2)0.23(BDC-NHCHO)0.22]; NO2/NH2 incorporation INCREASED CO2 capacity vs the parent, Br incorporation DECREASED it. Critically, for the H/CH3 mixed series "the molar ratios and especially the sorption properties differ SUBSTANTIALLY FOR EVERY BATCH" [10.1039/c3dt32355b, 요지]. Further substituent work: partial linker fluorination and linker extension [10.1016/j.micromeso.2017.04.054].
candidates.risks: (1) Hydrophilic S-shaped water isotherm with a step in the working range — at RH90 the pores are water-filled; this is a water sorbent, not a humid CO2 sorbent. (2) Breathing → rigid GCMC invalid. (3) 30–40 % transfer-resistance degradation after hydrothermal stress. (4) Al carboxylate chemistry is outside our validated force-field regime.

candidates.name: MIL-160(Al)
candidates.family: Al(OH)(dicarboxylate), CAU-10-type, bio-derived linker
candidates.topology: CAU-10-type helical AlO6 chains, square sinusoidal channels [미확인 exact]
candidates.pore_metrics: Ultramicroporous with hydroxyl and furan interaction sites [10.1021/acs.jpcc.7b08856, 요지]; numeric PLD/LCD [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]. Anchor at higher pressure: 4.2 mol/kg CO2 (vs 2.07 CH4, 0.69 N2) at 5.8 bar and 313 K on shaped material, dual-site Langmuir; LDF coefficients 0.021–0.096 s-1 for CO2 between 0.11 and 2.76 bar [10.1021/acs.iecr.2c04150, 요지]
candidates.humid_evidence: No humid-CO2 equilibrium data located. Coadsorption CO2 selectivity predicted by DFT+GCMC and supported by real coadsorption measurements on shaped samples — but for CO2 vs H2/N2/CH4/CO, NOT vs water [10.1021/acs.jpcc.7b08856, 요지]
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes — strongly hydrophilic, S-shaped with a step at LOW p/p0; this is a benchmark heat-reallocation and atmospheric-water-harvesting sorbent that outperforms commercial SAPO-34 [10.1002/adma.201502418, 요지; 10.1007/s10450-020-00286-5; 10.3390/en14123586]. Structural flexibility on H2O and N2 adsorption confirmed by Rietveld refinement [10.1002/ejic.201800323, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Good. Template-free green synthesis; a safer/greener route was developed for pilot scale producing MIL-160(Al) on a 400 g scale, then shaped into pellets by wet granulation, giving 343 Wh/kg energy storage capacity [10.1002/cssc.201700164, 요지]. Linker is bio-derived FDCA (109 PubChem vendor records), an industrially scaling platform chemical. Hydrothermal stress: ~5–10 % uptake loss after ~70,000 temperature-swing cycles generally, but under application-relevant boundary conditions MIL-160(Al) shows a drastic 35–45 % uptake reduction [10.1016/j.applthermaleng.2023.120336, 요지]
candidates.pipeline_modelable: LIMITED. Flexible on H2O adsorption (Rietveld-confirmed) and Al-carboxylate chemistry outside our validated regime. GCMC has been used successfully for the DRY gases [10.1021/acs.jpcc.7b08856], so a dry-CO2 benchmark run would be defensible; an RH90 run would not.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Moderate. FDC ↔ isophthalate ↔ thiophene-2,5-dicarboxylate are isoreticular in this Al helical-chain family, and the CAU-10 mixed-linker precedent [10.1039/c3dt32355b] transfers. But the furan oxygen that makes MIL-160 hydrophilic is the thing you would have to remove, at which point you have CAU-10.
candidates.risks: (1) Deliberately hydrophilic — designed to fill with water at low RH. It is the wrong direction for RH90 CO2. (2) 35–45 % uptake loss under application-relevant hydrothermal stress. (3) No humid CO2 data at all. (4) Flexible + non-Zn-azolate → double model penalty.

candidates.name: Al-fumarate / Basolite A520 (aluminium fumarate)
candidates.family: Al(OH)(dicarboxylate), MIL-53(Al) analogue
candidates.topology: MIL-53(Al)-type (bdc replaced by fumarate) but with MORE RIGID behaviour than MIL-53 [10.1002/anie.201410459, 요지]
candidates.linkers: fumarate (C(=C/C(=O)O)\C(=O)O, fumaric acid CAS 110-17-8 — food-grade bulk commodity, 136 PubChem vendor records)
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인] — not in the accessible abstract
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: EQUILIBRIUM binary CO2/H2O, 30 °C, microscale dynamic column breakthrough: CO2 capacity retained left of the water inflection, drops right of it; the water isotherm is UNAFFECTED by CO2 (no CALF-20-like protective shift) [10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772, 요지]. The same paper's "CO2 goes to zero at RH50" statement belongs to the Al-FUMARATE section (its Figure 6), NOT to CALF-20 — a misattribution already registered in our repo [/home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/CALF20_ANCHOR_20260829.md §V-2]. Hydrophobized composite ALF@poly(acrylates)-F has been built specifically to fix this for humid flue gas [10.1016/j.fuel.2024.132269, 미확인 numbers]
candidates.water_isotherm: Yes — S-shaped [10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772, 요지]; step position [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: COMMERCIAL. Sold by BASF as Basolite A520; the Al-MOF family's path from academic research to industrial production is documented [10.1016/j.micromeso.2011.08.016, title-level; abstract not deposited]. The commercial A520 sample's structure and an optimized synthesis were published [10.1002/anie.201410459, 요지]. Continuous solvent-free/low-solvent twin-screw EXTRUSION synthesis of MOFs reports space-time yields "orders of magnitude greater than STYs for other methods" [10.1039/c4sc03217a, 요지 — the specific per-MOF STY numbers were not retrievable, publisher blocked].
candidates.pipeline_modelable: LIMITED. MIL-53 family = breathing archetype; A520 is described as "more rigid" than MIL-53 but not rigid. Al carboxylate outside our validated force-field regime. No PLD published to pre-screen.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Low-to-moderate. Fumarate substitution is chemically awkward (the C=C is the linker); documented modification is post-synthetic halogen functionalization via in-situ hydrochlorination of an acetylenedicarboxylate analogue [10.1071/ch19221, 요지]. The real 'MTV' lever in this family is the CAU-10/MIL-53 linker-substituent axis, i.e. a different framework.
candidates.risks: (1) CO2 capacity collapses by RH50 — worse than CALF-20 on our exact axis, and this is the material our RH90 target has to beat. (2) Flexible. (3) Al carboxylate outside our chemistry. Value here is as a NEGATIVE CONTROL / cheap external humid anchor, not as a candidate.

candidates.name: UTSA-16 (K-Co citrate)
candidates.family: Alkali/transition-metal citrate framework
candidates.metal: Co(II) + K(I); OPEN METAL SITES present (Co)
candidates.linkers: citrate (C(C(=O)O)C(CC(=O)O)(C(=O)O)O, citric acid CAS 77-92-9 — commodity, 205 PubChem vendor records)
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인] — not in the accessible abstracts
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] at 0.15 bar. Anchor: 160 cm3 cm-3 CO2 uptake at ambient conditions, confirmed by simulated breakthrough; strong binding sites located by neutron diffraction [10.1038/ncomms1956, 요지]
candidates.humid_evidence: DYNAMIC, and the best OMS result in the literature: UTSA-16 retains 70 % of its CO2 separation capacity after water admittance in a flow designed to simulate real post-combustion emissions, and — uniquely among OMS materials — desorbs water FULLY at room temperature; stability tested over 160 cycles with a small temperature swing for regeneration [10.1021/acsami.6b13216, 요지]. RH value not given [미확인]
candidates.water_isotherm: Not located as an isotherm; the paper reports full water desorption at room temperature [10.1021/acsami.6b13216, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Very good and cheap. Aqueous synthesis from citric acid + KOH + Co salt. Microwave routes give rapid crystallization with improved CO2 performance [10.1016/j.cej.2019.04.112, 10.1016/j.jiec.2020.04.015]; CONTINUOUS FLOW synthesis including mixed-metal and magnetic composites, explicitly "toward scalable manufacture" [10.1016/j.jece.2024.114167]; shaping demonstrated as films on monoliths [10.1016/j.cej.2016.11.058], 3D-printed Co-kaolin monoliths [10.1021/acsami.8b05192] and electrospun fibre mats [10.1016/j.micromeso.2021.111233]
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO / LIMITED — self-declared exclusion. UTSA-16's advertised mechanism is OPEN METAL SITE binding of CO2 and of water. Our pipeline cannot model OMS water coordination (registered limitation; OMS leverage fixed at ~7 % in our own analysis). A rigid UFF_MOF + DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew run would miss precisely the physics that makes UTSA-16 interesting. Report it, do not assign compute to it.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Low on the linker axis (citrate is the structure). Real axes are metal substitution (Zn for Co is published: UTSA-16(Zn) [10.1016/j.jiec.2020.04.015]) and alkali substitution (Li/Na/K/Cs, studied by GCMC/MD [10.1016/j.seppur.2024.126534]). This is a metal-MTV, not a linker-MTV, platform.
candidates.risks: (1) OMS → outside our model. (2) Co content: cost and toxicity for a bulk sorbent. (3) 70 % retention is DYNAMIC and the RH is unstated. (4) No PLD/LCD published.

candidates.name: ZIF-94 / SIM-1
candidates.family: Zeolitic imidazolate framework, aldehyde-functionalized ("Substituted Imidazolate Material")
candidates.topology: SOD reported for SIM-1 [미확인 — not confirmed against a primary structural source in this pass]
candidates.pore_metrics: "Ultramicroporous" [10.1039/c0nj00667j, 요지]; numeric PLD/LCD [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: None located. The material is studied almost exclusively as an MMM filler for CO2/N2 and CO2/CH4 [10.1016/j.memsci.2017.12.033; 10.1002/adsu.202100317; 10.1039/d2ta03958c], not as a bulk humid sorbent.
candidates.water_isotherm: [미확인]. The pendant aldehyde is polar and would be expected to bind water — untested here.
candidates.synthesis_status: Unusually well documented on the process axis for a laboratory ZIF. A dedicated MOF SCALE-UP CASE STUDY improved production "to boost safety, reduce environmental impact and cost while maintaining performance" [10.1039/c9gc00783k, 요지]; synthesis from RECYCLED MOTHER LIQUORS with particle size controlled 41 ± 8 to 180 ± 73 nm [10.1002/adsu.202100317, 요지]; fast synthesis using NaOH as deprotonator with reagent recycling [10.1016/j.matchemphys.2022.127039]; a route for recovering the LIGAND itself from spent framework [10.1039/d2cc03661d]; nanoparticles via inorganic deprotonators [10.1039/d0nj04402d]. This is the only candidate here with a published circular-reagent process.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES in principle (rigid Zn imidazolate, no OMS) — same machinery as ZIF-69. But nothing is pre-checkable: no published PLD, no CO2 at 0.15 bar, no water isotherm. Every field would be a prediction with no anchor, which is exactly the situation our repo already flags as dangerous (no external humid benchmark).
candidates.mtv_headroom: High and chemically distinctive: the pendant ALDEHYDE is a post-synthetic modification handle (imine condensation with amines, ethanolamine, etc.), giving a route to install polar or basic groups AFTER the framework is built — i.e. decoupling framework formation from functionality, which our in-synthesis substitution approach cannot do. Also mixable with 2-methylimidazolate and with imidazole-2-carboxaldehyde (the ZIF-90 linker). CAUTION: amine-derived products would tip into chemisorption territory and leave our pipeline.
candidates.risks: (1) Topology unconfirmed. (2) No CO2, no water, no humid data — zero anchors. (3) The aldehyde is a hydrophilic site; hydrophobicity is unlikely. (4) Linker is a specialty chemical, ~78 vendors, clearly more expensive than 2-methylimidazole [price 미확인].
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] / [미확인] for structure and all adsorption numbers

candidates.name: ZIF-8 / MAF-4 (reference point, not a candidate)
candidates.family: Zeolitic imidazolate framework
candidates.pore_metrics: As-built PLD 3.95 Å; our own UFF4MOF relaxation closes it to 3.24 Å — the empty-framework UFF minimum is the CLOSED-gate phase [repo /home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/risk_screen.py:17, /home/mangwon1/mof_project/00_Migration/MIGRATION.md:269, 전문]
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — no primary 0.15 bar value located; ZIF-8 is generally a weak low-pressure CO2 sorbent
candidates.humid_evidence: None as a bulk humid CO2 sorbent. Work in this space is on hydrophobic ZIF-8 COATINGS over activated carbon [10.1016/j.jiec.2023.01.036] or amine-modified ZIF-8 [10.1016/j.seppur.2022.120535] — both leave physisorption-only territory.
candidates.water_isotherm: Hydrophobic internal pore surface but HYDROPHILIC external crystal surface (contrast with MAF-6) [10.1021/jacs.5b03727, 요지]
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercial and pilot-scale. Aqueous ZnO + CO2 route forming a soluble [ZnMeim]+[MeimCOO]- salt then releasing CO2 to precipitate ZIF-8 with water and 2-methylimidazole as the only recyclable streams; a PILOT PLANT produced hundreds of kilograms [10.1016/j.gee.2021.09.003, 요지]. Also: concentrated aqueous solution synthesis [10.1016/j.micromeso.2013.10.003], cost-effective stoichiometric-precursor route [10.1016/j.micromeso.2014.03.006], solvent-free ZnO/Zn(OH)2 + azole [10.1039/c1cc12763b]. Sold commercially as Basolite Z1200 [미확인 — vendor pages all returned 403].
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES, fully — it is already the calibration structure in our own gate logic.
candidates.mtv_headroom: The largest of any system here, and the one our project already lives in. 2-mIm mixes isomorphously with 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazolate [10.1002/adma.201004028], with benzimidazolates (giving CHA ZIF-300/301/302 [10.1002/anie.201403980]), and with essentially the whole substituted-imidazole catalogue.
candidates.risks: Weak low-pressure CO2; not a candidate in its own right. Its value is (a) as the cheapest, most scalable Zn-azolate lattice known, i.e. an MTV HOST, and (b) as the calibration point our gates were built on.

candidates.name: Fe2(bdp)3
candidates.family: Metal pyrazolate framework
candidates.topology: Triangular one-dimensional channels (bdp2- bridged Fe chains)
candidates.metal: Fe(III/II) — redox-active, no open metal site (octahedral N6)
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인] — 'triangular channels' only, no numeric PLD/LCD in the accessible abstract
candidates.co2_015bar: [미확인] — no CO2 isotherm located; the material's published application is hexane isomer separation at 160 °C
candidates.humid_evidence: None located
candidates.water_isotherm: [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Laboratory only. Described as "a highly stable framework" [10.1126/science.1234071, 요지]; no aqueous route, no scale-up, no shaping report located. H2bdp is a specialty multi-step linker (53 vendors, clearly the most expensive linker in this list) [price 미확인].
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PARTIAL. Rigid and OMS-free so mechanically modelable, BUT the framework is redox non-innocent — reductive cation insertion produces electron delocalization and charge mobility [10.1038/s41563-018-0098-1] — which makes a single DDEC6 charge set physically questionable and raises an O2/flue-gas oxidation risk. Fe UFF parameters are also outside our Zn-azolate validation.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Moderate: the benzene spacer of bdp accepts substituents (F, CH3, NH2) and can be extended (biphenyl, naphthalene) or replaced by pyridine/pyrimidine; metal can be Fe/Co/Ni/Mn (Co(bdp) and Fe(bdp) are known flexible phases). But every one of those linkers is a multi-step synthesis.
candidates.risks: (1) Nothing published on CO2 at our state point or on humidity — the candidate is on the list by reputation for stability, not by evidence. (2) Expensive linker kills the synthesis-feasibility case for a bulk flue-gas sorbent. (3) Redox activity in a wet, O2-containing flue gas. (4) Related M(bdp) phases are strongly flexible (phase-change adsorption), so 'rigid' cannot be assumed.

candidates.name: MOF-303
candidates.family: Al(OH)(pyrazoledicarboxylate) — Al MOF water harvester
candidates.pore_metrics: [미확인]

MODALITY: synthesis feasibility and scale. Tooling note: the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted on the first call, so all evidence below was gathered with curl against Crossref (api.crossref.org), OpenAlex (api.openalex.org, including abstract_inverted_index reconstruction), Europe PMC (ebi.ac.uk/europepmc), Semantic Scholar and PubChem PUG-REST, plus two OA full texts. OpenAlex is the highest-yield abstract source when publishers 403 — worth adding to the standing toolkit.

=== 1. THE FINDING THAT SHOULD GO INTO §6 FIRST: OUR OWN PLD GATE REJECTS THE INCUMBENTS ===
Our registered structure gate (PLD >= 3.3 A as-built, formally in force "from the next generation of structures", i.e. exactly these new frameworks) would reject the best-evidenced humid CO2 physisorbents in the world:
  CALF-20        PLD ca. 3.0 A   [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0, 전문]  -> FAILS
  SIFSIX-3-Cu    pore 3.5 A       [10.1038/ncomms5228, 전문]         -> marginal
  SIFSIX-3-Ni    between Zn 3.84 and Cu 3.5 A [미확인 exact]          -> marginal
  NbOFFIVE-1-Ni  deliberately contracted below SIFSIX-3-Cu           -> FAILS
  MAF-7 / ZIF-8  3.4 A / 3.95 A as-built                             -> marginal / passes
Meanwhile an independent GCMC+DFT screen of the fluorinated-MOF space concludes the optimum ultramicropore for flue-gas CO2 is 4.0-4.5 A [10.1021/acs.jpcc.0c03633, 요지] — which INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCES our own cavity-model optimum of 4.0-4.5 A (repo digest). So the external literature agrees with our physics and disagrees with our gate. Recommendation: T-NF-* registration should treat PLD <= 3.3 A as a FLAG requiring a diffusion/accessibility argument, not as an automatic kill, and the change must be registered BEFORE any new-framework data is read.

=== 2. THE SYNTHESIS-FEASIBILITY RANKING (this modality's actual answer) ===
Tier A — proven at >= kg scale in water or solvent-free, commodity linkers:
  CALF-20 (commercial, 1 t CO2/day demo), Zn-OX-ATZ (water-only, kg-scale flue-gas validation),
  MOF-303 (3.5 kg/batch, 91 %, microwave 5 min), CAU-10-H (27.5 kg/batch, 12-14 $/kg TEA),
  ZIF-8/MAF-4 (pilot plant, hundreds of kg, aqueous ZnO+CO2, full recycle),
  Al-fumarate/A520 (BASF commercial), MIL-160 (400 g pilot + pellets).
Tier B — laboratory but green/simple, no scale report:
  MAF-6, MAF-7 and the SOD Zn(mIm)x(mtz)2-x solid solutions (solvent-free ZnO/Zn(OH)2 + azole,
  water the only by-product, 10.1039/c1cc12763b), UTSA-16 (aqueous, continuous-flow demonstrated),
  SIFSIX-3-M (room-temperature methanol layering, 24 h), ZIF-94/SIM-1 (scale-up case study + mother-liquor
  and ligand recycling published).
Tier C — laboratory, hazardous or expensive inputs, no scale route:
  NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (oxyfluoroniobate/HF chemistry), ZIF-300/301/302 (DMF), ZIF-204 (Cu precursor complex),
  Fe2(bdp)3 (multi-step specialty linker, 53 vendors).
Cost anchor to quote: CAU-10-H 13.8 +/- 2.8 $/kg at 1 kt scale, best case 12.1 +/- 2.4 $/kg, LINKER COST dominant [10.1021/acs.iecr.5c05308]. This is the only real MOF cost number I could source, and it says the linker choice IS the economics — which argues hard for azolate/oxalate/citrate/fumarate chemistry and against anything requiring a multi-step aromatic linker.

=== 4. THREE PRECEDENTS THAT BEAR DIRECTLY ON OUR OWN REGISTERED FINDINGS ===
(a) BATCH SCATTER IS NOT OUR ARTEFACT. In the CAU-10 mixed-linker series, the H/CH3 members' "molar ratios and especially the sorption properties differ SUBSTANTIALLY FOR EVERY BATCH", while the Br and NO2/NH2 members were reproducible to +/- 2 % molar fraction [10.1039/c3dt32355b, 요지]. This is an independent, experimental instance of our registered result that arrangement/batch variance can exceed composition effects (배치 단위 8.7 %p > 후보 간 최대 차 7.9 %p). It is the strongest external support for the poster-grade claim in the repo, and it also says the effect is linker-dependent — some substituent pairs mix reproducibly, some do not.
(b) A COMPUTATIONALLY PREDICTED MTV WINNER FAILED TO EXIST. SquCALF-20 was predicted by GCMC to give 3.6 mmol/g at 0.15 bar and CO2/N2 500, better than the parent [10.1021/acsaenm.3c00622]. A dedicated synthetic screen failed to make it and produced two NONPOROUS coordination polymers (UdP-40, UdP-41) at the identical 2:2:1 Zn/triazolate/squarate stoichiometry [10.1021/acs.cgd.6c00193]. Any T-NF-* registration must therefore carry a synthesizability precondition, not only a gate on computed properties. (This paper is already in the repo's local library as CGD_2026_FactOrFiction.)
(c) THE RIGID-FRAMEWORK BLIND SPOT IS DOCUMENTED FOR TWO OF THE THREE INCUMBENTS. CALF-20's humid collapse is a water-induced alpha->beta polymorph transition [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0; 10.1021/acsmaterialslett.3c00930], and NbOFFIVE-1-Ni's water adsorption is explicitly shown to require framework flexibility (linker rotation) to reproduce [10.1021/acs.jpcc.4c04486]. Our frozen-framework TIP5P-Ew GCMC cannot see either mechanism. This is the same risk the repo already registered against our own nbIm retention numbers (CALF20_ANCHOR §V-3b) — the external literature now supplies two independent confirmations that it is real, not hypothetical.

=== 5. CORRECTIONS TO CLAIMS CIRCULATING IN THIS AREA ===
- "SIFSIX-3-Ni is unaffected by 74 % RH": the 74 % RH breakthrough in 10.1038/ncomms5228 is on SIFSIX-3-Cu, and it is a breakthrough SELECTIVITY, not a capacity retention. For Ni specifically, independent work reports that moisture significantly reduces DAC performance [10.1002/anie.201506952] and that aging causes irreversible decomposition to nonporous NiO nanosheets [10.1021/jacs.3c11503].
- "Al-fumarate CO2 goes to zero at RH50" belongs to Al-fumarate, not CALF-20; CALF-20 is still at 2.10 mmol/g (60 % retention) at RH50 [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-2, from 10.1021/acs.iecr.4c03772].
- "CALF-20 450,000 cycles": 450,000 STEAM TREATMENTS, with CO2 capacity measured at a single end-point sample [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-1.1].
- "CALF-20 retains performance to 40 % RH": a comparison sentence against CAU-10/Al-fumarate in the Science abstract. The defensible pair of numbers is "unaffected <= 30 % RH / negligible above 80 % RH" [repo CALF20_ANCHOR §V-1.1].
- The repo digest's "ZnAtzCO3 32.6 kJ/mol" benchmark entry is a DIFFERENT compound from the Zn-OX-ATZ (zinc oxalate-aminotriazolate) reported here; do not merge the two rows.

=== 6. WHAT I WOULD PUT FORWARD FOR T-NF-* ON THIS MODALITY'S EVIDENCE ALONE ===
1st  Zn-OX-ATZ / the Zn azolate-oxalate family (CALF-20 chemical family, amino variants). Water-only synthesis, kg-scale flue-gas validation, 2.29 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, a real MTV axis (trz / Atz / dtz), no OMS, no chemisorption. Cost: build + relax + Zeo++ + dry/RH0-90 GCMC, well within 2 weeks. Falsifier: if the Zeo++ PLD on the published CIF is < 3.0 A the CO2 kinetics argument collapses; if the paper's humid test turns out to be breakthrough-only at low RH, the headline claim is not on our axis.
2nd  SOD Zn(mIm)x(mtz)2-x solid solutions (MAF-4/MAF-7 series). The cleanest MTV composition axis in the literature on the cheapest, greenest lattice (solvent-free ZnO + azole), with NO humid CO2 data published — maximum novelty, and it is the direct control for our ZIF-69 result (does the retention/uptake trade-off reproduce on a different topology with a different polar group?). Falsifier: if MAF-7's water isotherm steps below RH90, the series reproduces our null result and we should say so and stop.
3rd  ZIF-300/301/302 CHA MTV series. Same building blocks and same substitution machinery as our current line, a genuinely different net (CHA vs gme), and the only published mixed-linker ZIF with an explicit dry-AND-humid CO2/N2 result. Weakest on synthesis feasibility (DMF, no scale-up) and its humid evidence is 3-cycle breakthrough, so it is a calculation candidate rather than a synthesis candidate.
Do NOT assign compute to: UTSA-16 (OMS), NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (documented flexibility-dependent water), MOF-303/MIL-160/CAU-10-H (hydrophilic by design and/or breathing), Fe2(bdp)3 (redox-active, no data at our state point), any amine-appended or amine-modified variant (chemisorption).

candidates.name: CALF-20
candidates.family: Zn triazolate-oxalate (Zn2(1,2,4-triazolate)2(oxalate))
candidates.topology: dmc (RCSR), layered Zn-triazolate sheets pillared by oxalate
candidates.pore_metrics: PLD ~3 Å, LCD ~4.3 Å [전문, 10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0]. Adv Mater 2025 review states micropores ~3-4.3 Å [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511]
candidates.humid_evidence: EQUILIBRIUM/co-adsorption: 'preferentially adsorbs CO2 at 40% relative humidity and maintains performance under flue gas conditions of 150 °C' [Science 2021 abstract, 10.1126/science.abi7281 — 전문 blocked 403, abstract verified via Crossref]. A review table gives 2.60 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 298 K at 40% RH vs 2.60 mmol/g dry (≈100% retention) [10.1002/adma.202515511] — but that review's Table 1 reference pointers are internally broken (refs 1-10 resolve to unrelated papers), so treat the 40% RH figure as [미확인]. PRACTICAL CEILING: shaped with polysulfone binder on a rotary bed, capture demonstrated only up to ≈25-30% RH [10.1002/advs.202401070]; 'CALF-20 is almost insensitive to water content up to 20-30% RH' [10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]; 'water vapor severely compromises its performance above 40% RH... CALF-20 loses all activity at 80% RH whereas methylated CALF-20M-w/CALF-20M-e retain ~20%' [10.1039/d6sc03678c]. No RH90 equilibrium CO2 datum found.
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. Type V (hydrophobic-type) with inflection below 20% RH and saturation ≈11 mmol/g [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0]. In situ XRPD: water-induced phase transition between 20 and 30% RH at 25 °C; 1.65 H2O per Zn at 50% RH rising to ~1.8 H2O/Zn at 90% RH, fully reversible; transition suppressed above 45 °C [전문, 10.1021/jacs.5c06866]
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercialized. kg-scale mild synthesis, >450,000 cycles without capacity loss, steam-stable at 150 °C for a week [10.1039/d3sc06076d citing Science 2021]. Deployed by Svante/BASF.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: PARTIAL. No OMS, no chemisorption → UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 + PACMAN DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew all apply. BUT the framework is genuinely flexible: CO2 loading distorts the pore rectangular→diamond→rectangular, pore-volume fraction changes ~12%, and water drives a first-order polymorphic transition at 20-30% RH. A RIGID 2x2x2 GCMC cell cannot reproduce the humidity-responsive polymorphism and will systematically mis-predict the RH0→RH90 curve. Usable as a dry-basis benchmark and as a rigid-approximation control, not as a quantitative RH90 prediction.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH and directly analogous to the current saIm work. (i) Triazolate C3/C5 ring positions: methylated CALF-20M-w and CALF-20M-e already synthesized and shown to shift the water step [10.1039/d6sc03678c]. (ii) Anionic pillar substitution: SiF6(2-) and SO4(2-) substituted into CALF-20-type frameworks [10.1039/d6sc03678c]. (iii) Oxalate → longer/functionalized dicarboxylate. Mixed triazolate/methyltriazolate ratios give a direct MTV composition axis with the same 'arrangement vs composition' question as ZIF-69.
candidates.risks: (1) Rigid-GCMC cannot capture the 20-30% RH phase transition — the exact regime our RH90 target sits above. (2) Water saturation (~11 mmol/g) far exceeds CO2 capacity; the RH90 retention is very likely poor and the published 40% RH claim does not extrapolate. (3) It is the field benchmark, so a null result against it is publishable but a 'we beat CALF-20' claim would need the flexibility caveat stated. (4) Reported dmc topology means the ZIF-69 gme substitution machinery does not transfer directly.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for Nat Commun 2024 flexibility/pore/water data and JACS 2025 XRPD water data; [요지] for the Science 2021 primary numbers (publisher 403, abstract verified via Crossref); [미확인] for the 40% RH CO2 retention value

candidates.co2_015bar: Trace-region isotherm (298 K): 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 mmol/g at 500 / 1000 / 3000 / 5000 / 10,000 ppm; N2 0.04 mmol/g at 1 bar; Qst 52 kJ/mol [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]. At 0.15 bar: ~2.8 mmol/g, 1 bar ~3 mmol/g [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH (dynamic), 298 K, 1 bar, 74% RH. 3000 ppm CO2/N2 at 74% RH: CO2 saturation uptake ≈1.5 mmol/g, retention time ≈520 min/g — the least degraded of all six sorbents tested (NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 1.9→0.5 mmol/g, Zeolite 13X →0.1 mmol/g under the same conditions). Dry 1000 ppm: 0.7 mmol/g, 715 min/g. Effluent CO2 <50 ppm across all trace conditions. Six-cycle and 100-cycle recyclability at 74% RH with no loss; desorption at 348 K. Accelerated stability 40 °C/75% RH: reverts to α polymorph after 14 days but is regenerable with negligible BET/CO2 change. IAST CO2/H2O selectivity S_CW = 16.2 at 74% RH / 500 ppm, rising to 54.0 and 173.1 at 0.005 and 0.01 bar CO2 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]
candidates.water_isotherm: YES, and it is the key result. H2O uptake only 1.64 mmol/g (DVS) / 0.96 mmol/g at ambient pressure at 95% RH — surface-sorption-like, comparable to ZIF-8 (1.44-2.6 mmol/g) and 5-20x lower than SIFSIX-3-Ni (8.80), TIFSIX-3-Ni (7.46), NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (10.09), Zeolite 13X (18.76), Mg-MOF-74 (~33.3) [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]. A phase transition to SIFSIX-18-Ni-α accompanies water uptake at 95% RH.
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized, single-crystal + PXRD characterized, lab scale; regenerable and cyclable. No scale-up reported.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — best fit of this whole list. Physisorption only, no OMS, no chemisorption; Ni is fully coordinated. UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 + PACMAN DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew is exactly the right tool. Caveat: an α↔β polymorph transition under water at 95% RH is outside a rigid cell; and the strong F(-)···CO2 electrostatics make the DDEC6 charge quality the dominant accuracy lever (as it was for the ZIF-69 EQeq→PACMAN switch).
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE-HIGH. The hydrophobicity comes from methyl groups on the pyrazine ring; the pyrazine → 2-methylpyrazine → 2,3-dimethylpyrazine series is a natural mixed-linker (MTV) ladder with the same fractional-substitution axis as saIm. Anion pillar is a second axis: SiF6 / TiF6 (TIFSIX) / NbOF5 (NbOFFIVE) / SnF6 are all isostructural. Two orthogonal composition axes = a real design study.
candidates.risks: (1) All the published humid data are at TRACE CO2 (1000-10,000 ppm), not 0.15 bar — extrapolating the 74% RH retention to flue gas is an assumption, not a measurement. (2) Qst 52 kJ/mol sits above our 29.8-41 benchmark band and means a high regeneration duty. (3) Polymorph switching under water is a rigid-GCMC blind spot. (4) Ni pyrazine SiF6 chemistry has no overlap with the ZIF synthesis line already in the lab.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] — full text mined from PMC6884411, including Table 1 and all breakthrough values

candidates.name: SIFSIX-3-Ni (and SIFSIX-3-Cu / SIFSIX-3-Zn analogues)
candidates.family: Hybrid ultramicroporous material, SiF6-pillared pyrazine square grid
candidates.metal: Ni(II) (also Cu, Zn, Co analogues), no open metal site
candidates.pore_metrics: Pore size 3.5 Å (Cu), 3.84 Å (Zn) by NLDFT from CO2 isotherms; SIFSIX-3-Ni ≈3.8 Å. BET (from CO2 at 298 K) ≈250 m²/g (Zn), ≈300 m²/g (Cu) [전문, 10.1038/ncomms5228]
candidates.co2_015bar: SIFSIX-3-Ni: ~2.5 mmol/g at 0.1 bar, 2.7 mmol/g at 1 bar, Qst 50.9 kJ/mol, 298 K [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 citing Chem 2016, 1, 753]. SIFSIX-3-Zn 2.55 mmol/g at 1 bar, IAST CO2/N2 1818, Qst 45. SIFSIX-3-Cu ~2.50 mmol/g at 1 bar, Qst 54; 1.24 mmol/g at 400 ppm/298 K (10x SIFSIX-3-Zn, 15x Mg-MOF-74); 82.6 cm³(STP)/cm³ at 0.01 bar [전문, 10.1038/ncomms5228]
candidates.humid_evidence: BOTH. (a) FLUE-GAS RELEVANT: 'The CO2 uptake of SIFSIX-3-Ni in the presence of moisture under simulated flue-gas conditions (0.15 bar CO2, 0.85 bar N2, 75% RH) was found to be 62% of that under dry conditions' [전문 of 10.1002/anie.202206613, citing 10.1002/anie.201506952 and 10.1039/c7cc02289a] — this is the single most directly comparable retention number in this list to our RH90/RH0 metric. (b) TRACE: SIFSIX-3-Cu 1000 ppm CO2/N2 column breakthrough at 74% RH, apparent CO2 selectivity 'not affected by the presence of humidity'; PXRD intact after ≥4 dry+humid cycles [전문, 10.1038/ncomms5228]. (c) SIFSIX-3-Ni at 74% RH, 3000 ppm: 1.6 mmol/g, 322 min/g [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171].
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. H2O uptake 8.80 mmol/g at 95% RH, 298 K (DVS) — hydrophilic, ~5x SIFSIX-18-Ni-β. IAST CO2/H2O could not be computed because negative adsorption is observed from a water-induced phase change [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]. SIFSIX-3-Ni undergoes a hydrolytic phase change at 80% RH, which is why TiF6 (TIFSIX) was substituted [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613]
candidates.synthesis_status: Well established, one-pot from MSiF6 + pyrazine in methanol, fast precipitation, gram scale; benchmark material since 2013.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES for the framework (no OMS, physisorption only), with two strong caveats: the 3.5-3.8 Å pore is at the edge where a rigid 12 Å-cutoff/Ewald treatment of the strongly polarizing F(-) sites is charge-quality-limited, and the material undergoes a water-induced phase change at ≥80% RH that a rigid cell cannot represent — precisely at our RH90 condition. Model it, but register in advance that RH90 output is an upper bound.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH on the ANION axis, LOW on the linker axis. SiF6 / TiF6 / SnF6 / NbOF5(2-) / AlF5(H2O)(2-) are all drop-in isostructural pillars with published CO2 and humid data, giving a clean single-variable series. The pyrazine linker can be methylated (→ SIFSIX-18) but that changes topology/polymorph. Mixed-anion (SiF6/TiF6) solid solutions are an unexplored MTV axis.
candidates.risks: (1) 62% retention at 75% RH is already below our 80% 'valid' gate and would land in the 50-80% 'conditional' band — at RH90 it will be worse. (2) Documented hydrolytic phase change at 80% RH. (3) Qst 45-54 kJ/mol is above the 29.8-41 benchmark band. (4) Metal/anion chemistry shares nothing with the existing ZIF-69 synthesis and relaxation workflow (no Zn-N imidazolate).
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for Nat Commun 2014 (PDF mined), Sci Adv 2019 and Angew 2022 (full text); [요지] for the Chem 2016 0.15 bar value taken from the Chem Sci review table

candidates.name: TIFSIX-3-Ni
candidates.family: Hybrid ultramicroporous material, TiF6-pillared pyrazine square grid
candidates.topology: pcu / α-Po primitive cubic (isostructural with SIFSIX-3-Ni)
candidates.pore_metrics: Ultramicroporous, ~3.7-3.8 Å class; explicit PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 2.39 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, ~2.42 mmol/g at 1 bar, Qst 50 kJ/mol, 298 K [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 citing 10.1039/c7cc02289a]. 1.2 mmol/g at 500 ppm with IAST CO2/N2 = 8090 (highest S_CN in its class); trace isotherm 1.2/1.7/1.9/1.9/2.0 mmol/g at 500/1000/3000/5000/10,000 ppm [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH + TPD, quantitative and unusually well resolved. Dry single-component DCB CO2 uptake 55 cm³/g (0.95 molecules/unit cell, matching theoretical saturation of 1). First-cycle CO2 uptake dry 53.9 vs wet 48.2 cm³/g (89% retention) with breakthrough times 18 vs 16 min/g; desorbed 54 vs 46 cm³/g; cycles 2 and 3 stabilized at 50.8 and 51.2 cm³/g. CRITICAL MECHANISM: with SHORT adsorption cycles (before water breaks through the bed) ~90% of CO2 capacity is retained, but after FULL humid saturation over several hours TPD recovers only 15.7 cm³/g CO2 (0.27 molecules/uc, ~29%) alongside ~240 cm³/g H2O. The retention is therefore KINETIC, not thermodynamic. TIFSIX-3-Ni retains structural stability at 80% RH where SIFSIX-3-Ni undergoes a phase change [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613]
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. Equilibrium H2O uptake ≈240 cm³/g at ~95% RH = 4.1 molecules per unit cell (matches the reported saturation of 4) [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613]. DVS: 7.46 mmol/g at 95% RH [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1] — hydrophilic.
candidates.synthesis_status: Established, same one-pot route as SIFSIX-3-M with (NH4)2TiF6; gram scale.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: FRAMEWORK YES, MECHANISM NO. Physisorption, no OMS, so the force fields apply — but the headline humid result is a slow-water-kinetics / non-equilibrium-cycling effect, and equilibrium GCMC (which is what our pipeline computes) will reproduce the PESSIMISTIC full-saturation number (~29% retention), not the 90% cycling number. This is the clearest published example in the field that a co-adsorption GCMC RH90 result and a real process result can differ by 3x. Useful as a registered caution, not as a target.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH on the anion axis (SiF6/TiF6/NbOF5/SnF6 isostructural series), LOW on the linker axis. Mixed SiF6/TiF6 anion solid solutions would be a genuine MTV composition series with an existing dry+humid baseline for both endpoints.
candidates.risks: (1) Equilibrium RH90 performance is poor (~29% recovery after full water saturation) — our pipeline measures exactly this quantity. (2) Qst 50 kJ/mol above the benchmark band. (3) The 90% claim depends on process cycle design our pipeline does not model. (4) No synthetic overlap with the ZIF line.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] — Angew 2022 full text via PMC9539483 and Sci Adv 2019 full text

candidates.name: NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (KAUST-7)
candidates.family: Hybrid ultramicroporous material, NbOF5-pillared pyrazine square grid
candidates.topology: pcu / α-Po primitive cubic, contracted by pillar tilting
candidates.pore_metrics: Contracted ultramicropore ~3.0-3.5 Å (pillar tilt closes the window relative to SIFSIX-3-Ni); explicit PLD/LCD not reported in accessible text [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 2.2 mmol/g at 1 bar / 298 K, Qst 54 kJ/mol [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 citing 10.1021/jacs.6b05345]; ~2.15 mmol/g at 10,000 ppm and 1.30 mmol/g at 390 ppm [same review]. Trace isotherm 1.3/1.8/2.0/2.1/2.3 mmol/g at 500/1000/3000/5000/10,000 ppm — the highest trace uptake of the six sorbents tested; IAST CO2/N2 = 6528 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH, 298 K, 74% RH — and it is a NEGATIVE result at high RH despite the 'moisture-stable (95% RH)' label carried in review tables. At 3000 ppm CO2/N2, 74% RH: CO2 saturation uptake collapses from ≈1.9 mmol/g (dry) to 0.5 mmol/g, retention time from ~425 to ~128 min/g — a 74% loss. IAST CO2/H2O selectivity S_CW = 0.03 at 74% RH / 500 ppm, i.e. water is preferred ~33:1 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. H2O uptake 10.09 mmol/g at 95% RH (DVS) — the most hydrophilic MOF in the Sci Adv comparison set apart from Mg-MOF-74 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]
candidates.synthesis_status: Established (Eddaoudi group, 2016), lab scale.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES structurally (physisorption, no OMS), and it is a GOOD VALIDATION TARGET precisely because it fails: a correct TIP5P-Ew + DDEC6 co-adsorption calculation should reproduce S_CW << 1 at 74% RH. Recommend using it as a negative control for the water-competition module before trusting any new-framework RH90 number.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Same anion-axis series as SIFSIX/TIFSIX (SiF6/TiF6/NbOF5/SnF6). Its value here is as a series endpoint, not as a candidate.
candidates.risks: Disqualifying as a candidate: water outcompetes CO2 by ~33:1 at 74% RH. The 'moisture-stable (95% RH)' descriptor in review tables refers to STRUCTURAL survival, not retained capacity — a direct example of the label trap this project has been burned by before.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the Sci Adv humid/water data; [요지] for the JACS 2016 primary numbers (publisher 403, no OA copy found)

candidates.name: ALF — aluminum formate, Al(HCOO)3
candidates.family: Metal formate framework
candidates.topology: ReO3-like cubic Al-formate net with alternating small and large cavities
candidates.pore_metrics: Two cavity types: small cavity 43(3) Å³ and large cavity 79(9) Å³ pore volumes (PLATON, 300 K). Channel window sizes 4.561(7) Å (SC/LC channel) and 4.103(19) Å (SC/SC channel). BET 588 ± 8 m²/g [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473]
candidates.co2_015bar: 2.7 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 320 K, ~4 mmol/g at 1 bar, IAST CO2/N2 (85:15) = 368, Qst 47.9 kJ/mol [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2]. Experimental isosteric enthalpy -47.7 kJ/mol at ~1 mmol/g loading; DFT binding -48.4 (small cavity) / -36.2 (large cavity) kJ/mol. Breakthrough with 15/85 CO2/N2 at 323 K: 0.80(1) mmol/g CO2, CO2/N2 selectivity 75(21), N2 <0.1 mmol/g. Saturation CO2 loading ≈4.8 mmol/g by neutron diffraction [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH, quantitative. Columns PRESATURATED with moisture at RH = 80.5% (298 K) then fed 15/85 CO2/N2 retained 70% of their dry CO2 dynamic capacity — i.e. CO2 outcompetes preadsorbed H2O for sites. 50 humid TGA cycles at 3% H2O between 313 and 353 K; 130 dry cycles. Performance largely retained in the presence of SO2 and NO. CAVEAT stated by the authors: ALF's hydrolytic stability envelope is ≈25% RH at 323 K, so it 'cannot be used to directly treat postcombustion flue gas saturated with moisture' and needs upstream drying (cooling/condensation suffices) [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473]
candidates.water_isotherm: YES, measured gravimetrically (Hiden IGAsorp-CT) with RH ramped 0→90/95%→0 at 313/323/333 K under both N2 and CO2 carriers. DFT: H2O binding in the small cavity (-51.3 kJ/mol) is slightly STRONGER than CO2 (-48.4), but in the large cavity CO2 is strongly preferred (-36.2 vs -28.8) — the reason CO2 can displace water [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473]
candidates.synthesis_status: Excellent. Earth-abundant, scalable, cheap (aluminum sulfate/hydroxide + formic acid); stable in 1 M NaOH and 12 M HCl. Among the most deployable frameworks on this list.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES, and it is arguably the cleanest fit after SIFSIX-18. Rigid small-molecule framework, no OMS, no chemisorption, no reported breathing. Formate C/H/O is well covered by UFF_MOF; DDEC6 charges on formate are straightforward; TIP5P-Ew water in a 4.1-4.6 Å window is exactly the CO2-vs-N2 kinetic-sieving regime the pipeline handles. Note: the CO2/N2 discrimination is partly KINETIC (window 4.1-4.56 Å vs CO2 3.3 Å / N2 3.64 Å), and equilibrium GCMC will not reproduce a kinetic sieve.
candidates.mtv_headroom: LOW-MODERATE and this is the main strategic weakness. Formate has no substitutable ring position. Available axes: metal substitution (Al → Fe, Ga, In, Sc formates) and mixed formate/acetate or formate/fluoride anion doping. There is no analogue of the saIm fractional-substitution study; the MTV question this project is built around does not transfer.
candidates.risks: (1) Hydrolytic stability envelope ≈25% RH at 323 K — the authors themselves rule out saturated flue gas. Our RH90 target is far outside it. (2) The 80.5% RH result is a PRESATURATION experiment (water first, then CO2), which is not the same as co-fed RH90 equilibrium co-adsorption — different test, must be labelled as such. (3) Qst 47.7 kJ/mol above the benchmark band. (4) Kinetic sieving is invisible to equilibrium GCMC. (5) Minimal MTV headroom.

candidates.name: ZIF-94 / SIM-1
candidates.family: Zeolitic imidazolate framework (same family as the current ZIF-69 line)
candidates.metal: Zn(II), tetrahedral, no open metal site
candidates.pore_metrics: Sodalite cavity 8.0 Å (vs 11.3 Å for ZIF-8) by simulation; BET 588 m²/g; particle size ~4 nm dodecahedra. PLD not separately reported [미확인] [전문, 10.3390/molecules27175608]
candidates.co2_015bar: 1 bar / 298 K: CO2 53.30 cm³/g = 2.38 mmol/g; N2 6.39 cm³/g = 0.285 mmol/g (ratio 8.34). IAST CO2/N2 (15:85) selectivity 67.11 at 273 K and 54.12 at 298 K. Qst(CO2) 28.23 kJ/mol, Qst(N2) 15.71 kJ/mol at near-zero loading. Dynamic breakthrough capacity from a 15/85 CO2/N2 feed (i.e. 0.15 bar CO2): 32.76 cm³/g = 1.46 mmol/g DRY [전문, 10.3390/molecules27175608]. Explicit static 0.15 bar isotherm point not tabulated [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH at the highest RH in this entire list. 15/85 v/v CO2/N2 at 298 K, 99.2% RH: CO2 breakthrough at 30.4 min vs 33.2 min dry (92% of dry breakthrough time); dynamic saturated CO2 uptake 30.94 cm³/g wet vs 32.76 cm³/g dry = 94.4% RETENTION; dynamic selectivity 30.54 wet. PXRD unchanged before/after. Additional stability: sample exposed to air 4 months → 49.59 cm³/g; soaked in water 2 months → 56.33 cm³/g (vs 53.30 fresh); stable in boiling water ≥24 h [전문, 10.3390/molecules27175608]
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT reported in this paper [미확인]. Hydrophobicity is inferred from the -CH3 group and from the retained performance at 99.2% RH plus 2-month water soaking. This is the single biggest data gap for this candidate.
candidates.synthesis_status: Established and commercial-adjacent (SIM-1 is a known substituted imidazolate material, ZIF-8 analogue routes apply); ZIF-8 itself is sold as Basolite Z-1200.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — the best fit of the entire list for THIS lab. Zn-N tetrahedral imidazolate, SOD topology, no OMS, physisorption only. Identical chemistry class to ZIF-69: the same xtb GFN-FF relaxation, PACMAN DDEC6 charging, audit_orphans.py, Zeo++ gates, and UFF_MOF/Garcia-Sanchez/TIP5P-Ew stack transfer with zero new machinery. The aldehyde C=O is a new functional group for DDEC6 but nothing exotic.
candidates.mtv_headroom: VERY HIGH and directly continuous with the saIm work. The linker carries TWO independent substituent positions (4-methyl, 5-carbaldehyde) on the imidazolate ring. Mixed-linker series: 2-methylimidazolate (ZIF-8) / 4-methyl-5-carbaldehyde (ZIF-94) fractional solid solutions; aldehyde → carboxylic acid, sulfonate (direct saIm analogue), nitrile, imine (post-synthetic condensation with amines). SOD has 24 linker sites per conventional cell, so the same arrangement-vs-composition batch statistics apply — meaning the 8.7 %p batch-unit problem WILL recur and must be budgeted for from the start.
candidates.risks: (1) NO published water isotherm — the RH90 water loading, our co-primary metric, is unmeasured. (2) Qst 28.23 kJ/mol is at the bottom edge of the 29.8-41 benchmark band; working capacity may be low even if retention is excellent. (3) 99.2% RH result is DYNAMIC breakthrough; no equilibrium co-adsorption isotherm exists, so a GCMC RH90 co-adsorption prediction has no experimental counterpart to validate against. (4) SOD cavity 8.0 Å is larger than the 4.0-4.5 Å optimum this project's cavity model identified — the same reason the ZIF-7 candidate collapsed, but in the opposite direction.

candidates.name: ZIF-300 / ZIF-301 / ZIF-302
candidates.family: Zeolitic imidazolate framework, DUAL-LINKER (mixed-metal-free MTV) ZIF
candidates.metal: Zn(II), tetrahedral, no open metal site
candidates.linkers: ZIF-300 = Zn(2-methylimidazolate)0.86(5(6)-bromobenzimidazolate)1.14 ; ZIF-301 = Zn(2-mIm)0.94(5(6)-chlorobenzimidazolate)1.06 ; ZIF-302 = Zn(2-mIm)0.67(5(6)-methylbenzimidazolate)1.33. SMILES: 2-methylimidazolate Cc1ncc[n-]1 ; 5-bromobenzimidazolate Brc1ccc2[n-]cnc2c1 ; 5-chlorobenzimidazolate Clc1ccc2[n-]cnc2c1 ; 5-methylbenzimidazolate Cc1ccc2[n-]cnc2c1
candidates.pore_metrics: BET (Ar, 87 K) 420 / 680 / 240 m²/g for ZIF-300 / 301 / 302. PLD/LCD not reported in accessible sources [미확인] — CHA cages are nominally ~7-8 Å with 8-ring windows ~3.8 Å, but this must be measured with Zeo++ on the actual CIFs, not assumed.
candidates.co2_015bar: 1 bar (800 torr) / 298 K: ZIF-300 1.32 mmol/g, ZIF-301 1.47 mmol/g. IAST CO2/N2 (from Henry constants) 22 and 19; Qst ≈28 and ≈30 kJ/mol. 0.15 bar values not tabulated [미확인] [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 citing 10.1002/anie.201403980]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH (dynamic). 'All three ZIFs are equally effective at the dynamic separation of CO2 from N2 under both dry and humid conditions without any loss of performance over three cycles and can be regenerated simply by using a N2 flow at ambient temperature' [요지, verified abstract of 10.1002/anie.201403980 via Crossref]. The specific RH%, feed composition, and quantitative wet-vs-dry capacities are NOT available to me — publisher 403, no OA copy, no citing OA paper found with the numbers. [미확인]
candidates.water_isotherm: YES and it is the strongest hydrophobicity evidence in this list. Type III water isotherms at 298 K for all three, with uptakes of only 6, 5.8 and 4.5 mg/g (= 0.33, 0.32, 0.25 mmol/g) at P/P0 ≈ 0.8 (i.e. ~80% RH). PXRD-confirmed stability in BOILING WATER for 7 days [전문 of the review 10.1002/advs.201901758 (PMC7029650) reporting the Angew 2014 data]. For scale: that is ~4x lower water uptake than SIFSIX-18-Ni-β and ~30x lower than SIFSIX-3-Ni at comparable RH.
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized by solvothermal reaction of zinc nitrate tetrahydrate + 2-methylimidazole + the respective benzimidazole in DMF/water; single-crystal XRD structures reported. Lab scale.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — full pipeline transfer, same as ZIF-94. Zn-N imidazolate, no OMS, physisorption only, rigid CHA framework with no reported breathing or gate opening. xtb GFN-FF relaxation, PACMAN DDEC6, Zeo++ PLD/LCD gates, UFF_MOF/Garcia-Sanchez/TIP5P-Ew all apply directly. Br and Cl are already in the project's parameter experience (the -Cl flip that exposed the periodic-boundary bug).
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGHEST OF THE ENTIRE LIST, and it is the closest structural analogue to what this project is already doing. These are BY CONSTRUCTION mixed-linker MTV ZIFs: the 2-methylimidazolate : benzimidazolate ratio is a continuous composition axis (0.86:1.14, 0.94:1.06, 0.67:1.33 already realized), and the benzimidazolate 5(6)-position is a substituent axis (Br / Cl / CH3 realized; NO2, CN, SO3H, NH2 unexplored). That is exactly the two-axis design the saIm study wanted, on a topology (CHA) with 8-ring windows near the CO2 kinetic diameter. CRITICAL: the same site-arrangement degeneracy that produced 8.7 %p batch scatter in ZIF-69 will apply, so ensemble sizes must be registered before any run.
candidates.risks: (1) The humid result is qualitative in every source I could reach — no RH%, no wet/dry capacity numbers. Reproducing or quantifying it is itself a contribution but is currently an unverified premise. (2) 1 bar capacity 1.3-1.5 mmol/g is LOW; 0.15 bar will be much lower, and the sub-1 mmol/g regime may put working capacity below the 0.90 mol/kg '월등' threshold before humidity is even considered. (3) Qst 28-30 kJ/mol sits at/below the bottom of the 29.8-41 benchmark band. (4) Bromo/chlorobenzimidazolate linkers are heavy — gravimetric capacity is structurally penalized. (5) REGISTRATION CONFLICT CHECK REQUIRED: the repo already registers ZIF-1001 (npo azolate) and ZIF-2/ZIF-77 as GME-external forks; ZIF-300 is a fourth ZIF fork and must be checked against those registrations before proposing.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] for the Angew 2014 humid claim and the CO2 capacities (publisher 403, verified abstract via Crossref); [전문] for the water isotherm and BET values as reported in the Adv Sci 2020 review full text

candidates.name: MUF-16 (and Mn/Co analogues)
candidates.family: Metal aminoisophthalate framework (Massey University Framework)
candidates.topology: 3D framework with 1D narrow channels; RCSR symbol not reported in accessible text [미확인]
candidates.metal: Co(II) (Mn and Ni analogues exist); metal is coordinatively saturated in the activated form
candidates.pore_metrics: Ultramicroporous with narrow 1D channels; explicit PLD/LCD not reported in accessible sources [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: ~2 mmol/g at 100 kPa / 30 °C (single-component volumetric); N2 essentially zero at the same temperature. Qst(CO2) ≈ 36 kJ/mol — squarely inside the 29.8-41 benchmark band. Explicit 0.15 bar isotherm point not tabulated in the accessible text [미확인]; breakthrough feed used was 14% CO2 / 2% He / balance N2, i.e. ≈0.14 bar CO2 [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH, and it is a SPLIT verdict that must be recorded honestly. POSITIVE (primary): Qazvini and Telfer report excellent sorption kinetics and stability under humidity for more than 100 cycles of breakthrough operation [요지, 10.1021/acsami.1c01156]. NEGATIVE (independent, 2025): when the bed is PRESATURATED with water vapour at 50% and 70% RH at 30 °C and then fed 14% CO2/2% He/N2 at the same humidity, 'the He tracer and CO2 break through at essentially the same time with sharp fronts, demonstrating that in the presence of water at these RH% there is NO COADSORPTION of CO2 with water' [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139]. The authors treat this as a process ADVANTAGE (sharp fronts for a simulated-moving-bed design that keeps the feed zone dry), not as a materials failure — but for an equilibrium RH90 co-adsorption metric it is a zero.
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. Gravimetric H2O isotherms measured at three temperatures (TA VTI-SA+, activated 150 °C/12 h, equilibrated to <0.0001 %/5 min). Described as having a moderate heat of adsorption for H2O. Numerical uptakes not extractable from the accessible text [미확인] [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139]
candidates.synthesis_status: Established; solvothermal from cobalt(II) acetate tetrahydrate + 5-aminoisophthalic acid in methanol. Note a reproducibility subtlety: ppm-level Mn(II) additive is required for consistently high-quality crystals [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139; see also 10.1021/acs.chemmater.4c00137]. Also assessed for SO2 stability under dry and humid streams.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES. Carboxylate framework, no open metal sites in the activated form, physisorption only, no reported flexibility. UFF_MOF covers Co-O carboxylate; PACMAN DDEC6 fine; TIP5P-Ew appropriate. This is a good candidate for a co-adsorption VALIDATION run: the experimental answer at 50-70% RH is known and unambiguous (zero CO2 coadsorption), so if our RH-competition module cannot reproduce it, the module is wrong.
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE. The 5-amino group on isophthalate is a substituent position (amino → nitro, sulfonate, methyl, H, hydroxy — i.e. a direct saIm-style series on a carboxylate rather than an imidazolate). Metal axis: Mn / Co / Ni / Zn isostructural analogues. Two real axes, but the framework is not a 24-site MTV lattice like a ZIF, so the batch-arrangement statistics may be milder.
candidates.risks: (1) The 2025 presaturation experiment shows NO CO2 coadsorption at 50 and 70% RH — at RH90 this is almost certainly a hard zero on our metric. Do not cite the '100 humid cycles' claim without the presaturation caveat. (2) PLD/LCD unpublished, so the Zeo++ PLD ≥3.3 Å gate must be evaluated on the CIF before anything else. (3) Synthesis needs a trace-Mn additive for reproducibility — a hidden variable if anyone tries to make it. (4) The digest lists MUF-16 in the 29.8-41 benchmark band at 32/37 kJ/mol; the value I verified is ~36 kJ/mol — consistent, no correction needed.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the 2025 SMB paper (PMC12616598) including the presaturation result; [요지] for the Qazvini/Telfer primary MUF-16 papers

candidates.name: Qc-5-Cu-sql-β (Cu(Qc)2)
candidates.family: Square-lattice (sql) coordination network, hydrophobic ultramicroporous
candidates.topology: sql — 2D square lattice layers, β polymorph (offset stacking gives the small pore)
candidates.metal: Cu(II) paddlewheel-free square-planar node; no accessible open metal site in the β form
candidates.pore_metrics: Pore size 3.3 Å — a near-exact match to the CO2 kinetic diameter, which is what produces the molecular sieving [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d citing 10.1002/anie.201603934]. Explicit Zeo++ PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 2.16 mmol/g at 1 bar / 293 K; IAST CO2/N2 selectivity 40,000 (the highest reported for any physisorbent in the review's table); Qst 36 kJ/mol — inside the 29.8-41 benchmark band. 0.15 bar value not tabulated [미확인] [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH. 'Dynamic breakthrough experiments further demonstrated that the CO2 separation capacity of Qc-5-Cu-sql-β could also be maintained even at 75% RH.' Structural integrity retained in liquid water for 21 days and in air at 75% RH for 14 days [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d reporting 10.1002/anie.201603934]. Quantitative wet/dry capacity ratio not available to me [미확인] — publisher 403, no OA copy found.
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT located [미확인]. Hydrophobicity is inferred from the aromatic quinoline pore walls, the 3.3 Å aperture, and the 21-day water and 14-day 75% RH stability tests.
candidates.synthesis_status: Straightforward from Cu(II) salts + quinoline-5-carboxylic acid (HQc); β polymorph obtained by controlled crystallization. Lab scale, Zaworotko/Zhang/Chen groups.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: MOSTLY YES. Physisorption, no chemisorption; the Cu node in the sql β form is not an accessible open metal site for guest binding. Rigid framework, no reported breathing. Caution: the 40,000 selectivity is a SIEVING result (N2 is size-excluded at 3.3 Å), and a 3.3 Å aperture is exactly at the boundary where the Zeo++ PLD ≤ 3.3 Å hard gate would REJECT this material — a useful stress test of whether that gate is discarding real winners. Recommend running the gate on the deposited CIF and recording the outcome before drawing conclusions.
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE-HIGH. The quinoline ring has multiple substitutable positions and the isomer series (quinoline-3-, -5-, -6-carboxylate; isoquinoline) is a published pore-size-tuning ladder — the Angew 2016 title is literally 'Tuning Pore Size in Square-Lattice Coordination Networks'. Metal axis Cu/Ni/Zn/Co. Mixed-ligand sql solid solutions are unexplored.
candidates.risks: (1) A 3.3 Å pore sits exactly on our PLD hard gate — the material may be auto-rejected by our own screening, which is itself worth registering as a finding. (2) No water isotherm found, so the co-primary RH90 water loading metric is unconstrained. (3) The 75% RH claim is qualitative in every source reachable to me. (4) 2D sql layers stack by van der Waals contact; layer sliding under water is a plausible failure mode that a rigid 2x2x2 cell cannot see. (5) Cu(II) may still be a partial water-binding site despite the 'no OMS' classification.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] — primary Angew 2016 blocked (403); all values taken from the Chem Sci 2024 review full text, which I read in full

candidates.name: UTSA-120
candidates.family: Pillared square-grid ultramicroporous MOF, nitrogen-rich
candidates.topology: Pillared sql / pcu-type, related to SIFSIX-2-Cu-i
candidates.pore_metrics: Pore similar to SIFSIX-2-Cu-i (5.15 Å class) but with high-density N sites on the tetrazine ring; explicit PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 3.56 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 296 K — the HIGHEST 0.15 bar capacity among the physisorption-only, moisture-tolerant entries in the Chem Sci review's flue-gas table. 5.0 mmol/g at 1 bar; IAST CO2/N2 ≈600; Qst 27-31 kJ/mol — at the low end of the benchmark band, i.e. cheap to regenerate [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 citing 10.1039/c8ta11596f]
candidates.humid_evidence: Classified 'moisture-stable (80% RH)'; carbon-capture performance 'could be completely maintained' after exposure of the sample to air for 1 month. IAST selectivity for simulated flue gas 4x higher than SIFSIX-2-Cu-i [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d]. This is an EXPOSURE/stability result, not a co-adsorption or humid-breakthrough measurement — the wet CO2 capacity at a stated RH was not found [미확인]. Compare NbOFFIVE-1-Ni, which is also labelled 'moisture-stable (95% RH)' yet loses 74% of its capacity at 74% RH: the label does not imply retained capacity.
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT located [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Lab scale (Chen group, J. Mater. Chem. A 2019).
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES structurally (physisorption, SiF6 pillar, no OMS), same class as SIFSIX. The Qst 27-31 kJ/mol combined with 3.56 mmol/g at 0.15 bar makes it the most attractive DRY working-capacity target on this list. But the tetrazine N-rich surface is polar, so the RH90 water competition is genuinely unknown and is the whole question.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH. Two axes: the pillar anion (SiF6/TiF6/NbOF5) and the dipyridyl-tetrazine linker (tetrazine → pyrazine → bipyridyl → functionalized tetrazine), plus mixed-linker solid solutions between the 5.15 Å SIFSIX-2-Cu-i linker and dptz.
candidates.risks: (1) The '80% RH' descriptor is a stability label with NO humid capacity number behind it in any source I could reach — this is exactly the trap NbOFFIVE-1-Ni illustrates. Do not treat as humid-validated. (2) High N-site density is a plausible water-binding liability. (3) No water isotherm. (4) Primary paper (JMCA 2019) not accessible to me; all numbers come from a review table.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] — all values from the Chem Sci 2024 review full text; primary JMCA 2019 not accessible

candidates.name: PCN-250(Fe3) and PCN-250(Fe2Co)
candidates.family: Fe-trimer azobenzenetetracarboxylate MOF
candidates.topology: soc-type, microporous 3D framework, pore apertures ≈5.9 Å
candidates.metal: Fe(III)/Fe(II) trimer [Fe3(μ3-O)(CH3COO)6], or mixed [Fe2Co(μ3-O)(CH3COO)6] — OPEN METAL SITES present after activation
candidates.pore_metrics: Pore apertures centered ≈5.9 Å [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511]. Zeo++ PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 1 bar / 298 K figures only: PCN-250(Fe3) 1.18 mmol/g dry; PCN-250(Fe2Co) 1.32 mmol/g dry. 0.15 bar values not reported in the accessible sources [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: EQUILIBRIUM, and it is the rare MOISTURE-ENHANCED case: at 50% RH and 1 bar / 298 K the CO2 uptake RISES to 1.82 mmol/g for PCN-250(Fe3) (+54%) and 2.23 mmol/g for PCN-250(Fe2Co) (+69%) [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511 Table 1, primary 10.1021/acsami.8b14400 'Unusual Moisture-Enhanced CO2 Capture within Microporous PCN-250 Frameworks']. CAUTION: the Adv Mater 2025 review's Table 1 reference pointers are internally broken (refs 1-10 resolve to unrelated general MOF papers), so the numbers should be re-verified against the ACS AMI 2018 primary before use [미확인].
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT located [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Well established, scalable, one of the more robust Fe-MOFs; PCN-250 is available in gram-to-kg quantities.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO / LIMITED — this is the OMS case the project has already ruled out. The moisture enhancement almost certainly arises from water coordinating to the open Fe/Co sites and creating new polar CO2 binding environments, which is precisely the open-metal-site water chemistry our rigid UFF_MOF + DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew pipeline cannot represent. Modelling it would reproduce a competitive-adsorption penalty and miss the enhancement entirely. Include as a literature counterexample, not as a computational target.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH chemically (metal-mixing Fe3/Fe2Co/Fe2Ni is itself a demonstrated MTV axis, plus ABTC functionalization), but irrelevant given the pipeline limitation.
candidates.risks: (1) OMS-driven mechanism = outside pipeline scope, same reason the earlier OMS route was abandoned. (2) Review-table provenance is unreliable (broken citation pointers); primary paper not accessible to me. (3) Only 1 bar data — no 0.15 bar point. (4) 50% RH, not 90%.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] — Adv Mater 2025 review full text (with a documented citation-integrity problem); primary ACS AMI 2018 DOI verified via Crossref but text not accessible

candidates.name: UTSA-16
candidates.family: Alkali-metal/cobalt citrate framework
candidates.metal: Co(II) + K(I); K ions carry TWO COORDINATED WATER molecules (O3w) in the as-synthesized structure
candidates.pore_metrics: Diamondoid cage ≈4.5 Å in diameter [전문, 10.1038/ncomms1956]. Zeo++ PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: >2 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, with CO2/N2 selectivity >100 [요지, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224 which groups it with Mg-MOF-74 and CALF-20 on this criterion]. Original paper reports 160 cm³/cm³ volumetric CO2 uptake at ambient conditions [전문, 10.1038/ncomms1956]
candidates.humid_evidence: CONTRADICTORY — both directions are published and both must be recorded. NEGATIVE: 'While Mg-MOF-74 and UTSA-16 exhibit a DRASTIC DECREASE of CO2 capacity in wet conditions, CALF-20 is almost insensitive to a water content (up to 20-30% RH)' [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224, citing Masala et al. 10.1021/acsami.6b13216 'CO2 Capture in Dry and Wet Conditions in UTSA-16']. POSITIVE (shaped): 3D-printed UTSA-16 monoliths 'showed reproducible breakthrough behavior without detectable degradation even near 100% RH' [요지, 10.1016/j.cej.2020.126166 as reported in 10.3390/nano16080454]; and 30 wt% UTSA-16 in activated-carbon composite pellets gave 75% higher CO2 capacity and ~1000% higher CO2/N2 selectivity than the parent pellet 'while retaining stability toward humid air, SOx and NOx' [요지, 10.1016/j.jece.2023.109593]. The likely reconciliation is that the shaped-body results are about STRUCTURAL survival and process-level breakthrough, while the Masala equilibrium measurement is about CO2 CAPACITY — the same label-vs-capacity trap as NbOFFIVE-1-Ni.
candidates.water_isotherm: Measured in the Masala 2016/2017 study [10.1021/acsami.6b13216]; numerical values not accessible to me [미확인]. Note the framework contains structural coordinated water on K+ even before any dosing.
candidates.synthesis_status: Excellent — hydrothermal from Co(OAc)2·4H2O + citric acid + KOH in water/ethanol, cheap and green; already shaped into pellets, composites and 3D-printed monoliths.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: LIMITED. The K+ sites with two coordinated waters are effectively open cation sites: water binds there specifically, and our rigid framework + TIP5P-Ew treatment would have to decide whether to include the structural waters as part of the framework (changing the CIF and the DDEC6 charges) or as adsorbate. That choice alone would change the RH90 answer. Also, alkali-cation frameworks are a known weak spot for UFF-type force fields. Treat as not cleanly modelable without a documented protocol decision.
candidates.mtv_headroom: LOW-MODERATE. Citrate is not substitutable in the saIm sense. Axes: alkali cation (K/Na/Rb/Cs) and transition metal (Co/Ni/Mn/Zn). No aromatic ring to functionalize.
candidates.risks: (1) Documented drastic capacity loss under wet equilibrium conditions — the exact metric we measure. (2) K+ coordinated water forces an arbitrary framework/adsorbate partitioning decision that would need pre-registration. (3) The positive humid claims are all for SHAPED bodies (monoliths, composites) and are process results, not material equilibrium results. (4) No aromatic MTV axis.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for Nature Communications 2012 (PDF mined) and the CCST 2024 statement; [요지] for the Masala wet-condition paper and the shaped-body results

candidates.name: MIL-160(Al)
candidates.family: Aluminium furandicarboxylate, CAU-10/MIL-53-related Al-MOF
candidates.topology: cds-related; helical/sinusoidal 1D channels from cis corner-sharing AlO4(OH)2 chains
candidates.pore_metrics: 1D sinusoidal channels ~5-6 Å; explicit Zeo++ PLD/LCD not reported in accessible sources [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 0.95 mmol/g at 30 °C / 0.15 bar; working capacity 0.85 mmol/g between 0.015 and 0.15 bar; adsorption enthalpy -33 kJ/mol (inside the 29.8-41 benchmark band, easy regeneration); IAST CO2/N2 (15:85) = 34 at 1 bar / 303 K [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]
candidates.humid_evidence: PROCESS-SCALE but DRY FEED. A 3-bed 6-step VPSA lab pilot with 60 kg of shaped MIL-160(Al) separating 15/85 vol% CO2/N2 between 0.1 and 2 bar delivered 90% CO2 purity and 92.7% recovery, versus 79.7% purity and 85% recovery for zeolite 13X under identical conditions [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]. The feed was a dry binary mixture — this is NOT humid evidence. No equilibrium CO2/H2O co-adsorption or humid breakthrough at RH ≥30% was found for MIL-160 in any source I could reach [미확인].
candidates.water_isotherm: YES, and it is the disqualifying property. MIL-160(Al) is a benchmark ATMOSPHERIC WATER HARVESTING material with a steep type-V water isotherm and its uptake step at very low relative pressure (~5-10% RH) — it appears repeatedly in water-harvesting mixture-optimization studies [요지, 10.1021/acsengineeringau.5c00051; 10.1039/d3qm00484h]. A framework selected for capturing water from dry air will be water-saturated long before RH90.
candidates.synthesis_status: Excellent — green aqueous synthesis from bio-sourced 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid; already produced at 60 kg and shaped for a VPSA pilot; commercially available.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES technically (rigid Al carboxylate, no OMS, physisorption) — but the interesting answer is already known qualitatively. It would make a good NEGATIVE control for the water-competition module: a correct TIP5P-Ew calculation must show water saturating the pores at low RH and CO2 excluded at RH90.
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE. The furandicarboxylate can be swapped for thiophene-, pyrrole-, pyrazole- or benzene-dicarboxylate within the same Al chain topology (CAU-10 family: CAU-10-H, -CH3, -NO2, -NH2, -OH are all published), giving a real substituent series with published water isotherms — which makes this family a good place to study the water-step position, if not to win on CO2.
candidates.risks: DISQUALIFYING for RH90 flue gas: it is a water-harvesting sorbent. Its water step is at low RH by design. The impressive pilot result is on DRY feed and should not be quoted as humid performance. Also 0.95 mmol/g at 0.15 bar is modest.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the CCST 2024 VPSA pilot paper (PDF mined from the UMons repository); [요지] for the water-harvesting characterization

candidates.name: MIL-120(Al)-AP
candidates.family: Aluminium 1,2,4,5-benzenetetracarboxylate (pyromellitate) MOF
candidates.topology: 3D framework of Al(OH)4O2 octahedra chains delimiting 1D narrow channels along [001]
candidates.metal: Al(III), no open metal site; high density of μ2-OH groups
candidates.pore_metrics: 1D channels with free section ≈5.4 Å × 4.7 Å; BET ≈590 m²/g. Parallel aromatic rings 6.5-7.0 Å apart (out of van der Waals radii) — matching the 'adsorbaphore' motif predicted by Smit et al. for CO2 [전문, 10.1002/advs.202401070]
candidates.co2_015bar: 1.90 mmol/g at 0.10 bar / 298 K (73.1 cm³/cm³); 3.87 mmol/g at 0.9 bar; N2 only 0.32 mmol/g at 0.9 bar. Qst -41 kJ/mol at near-zero coverage, decreasing only ~5 kJ/mol with loading. IAST CO2/N2 ≈90 for both 15:85 and 5:95 at 298 K / 1 bar. Direct 0.15 bar value not tabulated but lies between 1.90 and 3.87 [전문, 10.1002/advs.202401070]
