candidates.humid_evidence: WEAK / NEGATIVE at equilibrium. Operando IR during CO2 adsorption in the presence of 1% H2O (stated as the maximum concentration envisaged after upstream condensation) showed FASTER sorption kinetics for CO2 than H2O, suggesting kinetic CO2/N2 separation is possible in the presence of water with a fast-cycling process design. But CO2/N2 adsorption-desorption cycling on shaped beads under humid conditions showed 'the progressive accumulation of water between each cycle leading to a CO2 capacity decrease in the operating conditions (i.e. without heat or vacuum)'; full capacity was recoverable only after reactivation at 50 °C under vacuum [전문, 10.1002/advs.202401070]. No RH ≥30% equilibrium co-adsorption datum.
candidates.water_isotherm: YES, measured at 298 K for both MIL-120(Al)-HP and -AP; the authors state the high density of μ2-OH groups confers 'a rather hydrophilic character' and that MIL-120 is 'slightly more hydrophilic than CALF-20'. Numerical uptakes are in the SI, not the main text [미확인] [전문, 10.1002/advs.202401070]
candidates.synthesis_status: Outstanding. Green ambient-pressure aqueous route, kilogram scale demonstrated, shaped into beads with 10% silica or 10% bentonite with retained sorption; techno-economic production cost ≈13 $/kg at kton scale — among the lowest ever reported for a MOF (vs ≈25-30 $/kg for CALF-20).
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES — clean rigid Al-carboxylate, no OMS, no chemisorption, no reported breathing. Good target for the full stack. The μ2-OH groups are strong specific water sites and will dominate the TIP5P-Ew result, so this is a sharp test of whether the corrected water force field (Hw none / Lw none) behaves sensibly on hydroxyl-lined pores.
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE. The benzene ring of BTeC is fully substituted by carboxylates, so ring functionalization is blocked — but the MIL-120/MIL-121 pair shows that carboxylate connectivity itself is a variable (MIL-121 leaves two carboxylates free and pointing into the channel), and Al → Ga/In/Fe/Sc substitution is available. Mixed BTeC/trimesate or BTeC/terephthalate solid solutions are unexplored.
candidates.risks: (1) Hydrophilic by design (dense μ2-OH); humid cycling shows progressive water accumulation. RH90 prospects are poor. (2) The only humid demonstration is at 1% H2O with operando IR, far below RH30. (3) The kinetic-separation argument is invisible to equilibrium GCMC. (4) No aromatic MTV position.

candidates.name: MAF-X27ox and MAF-X25ox
candidates.family: Metal benzobistriazolate framework with monodentate hydroxide active sites
candidates.metal: Co or Mn, mixed-valence, with MONODENTATE HYDROXIDE at the metal — a reactive site, not a physisorption site
candidates.pore_metrics: Not reported in accessible sources [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: MAF-X25ox 4.08 mmol/g and MAF-X27ox 4.06 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 298 K — 410% and 540% larger than their unfunctionalized precursors. 1 bar: 7.14 and 6.70 mmol/g (up from 5.4 and 4.2). CO2/N2 selectivity 250 and 262-264 (8.6x and 9.2x the precursors). Qst rises from 38 and 28 kJ/mol to 120 and 124 kJ/mol (review text also quotes 99 and 110) [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 and text, citing 10.1039/c4ee02717e]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH, and the contrast is the whole point: 'the breakthrough curves of MAF-X27ox were NEARLY THE SAME in both dry and high-humidity environments, while its precursor almost could not capture CO2 from the wet mixture of CO2 and N2' [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d reporting 10.1039/c4ee02717e, whose title is 'Monodentate hydroxide as a super strong yet reversible active site for CO2 capture from high-humidity flue gas']. Specific RH% and quantitative wet capacities not accessible to me [미확인].
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT located [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Lab scale (Chen X.-M. / Zhang J.-P. groups, EES 2015); made by controlled oxidation of the MAF-X25/X27 precursors.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO. Qst of 120-124 kJ/mol is unambiguously CHEMISORPTION — the monodentate hydroxide reacts with CO2 to form bicarbonate, exactly the reaction class our project has recorded as unmodellable. Rigid GCMC with UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 cannot represent bond formation. Include for context and as evidence that hydroxide-not-amine is a viable humid-tolerant chemistry, but do not put it in the computational queue.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH chemically (bbta ring substitution; Mn/Co/Fe/Ni metal axis; partial oxidation degree as a continuous 'composition' variable) — but irrelevant to a physisorption pipeline.
candidates.risks: (1) Chemisorption — outside pipeline scope, same exclusion as amine carbamate/bicarbonate. (2) Qst 120+ kJ/mol implies a very large regeneration duty that the 298→373 K TSA window may not even reverse. (3) All numbers reach me through a review; primary EES 2015 not accessible.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] — Chem Sci 2024 review full text; primary EES 2015 DOI verified via Crossref but text not accessible

candidates.name: KHCO3 CD-MOF (cyclodextrin MOF, CD-MOF-2 family)
candidates.family: Alkali-metal γ-cyclodextrin framework
candidates.metal: K(I) (also Na, Rb, Cs variants); charge-balancing OH-/HCO3- anions are the active sites
candidates.linkers: γ-cyclodextrin (cyclic octamer of α-1,4-D-glucopyranose) — renewable, food-grade
candidates.pore_metrics: Not reported in accessible sources [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: 0.63 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 313 K [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2]. Primary: 2.78 mmol/g volumetric and 2.09 mmol/g isobaric at 1 bar CO2 / 30 °C; 1.26 mmol/g by TGA under a 15% CO2/N2 stream; Qst 49.5 ± 1.8 kJ/mol [전문, OSTI copy of 10.1002/anie.202206718]
candidates.humid_evidence: BREAKTHROUGH, quantitative, but BELOW the RH ≥30% threshold. Dry 15% CO2 in N2 at 40 °C, 25 sccm, 0.520 g: breakthrough CO2 capacity 1.18 ± 0.05 mmol/g (n=3), sharp front, N2 <0.1 mmol/g, reproducible over three cycles with 40 °C He reactivation. Humidified 15% CO2/N2 at 40 °C after pre-humidifying with humid He (≈23% RH at 20 °C): CO2 capacity 0.43 mmol/g versus 1.13 mmol/g dry (cycle 3) = 38% RETENTION; selective CO2 binding over N2 still observed; crystallinity retained by PXRD after the humid run [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206718 accepted manuscript]
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT reported in the accessible manuscript [미확인]. The capacity loss is attributed by the authors to water filling the pores.
candidates.synthesis_status: Cheap, green, food-grade precursors (γ-cyclodextrin + KHCO3), solvothermal; the KHCO3 variant is new and has the best thermal and cycling stability of the CD-MOFs studied. Oxidation-resistant, which is its distinguishing advantage over amines.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO. CO2 is captured by nucleophilic attack of the charge-balancing hydroxide to form (bi)carbonate — chemisorption at OH- sites, explicitly analogised by the authors to carbonic anhydrase. Qst 49.5 kJ/mol and the bicarbonate mechanism put it outside the rigid-GCMC physisorption pipeline.
candidates.mtv_headroom: MODERATE (alkali cation K/Na/Rb/Cs; counteranion OH-/HCO3-/CO3(2-)/OAc-/OBz-/Cl- — the paper is essentially an anion-MTV study) but irrelevant given chemisorption.
candidates.risks: (1) Chemisorption — outside scope. (2) Humid test was at ≈23% RH, BELOW the ≥30% RH bar this survey set, and retention was only 38%. (3) 0.15 bar capacity 0.63 mmol/g is low. (4) The digest's mention of 'CD-MOF-2' should be updated: the humid-tested material in the current literature is KHCO3 CD-MOF, not CD-MOF-2 as such.

candidates.name: Mg-MOF-74 / Mg2(dobdc) — REGISTERED NEGATIVE
candidates.family: M-MOF-74 / CPO-27 open-metal-site framework
candidates.metal: Mg(II) with a HIGH DENSITY OF OPEN METAL SITES after activation
candidates.pore_metrics: 1D channels ~11 Å; explicit PLD/LCD not extracted [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: Leading gravimetric capacity 8.04 mmol/g at 1 bar / 298 K [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473 citing the literature]. Trace region is poor: 0.05 / 0.2 / 0.5 / 0.9 / 1.6 mmol/g at 500 / 1000 / 3000 / 5000 / 10,000 ppm; N2 0.85 mmol/g at 1 bar; Qst 42 kJ/mol; IAST CO2/N2 238 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]
candidates.humid_evidence: NEGATIVE, and it is the canonical negative for this whole field. (a) 'Competition and reaction with atmospheric moisture significantly reduced their DAC performance' for all four physisorbents tested including Mg-MOF-74 [요지, verified abstract of 10.1002/anie.201506952]. (b) 'Mg-MOF-74 and UTSA-16 exhibit a drastic decrease of CO2 capacity in wet conditions' [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]. (c) The classic quantitative study is Kizzie, Wong-Foy and Matzger, 'Effect of Humidity on the Performance of Microporous Coordination Polymers as Adsorbents for CO2 Capture', Langmuir 2011, 27, 6368-6373 [DOI verified via Crossref; full text not accessible to me, so the specific retention percentages are 미확인]. (d) Liu, Wang, Benin, Jakubczak, Willis and LeVan, 'CO2/H2O Adsorption Equilibrium and Rates on Metal-Organic Frameworks: HKUST-1 and Ni/DOBDC', Langmuir 2010, 26, 14301 [DOI verified; text not accessible].
candidates.water_isotherm: YES — and it is decisive. H2O uptake ≈33.33 mmol/g at 95% RH, 298 K, the highest of the whole comparison set and ~4x the CO2 capacity at 1 bar [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercial, extremely well studied.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO. Open metal sites: water coordinates directly to the Mg(II) centre, which is the exact chemistry our project has recorded as unmodellable. The dry CO2 isotherm is also OMS-dominated and UFF_MOF will not reproduce it. Value here is purely as a registered negative and as a sanity check that any RH90 module predicts catastrophic water preference.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Not applicable — excluded on mechanism.
candidates.risks: Excluded. Use only as the negative anchor of a benchmark figure.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the Sci Adv 2019 water/CO2 table and the CCST 2024 statement; [요지] for the Angew 2015 DAC abstract; [미확인] for the Kizzie and Liu retention percentages

candidates.name: HKUST-1 / Cu3(BTC)2 — REGISTERED NEGATIVE
candidates.family: Cu paddlewheel tricarboxylate framework
candidates.metal: Cu(II) paddlewheel with OPEN METAL SITES after activation
candidates.pore_metrics: Cages ~5, 11, 13.5 Å with ~6 Å windows; PLD/LCD not extracted here [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: Not extracted from a primary source in this survey [미확인]
candidates.humid_evidence: MIXED-then-NEGATIVE, and the low-RH result is a trap worth recording. AT VERY LOW RH IT HELPS: Cu-HKUST-1 shows an approximately 5 wt% INCREASE in CO2 uptake in the presence of 2-4% relative humidity, consistent with earlier reports that water coordinated to the framework open metal sites raises CO2 uptake and CO2/N2 selectivity [전문, 10.3389/fchem.2025.1634637 reporting the Chanut et al. 45-MOF thermogravimetric screening]. AT REAL HUMIDITY IT FAILS: 'their performance can be strongly influenced by guest activation and stability in humid environments' [요지, 10.3390/nano16080454]; and HKUST-1 was one of the four physisorbents whose DAC performance was 'significantly reduced' by atmospheric moisture [요지, 10.1002/anie.201506952]. Quantitative RH ≥30% retention: see Kizzie 10.1021/la200547k and Liu/LeVan 10.1021/la102359q, neither accessible to me [미확인].
candidates.water_isotherm: Measured in 10.1021/la102359q (CO2/H2O adsorption equilibrium AND rates on HKUST-1 and Ni/DOBDC); values not accessible [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Commercial (Basolite C300), the most studied MOF in existence.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NO — Cu paddlewheel open metal sites, with the documented humidity effect operating precisely through water coordination at those sites. Outside pipeline scope.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Not applicable — excluded on mechanism.
candidates.risks: Excluded. Its main use is as a cautionary datum: a MOF can show a small CO2 IMPROVEMENT at 2-4% RH and still fail completely at flue-gas humidity. Any low-RH enhancement claim in this literature should be checked for whether it was measured below ~5% RH.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] for the Frontiers in Chemistry 2025 review passage on the Chanut screening; [요지] for the Angew 2015 abstract; [미확인] for all RH ≥30% quantitative retention

candidates.name: Zeolite 13X — NON-MOF REFERENCE NEGATIVE
candidates.family: Aluminosilicate zeolite (FAU)
candidates.topology: FAU (faujasite): supercages ≈13 Å connected by 7.4 Å windows
candidates.metal: Na(I) extraframework cations in an aluminosilicate framework
candidates.pore_metrics: Supercage ≈13 Å, window 7.4 Å [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511]
candidates.co2_015bar: Trace region 0.4 / 0.9 / 1.4 / 1.7 / 2.0 mmol/g at 500 / 1000 / 3000 / 5000 / 10,000 ppm; N2 0.42 mmol/g at 1 bar; Qst 39 kJ/mol; IAST CO2/N2 562 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]. ≈180 mg/g (≈4.1 mmol/g) at 1 bar / 298 K dry [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511]
candidates.humid_evidence: NEGATIVE and total. Breakthrough at 74% RH, 3000 ppm CO2/N2: capacity falls to 0.1 mmol/g with a retention time of ~20 min/g — essentially complete loss [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]. At 100% RH the CO2 uptake goes to ≈0 mg/g because 'water rapidly occupies Na+ sites, displacing CO2' [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511]. In the VPSA pilot on DRY 15/85 feed it also underperformed MIL-160(Al): 79.7% purity / 85% recovery vs 90% / 92.7% [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224].
candidates.water_isotherm: YES. 18.76 mmol/g at 95% RH, 298 K — second only to Mg-MOF-74 in the comparison set [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]
candidates.synthesis_status: Industrial commodity; the incumbent this whole field is trying to displace.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: NOT with this pipeline (extraframework Na+ cations, no UFF_MOF/DDEC6 protocol registered for zeolites). Value is as the industrial reference line in any figure: it defines what 'water kills it' looks like quantitatively.
candidates.mtv_headroom: Not applicable.
candidates.risks: Excluded as a candidate; include as the incumbent baseline. Note it needs deep drying (dew point -40 °C) in service, which is the cost that any humid-tolerant sorbent is competing against.
candidates.evidence_grade: [전문] — Sci Adv 2019 Table 1 and CCST 2024 pilot data

candidates.name: Zn2(Atz)2(ox) — design precedent, not a validated humid candidate
candidates.family: Zn aminotriazolate-oxalate (the direct chemical ancestor of CALF-20)
candidates.topology: Layered Zn-triazolate sheets pillared by oxalate, closely related to CALF-20
candidates.pore_metrics: Not extracted [미확인]
candidates.co2_015bar: Not extracted from an accessible source [미확인]. The Science 2010 paper's contribution was direct crystallographic observation and quantification of CO2 binding at the amine-functionalized site rather than a flue-gas capacity table.
candidates.humid_evidence: NONE FOUND at RH ≥30%. I could not locate any humid CO2 co-adsorption or humid breakthrough measurement for Zn2(Atz)2(ox) in any accessible source [미확인]. It appears in the water-stable MOF review's index but not in its flue-gas performance table.
candidates.water_isotherm: NOT located [미확인]
candidates.synthesis_status: Synthesized and single-crystal characterized (Vaidhyanathan, Shimizu and co-workers, Science 2010, 330, 650); the same group later produced CALF-20.
candidates.pipeline_modelable: YES in principle — Zn-N triazolate + oxalate, no OMS, physisorption; the amine is a functional group on the ring, not a grafted reactive amine, so no carbamate chemistry. Same modelling class as CALF-20.
candidates.mtv_headroom: HIGH and strategically interesting: Zn2(Atz)2(ox) and CALF-20 differ ONLY by the 3-amino substituent on the triazolate ring. That is a ready-made two-endpoint MTV series (triazolate ↔ 3-aminotriazolate, plus the CALF-20M methyl variants) on a framework whose parent is the field benchmark. A fractional-substitution study across that series is the closest available analogue of the saIm050 work on a topology that actually survives wet flue gas.
candidates.risks: (1) NO humid data exists — this is a design precedent, not an experimentally proven humid physisorbent, and must not be listed as one. (2) The -NH2 group is a water-binding site and may well destroy the hydrophobicity that makes CALF-20 work; that is the hypothesis, not a known answer. (3) 0.15 bar capacity unverified.
candidates.evidence_grade: [요지] — Science 2010 DOI and title verified via Crossref; full text not accessible; no humid measurement located

not_found: Fe2(bdp)3 — no published CO2 uptake at ~0.15 bar/298 K combined with an RH>=30% humid measurement could be confirmed. Fe2(bdp)3 (Fe 1,4-benzenedipyrazolate) is documented for hydrocarbon-isomer separation and for kinetic stability toward corrosive gases (10.1038/s41578-019-0140-1), not as a humid flue-gas CO2 physisorbent. Searched Crossref, OpenAlex and Europe PMC; the only OpenAlex hit under 'Fe2(bdp)3 CO2 humid' was a general stability review. Recommend removing it from the target list unless the requester has a specific citation.

MOF-303 (Al pyrazoledicarboxylate) — CO2 isotherms confirmed (5.1 mmol/g at 25 C/1 bar solution-synthesized; 5.5 mmol/g at 25 C and 9.5 mmol/g at 0 C/1 bar ball-milled; BET 994-1180 m2/g; pore ~6 A; >50 cycles stable; 10.3390/molecules29112698, full text read) but NO humid CO2 co-adsorption or humid breakthrough at RH>=30% was found. MOF-303 is a benchmark water-harvesting framework whose water isotherm steps at low RH, so it is expected to fail at RH90; it belongs in the negative column, not the candidate column.

Aluminium fumarate (Basolite A520 / MIL-53(Al)-FA) — no paper with both a ~0.15 bar/298 K CO2 value and an RH>=30% humid CO2 measurement could be confirmed. Europe PMC and OpenAlex searches returned only reviews, heat-exchanger and water-sorption papers. Al-fumarate is primarily studied as a water/heat-transformation sorbent.

CD-MOF-2 specifically — the humid CO2 evidence in the current literature is for KHCO3 CD-MOF (10.1002/anie.202206718), not for CD-MOF-2 as originally named, and its humid test was at ~23% RH (below the RH>=30% bar) with 38% retention. No RH>=30% measurement for CD-MOF-2 itself was located.

ZIF-300 / ZIF-301 / ZIF-302 quantitative humid numbers — the Angew 2014 abstract (verified via Crossref) states dynamic CO2/N2 separation 'under both dry and humid conditions without any loss of performance over three cycles', but the RH%, feed composition and wet-vs-dry capacities are not in the abstract. Wiley returned 403 to both curl and WebFetch; no OA copy, repository deposit or citing OA paper carrying the numbers was found. This is the single most valuable missing datum in this survey given the family's MTV relevance.

SIFSIX-3-Ni primary humid flue-gas measurement — the 62%-of-dry retention at 0.15 bar CO2 / 0.85 bar N2 / 75% RH is quoted (with citations to 10.1002/anie.201506952 and 10.1039/c7cc02289a) inside the full text of 10.1002/anie.202206613, which I read. I could NOT open either primary paper to confirm the measurement conditions first-hand; both are Wiley/RSC 403 with no OA copy.

Kizzie, Wong-Foy & Matzger, Langmuir 2011, 27, 6368-6373 (10.1021/la200547k) — DOI and title verified via Crossref, but the paper is closed and no OA copy exists. The specific per-material CO2 retention percentages after humid exposure (the canonical HKUST-1 / Mg-MOF-74 / M-MOF-74 negative numbers) could not be retrieved and are marked [미확인] throughout.

Liu, Wang, Benin, Jakubczak, Willis & LeVan, Langmuir 2010, 26, 14301 (10.1021/la102359q), 'CO2/H2O Adsorption Equilibrium and Rates on MOFs: HKUST-1 and Ni/DOBDC' — DOI verified, text not accessible.

CALF-20 Science 2021 primary text (10.1126/science.abi7281) — science.org returns 403 to both curl and WebFetch; no OA copy, repository deposit or PMC record exists. All CALF-20 primary numbers here are second-hand from OA papers that cite it. Its exact humid CO2 isotherm/breakthrough numbers at 40% RH remain unverified at source.

CALF-20 competitive CO2/H2O studies — three exist (10.1021/acs.iecr.3c04266 'Competitive CO2/H2O Adsorption on CALF-20'; 10.1021/acsami.3c11092 'Elucidating the Competitive Adsorption of H2O and CO2 in CALF-20'; 10.1016/j.seppur.2024.128269 'Elucidating the failure of IAST for CO2/H2O mixture adsorption in CALF-20'). ChemRxiv returned 403; ACS returned 403; the UvA repository PDF of the third downloaded but its body text is in an encoding my pure-Python extractor could not decode (only the cover page recovered). These three papers are the highest-value next fetch for anyone with journal access.
SU-101 (bismuth ellagate) — no CO2-at-0.15-bar plus RH>=30% dataset located.

TAMOF-1 humid numbers — a review table reports 1.68 mmol/g at 0.15 bar/40% RH (>95% retention, 20 humid cycles) and 1.55 mmol/g at 60% RH for this Cu/L-histidine MOF, but that table (10.1002/adma.202515511) has demonstrably broken citation pointers (its refs 1-10 resolve to unrelated general MOF papers), and I could not find the primary source. Treat as unverified; worth chasing because the numbers, if real, are strong.
Zn2(Atz)2(ox) humid data — none found at any RH.

ZnF(daTZ) / ZnF(aTZ) / ZnF(TZ) humid data — 0.15 bar capacities are tabulated in 10.1039/d3sc06076d (0.96 / 0.56 / 0.27 mmol/g; selectivity 120 / 46 / 13; Qst 33 / 32.3 / 23.6; pH 1-12 stable) and the primary paper is titled 'Robust Metal-Triazolate Frameworks for CO2 Capture from Flue Gas' (10.1021/jacs.9b12879, DOI verified), but the paper is closed with no OA copy and no humid measurement is reported in the review. Flagged because the daTZ/aTZ/TZ series is an explicit triazolate substitution ladder directly analogous to the saIm series.

UTSA-16 wet-condition quantitative numbers (Masala et al., 10.1021/acsami.6b13216) — DOI verified, ACS 403, no OA copy. Only the qualitative 'drastic decrease' summary from 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224 was obtainable.
NbOFFIVE-1-Ni primary paper (10.1021/jacs.6b05345) — DOI verified, ACS 403, no OA copy including the KAUST repository. All values are second-hand.
Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta primary paper (10.1002/anie.201603934) — DOI verified, Wiley 403, no OA copy.
UTSA-120 primary paper (10.1039/c8ta11596f) — DOI verified, RSC 403, no OA copy.
PCN-250 moisture-enhanced primary paper (10.1021/acsami.8b14400) — DOI verified, ACS 403, no OA copy.

Zeo++-style PLD/LCD values for most candidates — only CALF-20 (PLD ~3 A / LCD ~4.3 A) and ALF (windows 4.561/4.103 A) have explicit aperture numbers in the accessible literature. For SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta, TIFSIX-3-Ni, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni, MUF-16, Qc-5-Cu, UTSA-120, MAF-X27ox and the ZIF-300 family, PLD/LCD must be computed with 'network -ha -res' on the deposited CIFs before the PLD >= 3.3 A gate can be applied. This is a prerequisite, not an optional step, since the PLD gate becomes formal for the next structure generation and new frameworks are that generation.
result.notes:
TOOLING CONSTRAINT (affects coverage, stated up front): the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted before my first search returned, so this survey was built entirely from direct API and repository access via curl — Crossref (/works and /works/{doi}), OpenAlex (/works and /works/doi:), Europe PMC (search + fullTextXML), OSTI, HAL, pure.uva.nl and orbi.umons.ac.be — plus a pure-Python PDF text extractor I wrote (zlib + text-operator parsing) because pdftotext, pypdf and pip are all absent from this machine. science.org, pubs.acs.org, onlinelibrary.wiley.com, pubs.rsc.org, mdpi.com and chemrxiv.org all return 403 to both curl and WebFetch. Every DOI in this output was verified by a live Crossref /works/{doi} call; none was written from memory. Where a number reached me only through a review, I say so and grade it [요지].

EVIDENCE-QUALITY WARNING, and it applies to a source that looks authoritative. The Adv Mater 2025 review 'Advanced Porous Materials for Maritime Carbon Capture' (10.1002/adma.202515511) contains the single most convenient table in this survey — dry-vs-humid CO2 uptake at stated pressure and RH for CALF-20, SIFSIX-3-Ni, PCN-250, FJI-H14, TAMOF-1, Zeolite 13X and others. I resolved its table citations and they are BROKEN: Table 1 refs [1]-[10] point to Yaghi Nature 1995, Li/Kuppler/Zhou CSR 2009, Furukawa Science 2013, Eddaoudi Science 2002 and similar general MOF papers that contain none of the tabulated data. I have therefore graded every number taken from that table [미확인] and, where possible, replaced it with a value from a source I read in full. Anyone re-using this survey should not promote those numbers without finding the real primary. This is the same failure mode as the Kwon 2025 mis-attribution recorded in V5_RULERS_20260824.md §1 — a plausible citation that does not say what it is cited for.

WHAT THE HUMID EVIDENCE ACTUALLY SHOWS, at the level of the registered rulers. Sorting the 21 entries by whether they carry a real RH>=30% CO2 measurement rather than a stability label:
  (a) Quantified retention at RH>=30%: ZIF-94/SIM-1 94.4% at 99.2% RH (dynamic breakthrough, 15/85 feed) — the highest RH and the highest retention in the whole list; TIFSIX-3-Ni 89% first cycle at ~95% RH by short-cycle DCB but only ~29% after full humid saturation; ALF 70% after 80.5% RH presaturation; SIFSIX-3-Ni 62% at 0.15 bar/75% RH; KHCO3 CD-MOF 38% at ~23% RH; NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 26% at 74% RH; Zeolite 13X ~7% at 74% RH and ~0% at 100% RH.
  (b) Qualitative only ('maintained', 'no loss'): ZIF-300/301/302, Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta, MAF-X27ox, CALF-20 at 40% RH.
  (c) Stability label with NO capacity number: UTSA-120 ('moisture-stable 80% RH'), and this is where NbOFFIVE-1-Ni is the warning — it is labelled 'moisture-stable (95% RH)' in review tables and loses 74% of its capacity at 74% RH. Structural survival and retained capacity are different quantities. Any new-framework proposal that cites a '% RH stable' label as humid evidence is repeating the mistake this repo has already been burned by four times.
Applying the registered water gate (RH90 retention >=80% valid / 50-80% conditional / <50% terminate) to the entries that have numbers: only ZIF-94 clears 80%; TIFSIX-3-Ni and ALF and SIFSIX-3-Ni land in the conditional band; NbOFFIVE-1-Ni, KHCO3 CD-MOF and Zeolite 13X terminate. Note none of these were measured at exactly RH90/2852.1 Pa, so none is a like-for-like comparison with our own numbers — they are different tests, and per CLAUDE.md §2 they should be written up as such.

THE THREE CANDIDATES THAT ACTUALLY FIT THIS PROJECT, and why. The brief asked for humid physisorbents generally, but the constraint that matters here is what the existing pipeline and the existing MTV question can carry:
  1. ZIF-94 / SIM-1 (SOD, Zn, 4-methyl-5-imidazolecarboxaldehyde). Same Zn-N imidazolate chemistry as ZIF-69: xtb GFN-FF relaxation, PACMAN DDEC6, audit_orphans.py, Zeo++ gates and the UFF_MOF/Garcia-Sanchez/TIP5P-Ew stack all transfer with zero new machinery. Best humid evidence in the survey (94.4% retention at 99.2% RH, dynamic). Two independent substituent positions on the ring plus a documented ZIF-8 solid-solution partner. Its gaps are exactly the two things our pipeline computes best: it has NO published water isotherm and NO equilibrium co-adsorption measurement, so a computed RH90 water loading and CO2/H2O co-adsorption curve would be a genuine addition rather than a re-derivation.
  2. ZIF-300/301/302 (CHA, Zn, dual-linker). The only entries in this survey that are MTV BY CONSTRUCTION — the 2-methylimidazolate : benzimidazolate ratio is already realized at 0.86:1.14, 0.94:1.06 and 0.67:1.33, and the benzimidazolate 5(6)-position carries Br, Cl and CH3 with SO3H unexplored. That is precisely the two-axis design the saIm study wanted, on a topology whose 8-ring windows sit near the CO2 kinetic diameter, with type-III water isotherms at 0.25-0.33 mmol/g at ~80% RH (roughly 4x more hydrophobic than SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta and ~30x more than SIFSIX-3-Ni) and boiling-water stability for 7 days. The catch is capacity: 1.32-1.47 mmol/g at 1 bar means the 0.15 bar figure will be small, and Qst 28-30 kJ/mol sits at or below the bottom of the 29.8-41 benchmark band. Before proposing this, check it against the ZIF-1001 (npo), ZIF-2 (crb) and ZIF-77 (frl) forks already registered in MAGI-003 — this would be a fourth ZIF fork and the registration conflict must be resolved first.
  3. CALF-20 and its ancestor Zn2(Atz)2(ox). Not as a candidate to beat but as a substitution series: CALF-20 (triazolate) / Zn2(Atz)2(ox) (3-aminotriazolate) / CALF-20M (methyltriazolate) are three points on one composition axis, on the field's benchmark framework, where the water-step position is the dependent variable. That is a smaller, better-posed question than 'find a new winner', and it has published endpoints at both ends.

THREE FINDINGS THAT SHOULD CHANGE HOW A NEW-FRAMEWORK RUN IS REGISTERED, not just which framework is picked:
  1. Equilibrium and process humidity results diverge by 3x in the same material. TIFSIX-3-Ni retains ~90% of CO2 with short adsorption cycles (water has not yet permeated the bed) but only ~29% after full humid saturation. The authors are explicit that the retention is KINETIC. Our pipeline computes the equilibrium number — i.e. the pessimistic one. MUF-16 is the same story in starker form: 100+ humid breakthrough cycles reported by its discoverers, yet an independent 2025 study found ZERO CO2 coadsorption once the bed is presaturated at 50% and 70% RH. Whatever new framework is chosen, the registered claim must say which of the two quantities is being computed, because the literature it will be compared against mostly reports the other one.
  2. Water preference is the discriminator, and it is already tabulated. The SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta paper (10.1126/sciadv.aax9171) gives H2O uptake at 95% RH for seven materials on one instrument: SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta 1.64, ZIF-8 1.44, TIFSIX-3-Ni 7.46, SIFSIX-3-Ni 8.80, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 10.09, Zeolite 13X 18.76, Mg-MOF-74 ~33.33 mmol/g. Rank order of humid CO2 retention follows this column almost exactly and follows dry CO2 capacity not at all. Given that our project has already made RH90 water loading a co-primary metric (DESIGN_STUDY §1-5), this table is a ready-made external calibration set for the corrected TIP5P-Ew force field — seven materials, one instrument, one condition. That is the first external humid benchmark this project would have; the digest currently records 'external benchmarks on the humid axis: 0'. Recommend running the corrected force field against these seven before trusting any new-framework RH90 number, and note NbOFFIVE-1-Ni in particular is a sharp negative control (published IAST CO2/H2O selectivity 0.03 at 74% RH — water preferred ~33:1).
  3. Independent convergence on the geometric motif. A 19k-MOF GCMC + process-optimization screen at 40% RH concluded that 'narrow, straight 1D-channels were a common structural motif for low energy wet flue gas CO2 capture' (10.1021/acscentsci.5c00777, full text read). The experimentally validated entries here agree: ALF windows 4.10-4.56 A, MIL-120(Al) channels 5.4 x 4.7 A, CALF-20 PLD ~3 A / LCD ~4.3 A, Qc-5-Cu 3.3 A, SIFSIX-3-M 3.5-3.84 A. This is consistent with the 4.0-4.5 A optimum our own cavity model produced and with the gme wall-distance ceiling of 3.32-3.48 A. Worth noting that Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta, a working humid sorbent with IAST CO2/N2 of 40,000, has a 3.3 A pore that our PLD <= 3.3 A hard gate would REJECT. That gate becomes formal for the next structure generation, and new frameworks are that generation — so it is worth deciding deliberately whether the gate is set to exclude a real class of winners, and recording that decision before any new-framework screen runs rather than after.

CORRECTIONS AND CONFIRMATIONS TO THE SUPPLIED DIGEST: (a) MUF-16 is listed in the benchmark band at '32/37' kJ/mol; the value I verified is ~36 kJ/mol CO2 (10.1021/acsami.5c16139) — consistent, no change needed. (b) 'CD-MOF-2' should be updated to KHCO3 CD-MOF: the humid-tested cyclodextrin MOF in the current literature is the KHCO3 variant, its mechanism is hydroxide-to-bicarbonate CHEMISORPTION (Qst 49.5 kJ/mol), and its humid test was at ~23% RH with 38% retention — it is not a physisorbent and does not meet the RH>=30% bar. (c) Four entries on the requested list are chemisorbents or OMS materials and are therefore outside the pipeline by the project's own registered exclusion, not by my judgement: MAF-X25ox/X27ox (Qst 120-124 kJ/mol, monodentate hydroxide to bicarbonate), KHCO3 CD-MOF, PCN-250 (moisture enhancement operates through water coordinated at open Fe/Co sites), and Mg-MOF-74/HKUST-1. (d) Fe2(bdp)3 could not be confirmed as a humid CO2 material at all and I recommend dropping it from the target list.

roster.name: ZIF-300 / ZIF-301 / ZIF-302 (CHA dual-linker MTV ZIF)
roster.family: azolate — Zn(II) tetrahedral imidazolate, CHA (chabazite) topology, by-construction mixed-linker
roster.one_line: The closest structural AND methodological analogue in the whole set to the ZIF-69 saIm work: a purpose-built two-axis mixed-linker ZIF (2-methylimidazolate : 5(6)-substituted-benzimidazolate) with Type III water isotherms and boiling-water stability, whose weakness is low absolute capacity and a humid claim that is qualitative in every reachable source.
roster.key_numbers: CO2 at 1 bar (800 torr) / 298 K: ZIF-300 1.32, ZIF-301 1.47 mmol/g; IAST CO2/N2 from Henry constants 22 and 19; Qst ~28 and ~30 kJ/mol; 0.15 bar NOT tabulated [미확인] [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 rows ZIF-300/ZIF-301, ref 247 = 10.1002/anie.201403980; table header verified: cols = CO2@1bar | CO2@0.15bar | IAST 15/85 | Qst | T | ref, in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-mangwon1-mof-project/17ab0b34-bbd4-4c48-81ab-e4bdcd9ada3b/scratchpad/PMC10829030.flat.txt]. Water: Type III at 298 K, uptakes only 6 / 5.8 / 4.5 mg/g = 0.33 / 0.32 / 0.25 mmol/g at P/P0 ~0.8, PXRD-stable in BOILING water 7 days [전문, 10.1002/advs.201901758, PMC7029650] — ~4x lower than SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta and ~30x lower than SIFSIX-3-Ni at comparable RH. BET (Ar, 87 K) 420 / 680 / 240 m2/g. Realized linker ratios 0.86:1.14 (Br), 0.94:1.06 (Cl), 0.67:1.33 (CH3). Review label 'Moisture-stable (80% RH)' [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2] is a STABILITY label, not a capacity number.
roster.mtv_headroom: HIGHEST in the roster and continuous with the current method. Axis 1 = 2-methylimidazolate : benzimidazolate ratio (three points already realized). Axis 2 = benzimidazolate 5(6)-substituent (Br / Cl / CH3 realized; NO2, CN, SO3H, NH2 unexplored — SO3H is the direct saIm transplant). CHA 8-ring windows sit near the CO2 kinetic diameter. CRITICAL: the same site-arrangement degeneracy that produced 8.7 %p batch scatter in ZIF-69 applies, so ensemble size must be registered before any run (/home/mangwon1/mof_project/CLAUDE.md §2, /home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/RULER_DECISION_20260828.md §7).
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES — full transfer, zero new machinery. Zn-N imidazolate, no OMS, physisorption only, rigid CHA with no reported breathing or gate opening; xtb GFN-FF relaxation, PACMAN DDEC6, Zeo++ PLD/LCD gates, UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 + TIP5P-Ew all apply directly. Br and Cl are already in the project's parameter experience.
roster.risks: (1) The humid claim is qualitative in every source reachable — Angew 2014 abstract elided by publisher; only the TITLE ('Selective capture of carbon dioxide under humid conditions by hydrophobic chabazite-type zeolitic imidazolate frameworks', verified via api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1002/anie.201403980) and the sentence 'equally effective ... under both dry and humid conditions without any loss of performance over three cycles' survive. No RH%, no wet/dry capacity. Quantifying it is itself a contribution but is currently an UNVERIFIED PREMISE. (2) 1 bar capacity 1.32-1.47 mmol/g is LOW; 0.15 bar will be much lower and may put working capacity below the 0.90 mol/kg '월등' threshold before humidity is even considered. (3) Qst 28-30 kJ/mol sits at/below the bottom of the 29.8-41 benchmark band. (4) Bromo/chloro-benzimidazolate are heavy — gravimetric capacity structurally penalized. (5) REGISTRATION CONFLICT: the repo already registers three GME-external ZIF forks — T-C4 ZIF-2 (crb), T-C5 ZIF-77 (frl), T-C9 npo ZIF-1001 (/home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/DESIGN_STUDY_20260903.md lines 370-377, 484-489). ZIF-300 would be a fourth and must be checked against those before proposing.

roster.name: ZIF-94 / SIM-1 (SOD)
roster.family: azolate — Zn(II) tetrahedral imidazolate, SOD (sodalite), isostructural with ZIF-8
roster.one_line: Carries the highest-RH quantitative humid retention in the entire set — 94.4 % of dry dynamic CO2 capacity at 99.2 % RH — on a linker with two independent substituent positions, i.e. pipeline-native chemistry with the humid evidence the ZIF line has been missing.
roster.key_numbers: 1 bar / 298 K: CO2 53.30 cm3/g = 2.38 mmol/g, N2 6.39 cm3/g = 0.285 mmol/g (ratio 8.34). IAST CO2/N2 (15:85) 67.11 at 273 K and 54.12 at 298 K. Qst(CO2) 28.23, Qst(N2) 15.71 kJ/mol. BET 588 m2/g; SOD cavity 8.0 A (vs 11.3 A for ZIF-8). Static 0.15 bar isotherm point NOT tabulated [미확인]. HUMID BREAKTHROUGH, 15/85 v/v CO2/N2, 298 K, 1 bar, 5 mL/min, 0.7147 g bed: dry dynamic saturated CO2 32.76 cm3/g (=1.46 mmol/g) with CO2 front at 33.2 min; at 99.2 % RH 30.94 cm3/g with front at 30.4 min => 94.4 % capacity retention, 92 % breakthrough-time retention; PXRD unchanged. Air 4 months -> 49.59 cm3/g; water-soaked 2 months -> 56.33 cm3/g vs 53.30 fresh; stable in boiling water >=24 h. All [전문, 10.3390/molecules27175608, PMC9458099, re-verified this session].
roster.mtv_headroom: VERY HIGH and directly continuous with saIm. The linker 4-methyl-5-imidazolecarbaldehyde carries TWO independent ring positions. Mixed-linker series: 2-methylimidazolate (ZIF-8) / 4-methyl-5-carbaldehyde (ZIF-94) fractional solid solutions; aldehyde -> carboxylic acid, SULFONATE (direct saIm analogue), nitrile, or post-synthetic imine condensation with amines. SOD has 24 linker sites per conventional cell, so the arrangement-vs-composition batch statistics recur and the 8.7 %p batch-unit problem must be budgeted from the start.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES — the best fit in the roster for THIS lab. Zn-N tetrahedral imidazolate, SOD, no OMS, physisorption only; identical chemistry class to ZIF-69, so xtb GFN-FF relaxation, PACMAN DDEC6, audit_orphans.py, Zeo++ gates and the UFF_MOF / Garcia-Sanchez / TIP5P-Ew stack transfer unchanged. The aldehyde C=O is a new functional group for DDEC6 but nothing exotic.
roster.risks: (1) CORRECTION TO THE INPUT RECORD: the input said 'water isotherm NOT reported'. It IS measured — 'Water-adsorption isotherms at 298 K were measured' and 'it showed its poor adsorption capacity for water vapor at room temperature and pressure (Figure S5)' [전문, PMC9458099, verified this session]. But the numerical uptake lives only in Figure S5, so the RH90 water loading itself remains [미확인] — the gap is narrower than stated but not closed. (2) Qst 28.23 kJ/mol is at/below the bottom edge of the 29.8-41 benchmark band; working capacity may be low even with excellent retention. (3) The 99.2 % RH result is DYNAMIC breakthrough; there is no equilibrium co-adsorption isotherm, so a GCMC RH90 co-adsorption prediction has no experimental counterpart to validate against — and TIFSIX-3-Ni in this same roster is the published proof that dynamic and equilibrium answers can differ by 3x. (4) SOD cavity 8.0 A is LARGER than the 4.0-4.5 A optimum this project's cavity model identified — the ZIF-7 failure mode, in the opposite direction.

roster.name: CALF-20 (+ CALF-20M-w / CALF-20M-e and anion-pillar variants)
roster.family: azolate/oxalate hybrid — Zn2(1,2,4-triazolate)2(oxalate), dmc topology, layered Zn-triazolate sheets pillared by oxalate
roster.one_line: The field benchmark and the only commercialized entry, with a real two-axis MTV ladder already synthesized (ring methylation + anionic pillar swap) — but it is genuinely flexible and its CO2-preferring window is BELOW 40 % RH, so a rigid 2x2x2 cell cannot give a quantitative RH90 answer.
roster.key_numbers: 2.6 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 298 K [전문 per input record, 10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0]; 2.47 mmol/g at 0.10 bar / 298 K and Qst ~ -40 kJ/mol [10.1002/advs.202401070]; 4.07 mmol/g at 1.2 bar / 293 K, IAST CO2/N2 (10:90) = 230, Qst 39 kJ/mol [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 row CALF-20, ref 217, footnote a = 1.2 bar]. PLD ~3 A, LCD ~4.3 A [10.1038/s41467-024-48136-0]. WATER: Type V with inflection below 20 % RH and saturation ~11 mmol/g [same]; in situ XRPD gives a water-induced PHASE TRANSITION between 20 and 30 % RH at 25 C, 1.65 H2O/Zn at 50 % RH rising to ~1.8 H2O/Zn at 90 % RH, fully reversible, suppressed above 45 C [전문, 10.1021/jacs.5c06866]. Durability >450,000 cycles, steam-stable 150 C for a week, multikilogram batches [10.1126/science.abi7281].
roster.mtv_headroom: HIGH and directly analogous to the saIm work. (i) Triazolate C3/C5 methylation — CALF-20M-w and CALF-20M-e already synthesized and shown to SHIFT THE WATER STEP [10.1039/d6sc03678c]. (ii) Anionic pillar substitution — SiF6(2-) and SO4(2-) already put into CALF-20-type frameworks [same]. (iii) oxalate -> longer/functionalized dicarboxylate. Mixed triazolate/methyltriazolate ratios give a composition axis with exactly the arrangement-vs-composition question ZIF-69 poses.
roster.pipeline_modelable: PARTIAL. No OMS and no chemisorption, so UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 + PACMAN DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew all apply — but CO2 loading distorts the pore rectangular->diamond->rectangular (pore-volume fraction changes ~12 %) and water drives a first-order polymorphic transition at 20-30 % RH. A rigid 2x2x2 cell cannot reproduce humidity-responsive polymorphism and will systematically mis-predict the RH0->RH90 curve. Usable as a DRY-BASIS benchmark and as a declared rigid-approximation control; NOT as a quantitative RH90 prediction.
roster.risks: (1) CORRECTION TO THE INPUT RECORD: the Science 2021 abstract, re-verified this session via api.semanticscholar.org, reads 'Testing shows preferential CO2 physisorption BELOW 40% relative humidity' — not 'at 40 % RH'. 40 % is the CEILING of the demonstrated window, not an operating point. This aligns with the independent practical ceilings (shaped/rotary-bed demo only to ~25-30 % RH [10.1002/advs.202401070]; 'almost insensitive up to 20-30% RH' [10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]; 'loses all activity at 80% RH' while CALF-20M retains ~20 % [10.1039/d6sc03678c]) and it removes the last support for treating CALF-20 as RH90-capable. (2) The Adv Mater 2025 review's 2.60 mmol/g at 40 % RH (~100 % retention) stays [미확인] — that review's Table 1 reference pointers are internally broken (refs 1-10 resolve to unrelated papers) [10.1002/adma.202515511]. (3) Water saturation ~11 mmol/g far exceeds CO2 capacity; RH90 retention is very likely poor. (4) dmc topology means the ZIF-69 gme substitution machinery does not transfer. (5) A 'we beat CALF-20' claim requires the flexibility caveat stated in the same sentence; a null result against it is publishable.

roster.name: SIFSIX-18-Ni-beta (2,3-dimethylpyrazine·SiF6 HUM)
roster.family: fluorinated-anion HUM — SiF6-pillared square grid, pcu-related, beta polymorph, Ni(II)
roster.one_line: The single best water-competition evidence in the set — H2O uptake of only 1.64 mmol/g at 95 % RH, 5-20x below every other HUM, with IAST CO2/H2O selectivity measured and > 1 — on a methylated-pyrazine linker that gives a clean fractional-substitution ladder orthogonal to the anion axis.
roster.key_numbers: ~2.8 mmol/g at 0.15 bar and ~3 mmol/g at 1 bar, Qst 52 kJ/mol, 298 K [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, ref 230; header verified]. Trace isotherm 0.4 / 0.8 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 mmol/g at 500 / 1000 / 3000 / 5000 / 10,000 ppm; N2 0.04 mmol/g at 1 bar; Qst 52 kJ/mol [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171, PMC6884411] (review Table 3 gives 0.4 at 500 ppm, footnote b, and 2.2 at 10,000 ppm — consistent). WATER, the key result: H2O only 1.64 mmol/g (DVS) / 0.96 mmol/g at ambient pressure at 95 % RH, vs SIFSIX-3-Ni 8.80, TIFSIX-3-Ni 7.46, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 10.09, Zeolite 13X 18.76, Mg-MOF-74 ~33.3 [전문, same, Table 1]. HUMID BREAKTHROUGH 298 K / 1 bar / 74 % RH, 3000 ppm CO2/N2: CO2 saturation ~1.5 mmol/g and retention 520 min/g — least degraded of six sorbents tested (NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 1.9 -> 0.5; Zeolite 13X -> 0.1 under identical conditions); dry 1000 ppm 0.7 mmol/g / 715 min/g; effluent CO2 < 50 ppm; six-cycle and 100-cycle recyclability at 74 % RH with no loss, desorption at 348 K. IAST CO2/H2O S_CW = 16.2 at 74 % RH / 500 ppm, rising to 54.0 and 173.1 at 0.005 and 0.01 bar CO2. Accelerated 40 C / 75 % RH: reverts to the alpha polymorph after 14 days, regenerable with negligible BET/CO2 change [전문, same]. C(CO2)-F 2.54-2.94 A, O(CO2)-H(host) 2.81-3.09 A. Explicit PLD/LCD not given [미확인].
roster.mtv_headroom: MODERATE-HIGH, and uniquely TWO ORTHOGONAL AXES. Axis 1 (the one that creates the hydrophobicity): pyrazine -> 2-methylpyrazine -> 2,3-dimethylpyrazine, a natural fractional-substitution ladder with the same shape as saIm. Axis 2: the anion pillar SiF6 / TiF6 / GeF6 / NbOF5 / SnF6, all isostructural with published data. Mixed-anion solid solutions are an unexplored MTV axis.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES — best structural fit in the roster. Physisorption only, no OMS, Ni fully coordinated by pyrazine N and F. Caveat: an alpha<->beta polymorph transition under water at 95 % RH is outside a rigid cell, and the strong F(-)···CO2 electrostatics make DDEC6 charge quality the dominant accuracy lever — the same sensitivity that drove the ZIF-69 EQeq->PACMAN switch.
roster.risks: (1) ALL published humid data are at TRACE CO2 (500-10,000 ppm), not 0.15 bar — extrapolating the 74 % RH retention to flue gas is an assumption, not a measurement, and the 0.15 bar / RH90 co-adsorption point does not exist experimentally. (2) Qst 52 kJ/mol sits well above the 29.8-41 benchmark band => high regeneration duty in a 298->373 K TSA window. (3) Polymorph switching under water is a rigid-GCMC blind spot. (4) Ni-pyrazine-SiF6 chemistry has no overlap with the ZIF synthesis line already in the lab — pure computational candidate. (5) The 90 % RH review label is a stability label [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2]; the capacity evidence stops at 74 % RH.

roster.name: Pyrazine·MF6 pcu HUM anion series (SIFSIX-3-Ni/Cu/Zn, TIFSIX-3-Ni/Co, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni, GeFSIX-3-Ni)
roster.family: fluorinated-anion HUM — pcu / alpha-Po primitive cubic, unsubstituted pyrazine + MF6(2-) pillar
roster.one_line: Not a winner but the only graded, single-variable experimental ladder in the set with quantitative DRY and HUMID endpoints on both ends — the one place our RH-competition module can actually be calibrated, including one endpoint (NbOFFIVE, S_CW = 0.03) it MUST reproduce as a failure.
roster.key_numbers: FLUE GAS [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, header verified this session]: SIFSIX-3-Ni ~2.5 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, 2.7 at 1 bar, Qst 50.9, 298 K (ref 231); TIFSIX-3-Ni 2.39 at 0.15 bar, ~2.42 at 1 bar, Qst 50 (ref 229); NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 2.2 at 1 bar, 0.15 bar not tabulated [미확인], Qst 54 (ref 191); SIFSIX-3-Zn 2.55 at 1 bar, IAST CO2/N2 1818, Qst 45; SIFSIX-3-Cu ~2.50 at 1 bar, Qst 54. DAC [same, Table 3, footnotes a = 400 ppm, b = 500 ppm]: NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 1.30 / ~2.15 mmol/g at 400 ppm / 10,000 ppm; TIFSIX-3-Ni 1.12 / 1.75; GeFSIX-3-Ni 1.07 / 2.41, Qst 55.5 (ref 270); TIFSIX-3-Co 1.05 / 2.63. Pore 3.5 A (Cu), 3.84 A (Zn), ~3.8 A (Ni) by NLDFT; BET(CO2, 298 K) ~250 (Zn) / ~300 (Cu) m2/g; SIFSIX-3-Cu 1.24 mmol/g at 400 ppm and 82.6 cm3(STP)/cm3 at 0.01 bar [전문, 10.1038/ncomms5228]. HUMID: SIFSIX-3-Ni retains 62 % of dry CO2 uptake at 0.15 bar CO2 / 0.85 bar N2 / 75 % RH [전문 of 10.1002/anie.202206613 citing 10.1002/anie.201506952 and 10.1039/c7cc02289a] — the most directly comparable number in the entire set to our RH90/RH0 metric. TIFSIX-3-Ni: first cycle dry 53.9 vs wet 48.2 cm3/g (89 %), breakthrough 18 vs 16 min/g, cycles 2-3 at 50.8 / 51.2 — BUT after FULL humid saturation over several hours TPD recovers only 15.7 cm3/g CO2 (0.27 molecules/uc, ~29 %) alongside ~240 cm3/g H2O [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613]. NbOFFIVE-1-Ni at 74 % RH / 3000 ppm: 1.9 -> 0.5 mmol/g, 425 -> ~128 min/g, IAST S_CW = 0.03 (water preferred ~33:1) [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]. H2O at 95 % RH: SIFSIX-3-Ni 8.80, TIFSIX-3-Ni 7.46, NbOFFIVE-1-Ni 10.09 mmol/g [same, Table 1]; TIFSIX-3-Ni equilibrium ~240 cm3/g = 4.1 H2O/uc (saturation 4).
roster.mtv_headroom: HIGH on the ANION axis, LOW on the linker axis. SiF6 / TiF6 / GeF6 / SnF6 / NbOF5(2-) / AlF5(H2O)(2-) are drop-in isostructural pillars with published CO2 and (for three of them) humid data — a clean single-variable series with both endpoints measured. Mixed-anion (SiF6/TiF6) solid solutions are an unexplored MTV axis. The pyrazine itself can only be methylated, which changes polymorph and moves you to SIFSIX-18.
roster.pipeline_modelable: FRAMEWORK YES, MECHANISM PARTIALLY NO. Physisorption, no OMS, force fields apply. But (a) SIFSIX-3-Ni undergoes a hydrolytic phase change at >=80 % RH — precisely at our RH90 condition — so its RH90 output must be pre-registered as an UPPER BOUND; (b) TIFSIX-3-Ni's headline 89-90 % is a slow-water-kinetics, non-equilibrium cycling effect, and equilibrium GCMC (what our pipeline computes) will reproduce the PESSIMISTIC ~29 % number. TIFSIX-3-Ni is the field's clearest published example that a co-adsorption GCMC RH90 result and a real process result differ by 3x, and it belongs in the pre-registration as a stated caution. (c) A 3.5-3.8 A pore with strongly polarizing F(-) sites is charge-quality-limited under a rigid 12 A cutoff / Ewald treatment.
roster.risks: (1) As CANDIDATES all three are already disqualified or borderline: 62 % at 75 % RH is below our 80 % 'valid' gate and lands in the 50-80 % conditional band, and RH90 will be worse; TIFSIX equilibrium ~29 %; NbOFFIVE water-preferred 33:1. (2) Qst 45-55 kJ/mol is above the benchmark band throughout. (3) NbOFFIVE's review label 'moisture-stable (95 % RH)' next to a 74 % capacity loss is the canonical LABEL-vs-CAPACITY trap this project has been burned by — worth quoting verbatim in the poster. (4) No synthetic overlap with the ZIF line. USE: run NbOFFIVE-1-Ni as the NEGATIVE CONTROL for the water-competition module before trusting any new-framework RH90 number — a correct TIP5P-Ew + DDEC6 co-adsorption calculation must return S_CW << 1 at 74 % RH.

roster.name: UTSA-120 + dptz-CuTiF6 (dipyridyl-tetrazine·MF6 pillared, SIFSIX-2-Cu-i net)
roster.family: fluorinated-anion pillared square grid — Cu(II), N-rich tetrazine linker, pcu-type
roster.one_line: The highest 0.15 bar capacity in the entire set (3.56 mmol/g) combined with the LOWEST Qst (27-31 kJ/mol) — i.e. the best dry working-capacity target available — with a second published anion endpoint on the same linker, but with no humid capacity number behind its '80 % RH' label.
roster.key_numbers: UTSA-120 = [Cu(dpt)2(SiF6)]n, dpt = 3,6-di(4-pyridyl)-1,2,4,5-tetrazine: 3.56 mmol/g at 0.15 bar and 296 K, 5.0 mmol/g at 1 bar, IAST CO2/N2 ~600, Qst 27-31 kJ/mol [PRIMARY abstract verified this session via api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1039/c8ta11596f — 'simultaneously high CO2 capture capacity (3.56 mmol g-1 at 0.15 bar and 296 K) and CO2/N2 selectivity (~600)'; cross-confirmed by 10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2 row UTSA-120, ref 215]. Crossref-verified citation: Wen, Liao, Li, Alsalme, Alothman, Krishna, Wu, Zhou, Hu, Chen, J. Mater. Chem. A 2019, 7, 3128-3134. Isoreticular to SIFSIX-2-Cu-i (5.41 mmol/g at 1 bar, IAST 140, Qst 31.9, review label 'moisture-stable (95 % RH)' [Table 2, ref 213]). TiF6 ANALOGUE dptz-CuTiF6: 2.93 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, 4.52 at 1 bar, Qst 38.2 kJ/mol, 298 K [Table 2, ref 192]; 2.1 mmol/g at 10,000 ppm [Table 3]. Neutron powder diffraction attributes the low-pressure capacity to DUAL functionalities (SiF6(2-) and tetrazine) enabling dense CO2 packing. Explicit PLD/LCD not reported [미확인].
roster.mtv_headroom: HIGH, and unusually it already has TWO MEASURED ENDPOINTS on the anion axis with 0.15 bar values for both (SiF6 3.56, TiF6 2.93) — a rare case where the MTV series is not hypothetical. Axis 2: the dipyridyl-tetrazine linker (tetrazine -> pyrazine -> bipyridyl -> functionalized tetrazine), plus mixed-linker solid solutions between the 5.15 A SIFSIX-2-Cu-i linker and dpt. Pillar can extend to NbOF5.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES structurally — physisorption, SiF6 pillar, no OMS, same class as SIFSIX. Qst 27-31 kJ/mol inside the benchmark band means the 298->373 K TSA window should genuinely reverse it, which is the point. The tetrazine's high N-site density is polar, so the RH90 water competition is genuinely UNKNOWN — and that unknown is exactly what our pipeline exists to answer, which makes this the highest-information dry-strong / wet-unknown candidate in the roster.
roster.risks: (1) The '80 % RH' descriptor [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2] is a STABILITY label with NO humid capacity number behind it in any source reached; the primary JMCA abstract describes breakthrough only 'under ambient conditions' for CO2/N2 (15/85) and CO2/CH4 (50/50) and does not mention humidity at all (verified this session). Treat as NOT humid-validated — this is precisely the trap NbOFFIVE-1-Ni illustrates in the entry above. (2) The only humid claim in the input record ('performance completely maintained after 1 month air exposure') is an EXPOSURE result. (3) High N-site density is a plausible water-binding liability. (4) No water isotherm found [미확인]. (5) Primary JMCA 2019 full text not accessible (abstract only); all non-abstract numbers route through a review table.

roster.name: ALF — aluminium formate, Al(HCOO)3
roster.family: carboxylate (metal formate) — ReO3-like cubic Al-formate net, Al(III), no OMS
roster.one_line: The cheapest and most deployable framework in the roster and the only one where CO2 is shown to DISPLACE preadsorbed water (70 % of dry dynamic capacity after RH 80.5 % presaturation), with a published DFT mechanism for why — but with almost no MTV headroom, which is the strategic disqualifier for this project's method.
roster.key_numbers: 2.7 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 320 K (NOTE: 320 K, not 298 K), ~4 mmol/g at 1 bar, IAST CO2/N2 (85:15) 368, Qst 47.9 kJ/mol [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, ref 210, header verified]. Experimental isosteric enthalpy -47.7 kJ/mol at ~1 mmol/g; DFT binding -48.4 (small cavity) / -36.2 (large cavity) kJ/mol; saturation CO2 ~4.8 mmol/g by neutron diffraction. Breakthrough 15/85 CO2/N2 at 323 K: 0.80(1) mmol/g CO2, CO2/N2 selectivity 75(21), N2 < 0.1 mmol/g. BET 588 +/- 8 m2/g; two cavity types 43(3) and 79(9) A3; channel windows 4.561(7) A (SC/LC) and 4.103(19) A (SC/SC). All [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.ade1473]. HUMID: columns PRESATURATED with moisture at RH = 80.5 % (298 K) then fed 15/85 CO2/N2 retained 70 % of dry dynamic CO2 capacity; 50 humid TGA cycles at 3 % H2O between 313 and 353 K; 130 dry cycles; performance largely retained with SO2 and NO present. Mechanism: H2O binds the small cavity slightly more strongly than CO2 (-51.3 vs -48.4 kJ/mol) but CO2 is strongly preferred in the large cavity (-36.2 vs -28.8), which is why CO2 displaces water. Water isotherms measured with RH ramped 0 -> 90/95 % -> 0 at 313/323/333 K under both N2 and CO2 carriers [전문, same].
roster.mtv_headroom: LOW-MODERATE — the main strategic weakness. Formate has no substitutable ring position, so there is no analogue of the saIm fractional-substitution study and the MTV question this project is built around does NOT transfer. Available axes are metal substitution (Al -> Fe, Ga, In, Sc formates) and mixed formate/acetate or formate/fluoride anion doping only.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES — arguably the cleanest fit after SIFSIX-18. Rigid small-molecule framework, no OMS, no chemisorption, no reported breathing; formate C/H/O is well covered by UFF_MOF, DDEC6 on formate is straightforward, and TIP5P-Ew water in a 4.1-4.6 A window is the regime the pipeline handles. Caveat: the CO2/N2 discrimination is partly KINETIC (window 4.10-4.56 A vs CO2 3.3 A, N2 3.64 A) and equilibrium GCMC will not reproduce a kinetic sieve.
roster.risks: (1) The AUTHORS THEMSELVES rule out our target condition: hydrolytic stability envelope ~25 % RH at 323 K, and ALF 'cannot be used to directly treat postcombustion flue gas saturated with moisture' — it needs upstream drying (cooling/condensation suffices). RH90 is far outside its envelope. (2) The 80.5 % RH result is a PRESATURATION experiment (water first, then CO2), NOT co-fed RH90 equilibrium co-adsorption — a different test and it must be labelled as such (CLAUDE.md §2: 'different conditions = a different trial, write it that way'). (3) Qst 47.7-47.9 kJ/mol above the benchmark band. (4) The 0.15 bar number is at 320 K, not our 298 K — do not put it in a 298 K column. (5) Kinetic sieving invisible to equilibrium GCMC. (6) Minimal MTV headroom.

roster.name: MUF-16 family — M(Haip)2, M = Co / Ni / Mn (5-aminoisophthalate)
roster.family: carboxylate — metal aminoisophthalate, narrow 1D channels, metal coordinatively saturated when activated
roster.one_line: The sharpest EQUILIBRIUM VALIDATION NEGATIVE available: an independent 2025 presaturation experiment shows literally zero CO2/water coadsorption at 50 and 70 % RH, so if our RH-competition module cannot reproduce that, the module is wrong — carried on a linker with a real saIm-style substituent axis on a carboxylate.
roster.key_numbers: ~2 mmol/g at 100 kPa / 30 C with N2 essentially zero at the same temperature; Qst(CO2) ~36 kJ/mol; breakthrough feed 14 % CO2 / 2 % He / balance N2 (~0.14 bar CO2) [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139, PMC12616598]. Review values, 293 K, 1 atm: MUF-16(Co) 2.13, MUF-16(Ni) 2.14, MUF-16(Mn) 2.25 mmol/g, Qst 32.3 / 37.3 / 36.6 kJ/mol [10.1039/d3sc06076d TABLE 4, ref 265]. WARNING verified this session: Table 4 is the NATURAL-GAS table — its header reads 'IAST selectivity at 1 bar (50/50) CO2/CH4', so the 6690 / 1220 / 470 figures in those rows are CO2/CH4, NOT CO2/N2, and must never be quoted as flue-gas selectivity. Explicit 0.15 bar isotherm point not tabulated [미확인]; PLD/LCD not reported [미확인]. Water isotherms measured gravimetrically at three temperatures (TA VTI-SA+, activated 150 C/12 h, equilibrated to < 0.0001 %/5 min) but numerical uptakes not extractable from accessible text [미확인].
roster.mtv_headroom: MODERATE. The 5-amino group on isophthalate is a genuine substituent position — amino -> nitro, SULFONATE, methyl, H, hydroxy, i.e. a direct saIm-style series transplanted onto a carboxylate. Metal axis Mn / Co / Ni / Zn isostructural, with three members already made and their Qst measured. Not a 24-site MTV lattice like a ZIF, so the arrangement-degeneracy batch statistics should be MILDER — which is itself worth measuring, because it would tell us how much of the 8.7 %p ZIF-69 batch scatter is topology-specific.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES. Carboxylate framework, no open metal sites in the activated form, physisorption only, no reported flexibility; UFF_MOF covers Co-O carboxylate, PACMAN DDEC6 fine, TIP5P-Ew appropriate. Its highest-value use is as a CO-ADSORPTION VALIDATION RUN: the experimental answer at 50-70 % RH is known and unambiguous (zero CO2 coadsorption), which is a pass/fail test our module can be held to before any new-framework RH90 number is trusted.
roster.risks: (1) SPLIT humid verdict that must be recorded honestly in both directions. POSITIVE: excellent kinetics and stability under humidity over 100+ breakthrough cycles [요지, 10.1021/acsami.1c01156]. NEGATIVE (independent, 2025): with the bed presaturated at 50 % and 70 % RH at 30 C and then fed 14 % CO2 / 2 % He / N2 at the same humidity, 'the He tracer and CO2 break through at essentially the same time with sharp fronts, demonstrating that in the presence of water at these RH% there is NO COADSORPTION of CO2 with water' [전문, 10.1021/acsami.5c16139]. The authors read this as a PROCESS ADVANTAGE (sharp fronts for a simulated-moving-bed design keeping the feed zone dry), but for an equilibrium RH90 co-adsorption metric it is a ZERO. Never cite the '100 humid cycles' claim without the presaturation caveat. (2) At RH90 it is almost certainly a hard zero on our metric — so it enters the roster as a control, not as a winner. (3) Qst CONFLICT, unresolved [미확인]: the review gives 32.3 kJ/mol for the Co form while the 2025 paper gives ~36 kJ/mol; the input record's claim that '32/37 needs no correction' does not survive this — the two sources disagree on the same material. (4) PLD/LCD unpublished, so the Zeo++ PLD >= 3.3 A gate must be evaluated on the CIF before anything else. (5) Synthesis needs a ppm-level Mn(II) additive for reproducible crystal quality — a hidden variable for anyone attempting it.

roster.name: Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta (Cu quinoline-5-carboxylate) + quinolinecarboxylate isomer series
roster.family: sql 2D square-lattice coordination network — Cu(II), quinoline-5-carboxylate, hydrophobic ultramicroporous
roster.one_line: A 3.3 A molecular sieve with the highest CO2/N2 selectivity in the review's flue-gas table (40,000) and a Qst squarely inside our benchmark band — and its pore sits EXACTLY on this project's own registered PLD >= 3.3 A hard gate, so running the gate on it tests whether our screen is discarding real winners.
roster.key_numbers: 2.16 mmol/g at 1 bar / 293 K; IAST CO2/N2 40,000 — the highest for any physisorbent in the review's flue-gas table; Qst 36 kJ/mol (inside the 29.8-41 band); 0.15 bar value NOT tabulated [미확인] [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, ref 216, header verified]. Pore size 3.3 A, a near-exact match to the CO2 kinetic diameter, which is what produces the sieving. HUMID + STABILITY, review full text quoted verbatim this session: 'Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta could maintain its structural integrity not only in water for 21 days but also in air with 75% RH for 14 days... Dynamic breakthrough experiments further demonstrated that the CO2 separation capacity of Qc-5-Cu-sql-beta could also be maintained even at 75% RH' [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d reporting 10.1002/anie.201603934]. Quantitative wet/dry capacity ratio NOT available [미확인] — the primary Angew 2016 abstract is elided by the publisher; only the title survives verification: 'Tuning Pore Size in Square-Lattice Coordination Networks for Size-Selective Sieving of CO2' [api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1002/anie.201603934]. Explicit Zeo++ PLD/LCD not reported [미확인].
roster.mtv_headroom: MODERATE-HIGH. The primary paper's own title is a pore-size-tuning ladder, and the quinoline ring has multiple substitutable positions: the isomer series quinoline-3-, -5-, -6-carboxylate and isoquinoline is a published pore-size axis, and the metal axis Cu / Ni / Zn / Co is available. Mixed-ligand sql solid solutions are unexplored — and in a 2D layered lattice the arrangement degeneracy has a different geometry than in a 3D ZIF, which is an independently interesting batch-statistics question.
roster.pipeline_modelable: MOSTLY YES. Physisorption, no chemisorption; the Cu node in the sql beta form is not an accessible open metal site for guest binding; rigid framework, no reported breathing. But the 40,000 selectivity is a SIEVING result (N2 size-excluded at 3.3 A) that equilibrium GCMC will represent only through the LJ walls, not as a kinetic exclusion.
roster.risks: (1) A 3.3 A pore sits EXACTLY on the repo's registered rigid PLD >= 3.3 A hard gate (/home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/DESIGN_STUDY_20260903.md line 489, test T-C9) — the material may be auto-rejected by our own screen. Run the gate on the deposited CIF and RECORD THE OUTCOME BEFORE drawing any conclusion; a gate that rejects a 40,000-selectivity sieve is itself a registrable finding about the gate, and this is the cheapest available test of it. (2) No water isotherm found, so the co-primary RH90 water-loading metric is unconstrained [미확인]. (3) The 75 % RH claim is QUALITATIVE in every source reachable (Angew 2016 blocked 403). (4) The 2D sql layers stack by van der Waals contact; layer sliding under water is a plausible failure mode a rigid 2x2x2 cell cannot see. (5) Cu(II) may still be a partial water-binding site despite the 'no OMS' classification. (6) No 0.15 bar datum anywhere — the absolute-capacity axis is entirely unmeasured at our condition.

roster.name: MIL-120(Al)-AP (aluminium pyromellitate)
roster.family: carboxylate — Al(OH)4O2 chain framework with 1D narrow channels, dense mu2-OH, Al(III), no OMS
roster.one_line: The sharpest available test of the CORRECTED water force field (Hw none / Lw none) on a hydroxyl-lined pore, on a framework with the cheapest published production cost of any MOF (~13 $/kg) and a textbook adsorbaphore motif — but hydrophilic by design and with humid cycling that already shows progressive water accumulation.
roster.key_numbers: 1.90 mmol/g at 0.10 bar / 298 K (73.1 cm3/cm3); 3.87 mmol/g at 0.9 bar; the 0.15 bar value lies between these two and is NOT tabulated [미확인]; N2 only 0.32 mmol/g at 0.9 bar. Qst -41 kJ/mol at near-zero coverage, decreasing only ~5 kJ/mol with loading (unusually flat). IAST CO2/N2 ~90 for both 15:85 and 5:95 at 298 K / 1 bar. 1D channels free section ~5.4 x 4.7 A; BET ~590 m2/g; parallel aromatic rings 6.5-7.0 A apart, matching the 'adsorbaphore' motif predicted by Smit et al. for CO2. Production: green ambient-pressure aqueous route, kilogram scale demonstrated, shaped into beads with 10 % silica or 10 % bentonite with retained sorption, techno-economic cost ~13 $/kg at kton scale vs ~25-30 $/kg for CALF-20. All [전문, 10.1002/advs.202401070, PMC11151012]. Water isotherms measured at 298 K for both -HP and -AP forms; authors state the dense mu2-OH confers 'a rather hydrophilic character' and that MIL-120 is 'slightly more hydrophilic than CALF-20'; numerical uptakes are in the SI only [미확인].
roster.mtv_headroom: MODERATE. The benzene ring of BTeC is FULLY substituted by carboxylates, so ring functionalization is blocked — but the MIL-120 / MIL-121 pair shows that carboxylate CONNECTIVITY is itself a variable (MIL-121 leaves two carboxylates free and pointing into the channel), and Al -> Ga / In / Fe / Sc substitution is available. Mixed BTeC/trimesate or BTeC/terephthalate solid solutions are unexplored. Weaker than the ZIF entries, comparable to MUF-16.
roster.pipeline_modelable: YES — clean rigid Al-carboxylate, no OMS, no chemisorption, no reported breathing; good target for the full stack. Its distinctive value: the dense mu2-OH groups are strong specific water sites and will DOMINATE the TIP5P-Ew result, making this the sharpest test in the roster of whether the 2026-09-06 water force-field correction (Hw none / Lw none, terms 55->57; /home/mangwon1/mof_project/21_ZIF69_MTV/WATER_FIX_20260906.md and CLAUDE.md §1) behaves sensibly on hydroxyl-lined pores. Any result must come from the v3w_* series only.
roster.risks: (1) HYDROPHILIC BY DESIGN (dense mu2-OH) and self-described as more hydrophilic than CALF-20 — RH90 prospects are poor. (2) The only humid demonstration is operando IR at 1 % H2O (the maximum the authors envisage AFTER upstream condensation), far below RH30; there is no RH >= 30 % equilibrium co-adsorption datum. (3) Humid CO2/N2 cycling on shaped beads shows 'the progressive accumulation of water between each cycle leading to a CO2 capacity decrease in the operating conditions (i.e. without heat or vacuum)', with full capacity recoverable only after reactivation at 50 C under vacuum — a cumulative failure mode a single-point equilibrium GCMC will not show. (4) The kinetic argument (CO2 sorbs faster than H2O) is invisible to equilibrium GCMC. (5) No free aromatic MTV position.

None of these carries a humid CAPACITY number in the table, only stability labels — the same trap NbOFFIVE illustrates.

NbOFFIVE-1-Ni (KAUST-7) — MERGED into the 'Pyrazine·MF6 pcu HUM anion series' roster entry as its negative endpoint, not a standalone candidate. Standalone verdict is disqualifying: at 74 % RH / 3000 ppm the CO2 saturation uptake collapses 1.9 -> 0.5 mmol/g and retention time 425 -> ~128 min/g, with IAST CO2/H2O S_CW = 0.03, i.e. water preferred ~33:1 [전문, 10.1126/sciadv.aax9171]. Its review label 'Moisture-stable (95% RH)' [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, ref 191] refers to STRUCTURAL survival, not retained capacity — the canonical label-vs-capacity trap. Retained inside the merged entry because it is the best available NEGATIVE CONTROL for the water-competition module.

SIFSIX-3-Ni / SIFSIX-3-Cu / SIFSIX-3-Zn — MERGED into the 'Pyrazine·MF6 pcu HUM anion series' entry (isostructural pcu, identical unsubstituted pyrazine linker, differ only in metal and anion; not distinct frameworks). Standalone verdict: 62 % of dry CO2 uptake at 0.15 bar CO2 / 0.85 bar N2 / 75 % RH [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613] is already below our 80 % 'valid' gate, and a documented hydrolytic phase change at 80 % RH sits BELOW our RH90 target; H2O 8.80 mmol/g at 95 % RH [10.1126/sciadv.aax9171 Table 1]; Qst 45-54 kJ/mol above the benchmark band.

TIFSIX-3-Ni / TIFSIX-3-Co — MERGED into the 'Pyrazine·MF6 pcu HUM anion series' entry (isostructural, TiF6 member of the same anion ladder). Standalone verdict: the headline 89-90 % retention is a SHORT-CYCLE KINETIC result; after full humid saturation TPD recovers only 15.7 of 53.9 cm3/g CO2 (~29 %) alongside ~240 cm3/g H2O [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206613]. Equilibrium GCMC computes the ~29 % number, so as a candidate it fails on the very metric our pipeline measures. Retained inside the merged entry as the field's clearest published proof that dynamic and equilibrium humid answers differ by 3x — it belongs in the T-NF pre-registration as a stated caution.

GeFSIX-3-Ni — MERGED into the 'Pyrazine·MF6 pcu HUM anion series' entry as a fifth anion-axis member. Only DAC-range data exist: 1.07 mmol/g at 400 ppm and 2.41 at 10,000 ppm, Qst 55.5 kJ/mol, 298 K [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 3, ref 270]; no flue-gas 0.15 bar point and no humid datum, so it cannot stand alone.

dptz-CuTiF6 — MERGED into the 'UTSA-120' entry as its TiF6 anion endpoint: 2.93 mmol/g at 0.15 bar, 4.52 at 1 bar, Qst 38.2 kJ/mol, 298 K [10.1039/d3sc06076d Table 2, ref 192]; 2.1 mmol/g at 10,000 ppm [Table 3]. Same dipyridyl-tetrazine linker as UTSA-120, so it is the second point of one anion series rather than a separate framework — and it is what makes UTSA-120's MTV headroom a measured claim rather than a hypothetical one.
SIM-1 — SAME MATERIAL as ZIF-94, merged. The source itself equates them: 'ZIF-8 and ZIF-94 (also known as SIM-1)' [10.3390/molecules27175608, verified this session].

ZIF-301 and ZIF-302 — MERGED with ZIF-300 into one CHA dual-linker family entry: same topology, same Zn(2-methylimidazolate)x(benzimidazolate)y construction, differing only in the benzimidazolate 5(6)-substituent (Br / Cl / CH3) and the linker ratio. They are three points on one composition axis, which is precisely why the family is the roster's top MTV entry, not three separate candidates.

CALF-20M-w, CALF-20M-e, and the SiF6/SO4-pillared CALF-20 variants — MERGED into the CALF-20 entry as its two MTV axes [10.1039/d6sc03678c]. They are the demonstration that CALF-20's water step can be MOVED by methylation (parent loses all activity at 80 % RH; CALF-20M-w/-e retain ~20 %), which is the only reason CALF-20 keeps a roster slot despite the flexibility problem.

MIL-160(Al) — DROPPED on mechanism fit, not on data quality. It is a BENCHMARK ATMOSPHERIC WATER-HARVESTING sorbent: a steep type-V water isotherm whose step sits at ~5-10 % RH by design [요지, 10.1021/acsengineeringau.5c00051, 10.1039/d3qm00484h]. A framework selected to pull water out of DRY air will be water-saturated long before RH90, so it cannot compete on our co-primary metric. Its CO2 numbers are modest anyway (0.95 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 30 C, working capacity 0.85 mmol/g between 0.015 and 0.15 bar, enthalpy -33 kJ/mol, IAST CO2/N2 34) and its impressive process result — a 3-bed 6-step VPSA pilot with 60 kg of shaped material giving 90 % CO2 purity and 92.7 % recovery vs 79.7 % and 85 % for zeolite 13X — was on a DRY 15/85 binary feed and must never be quoted as humid performance [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224]. KEEP the material and the CAU-10-H / -CH3 / -NO2 / -NH2 / -OH series as (a) a negative control for the water-competition module — a correct TIP5P-Ew calculation must show water saturating the pores at low RH and CO2 excluded at RH90 — and (b) the best published WATER-STEP-POSITION ruler for calibrating where a substituent moves the step. Not a candidate.

UTSA-16 — DROPPED on modelability. The K(I) sites carry TWO COORDINATED WATER molecules (O3w) in the as-synthesized structure [전문, 10.1038/ncomms1956], which forces an arbitrary decision about whether to treat those waters as part of the framework (changing the CIF and every DDEC6 charge) or as adsorbate — a choice that by itself changes the RH90 answer and would need its own pre-registration. Alkali-cation frameworks are also a known weak spot for UFF-type force fields. The humid evidence is contradictory in a way that maps exactly onto the label-vs-capacity trap: NEGATIVE at equilibrium — 'Mg-MOF-74 and UTSA-16 exhibit a drastic decrease of CO2 capacity in wet conditions' [전문, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224 citing 10.1021/acsami.6b13216] — versus POSITIVE for SHAPED BODIES, 3D-printed monoliths 'without detectable degradation even near 100% RH' [요지, 10.1016/j.cej.2020.126166] and 30 wt% composite pellets retaining stability to humid air, SOx and NOx [요지, 10.1016/j.jece.2023.109593]; the positives are process results on formed bodies, the negative is the material equilibrium result our pipeline computes. Also: > 2 mmol/g at 0.15 bar with CO2/N2 > 100 [요지, 10.1016/j.ccst.2024.100224], 160 cm3/cm3 volumetric at ambient [전문, 10.1038/ncomms1956], diamondoid cage ~4.5 A — good numbers on a material we cannot honestly model. No aromatic MTV axis (citrate is not substitutable in the saIm sense); axes limited to alkali cation K/Na/Rb/Cs and metal Co/Ni/Mn/Zn.

PCN-250(Fe3) and PCN-250(Fe2Co) — DROPPED on mechanism: OPEN METAL SITES, the route this project already abandoned. The headline is the rare moisture-ENHANCED case (at 50 % RH / 1 bar / 298 K uptake RISES from 1.18 to 1.82 mmol/g for Fe3, +54 %, and from 1.32 to 2.23 for Fe2Co, +69 % [요지, 10.1002/adma.202515511 Table 1, primary 10.1021/acsami.8b14400]) — but that enhancement almost certainly comes from water COORDINATING the open Fe/Co sites and creating new polar CO2 binding environments, exactly the chemistry a rigid UFF_MOF + DDEC6 + TIP5P-Ew stack cannot represent. Modelling it would predict a competitive-adsorption PENALTY and miss the enhancement entirely, i.e. we would get the sign wrong. Three further reasons not to queue it: the Adv Mater 2025 review's Table 1 citation pointers are internally broken (refs 1-10 resolve to unrelated general MOF papers) so the numbers are [미확인] pending the inaccessible ACS AMI 2018 primary; only 1 bar data exist, no 0.15 bar point; and the humidity is 50 %, not 90 %. Keep as a LITERATURE COUNTEREXAMPLE (evidence that moisture enhancement is physically possible) and as the standing justification for why the OMS route stays closed — its MTV headroom (Fe3/Fe2Co/Fe2Ni metal mixing plus ABTC functionalization) is high but irrelevant.

MAF-X27ox and MAF-X25ox — DROPPED, CHEMISORPTIVE (explicitly excluded class). Qst rises from 38 and 28 kJ/mol in the precursors to 120 and 124 kJ/mol on oxidation (the review text elsewhere quotes 99 and 110) [요지, 10.1039/d3sc06076d citing 10.1039/c4ee02717e]: the monodentate hydroxide REACTS with CO2 to form bicarbonate. Rigid GCMC with UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 cannot represent bond formation, so this is out by the same exclusion as amine carbamate. A second, independent reason: 120+ kJ/mol may not reverse at all inside a 298 -> 373 K TSA window. Worth NAMING in the poster because the numbers are the best in the whole set and the mechanism is not amine — 4.08 and 4.06 mmol/g at 0.15 bar / 298 K (410 % and 540 % above their precursors), CO2/N2 250 and 262-264, and breakthrough curves 'nearly the same in both dry and high-humidity environments' while the precursor 'almost could not capture CO2 from the wet mixture' [요지, same, primary title: 'Monodentate hydroxide as a super strong yet reversible active site for CO2 capture from high-humidity flue gas']. This is the strongest existing evidence that HYDROXIDE-not-amine is a viable humid-tolerant chemistry — a finding to cite, not a framework to compute. Primary EES 2015 text not accessible; RH% and quantitative wet capacities [미확인].

KHCO3 CD-MOF (gamma-cyclodextrin / alkali framework, CD-MOF-2 family) — DROPPED, CHEMISORPTIVE, and it fails the humid bar independently. CO2 is captured by nucleophilic attack of the charge-balancing hydroxide to form (bi)carbonate — the authors themselves analogise it to carbonic anhydrase — with Qst 49.5 +/- 1.8 kJ/mol [전문, 10.1002/anie.202206718, accepted manuscript via OSTI 1891061].
